A temperature-scaled Softmax over predictive entropies assigns continuous weights to all chunks, enabling log-space aggregation across chunk-conditioned distributions. To partially compensate for the conditional independence assumption introduced by chunking, we propose Consistency Distillation, a LoRA-based self-distillation that constrains the chunked logit distribution toward a full-context teacher via KL-divergence. On LongBench multi-hop benchmarks, Soft-NBCE with Consistency Distillation improves consistently over NBCE-style baselines (MuSiQue F1: 0.310 vs.\ 0.275 for Vanilla NBCE; HotpotQA F1: 0.479 vs.\ 0.427) while maintaining retrieval accuracy (NIAH-32K: 0.909) at O(L^2/n) peak memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Soft-NBCE，将 NBCE 的离散硬选择路由替换为基于熵的连续软融合（logit 空间加权聚合），并配合 LoRA 一致性蒸馏，在保持 O(L²/n) 峰值内存的同时，在多跳推理和长程检索任务上显著优于 NBCE、PCW 等分块基线方法。
AI.motivation: 自注意力的 O(N²) 复杂度是 LLM 处理超长上下文的瓶颈。NBCE 通过分块并行推理并选择最低熵分块来缓解该问题，但其硬选择策略在跨分块推理时会导致语义碎片化：相邻 token 间分块路由的突变破坏了模型上下文的一致性。
AI.method: （1）熵驱动的置信度加权：对每个分块计算预测熵，经温度缩放 Softmax 得到连续权重 w_k，τ→0 退化为硬选择，τ→∞ 退化为均匀平均（PCW）；（2）对数空间的概率叠加：生成 logit 为各分块条件分布的加权和（几何平均），并结合对比先验 log P(T|Q) 抑制停用词劫持；（3）Top-p 核过滤（p=0.90）去除先验概率极小的 token；（4）Consistency Distillation：以全上下文教师模型的输出为软标签，对冻结的 LLaMA-3-8B 施加 LoRA（rank=64，仅作用于 W_q 和 W_v），通过 KL 散度约束缩小分块推理与全上下文联合分布之间的差距，使用 wikitext-103 进行无监督自蒸馏。
AI.result: 在 LongBench 多跳推理任务上，Soft-NBCE（τ=0.1, β=0.25, 分块 2048 token）MuSiQue F1 达 0.310（对比 Vanilla NBCE 0.275、PCW 0.212、Truncated-8K 0.209），HotpotQA F1 达 0.479（对比 NBCE 0.427），NIAH-32K 检索准确率 0.909（Truncated 仅 0.659，PCW 为 0.000）；Consistency Distillation 带来 +9.5% 的 MuSiQue F1 增益；温度消融显示 τ=0.1 为最优。GovReport 摘要任务 ROUGE-L 为 0.196，略低于 Truncated 的 0.223。峰值内存 O(L²/n)，分块独立 KV 缓存。
AI.conclusion: Soft-NBCE 通过温度参数化的熵加权融合统一了硬路由和均匀平均两种极限情况，并结合一致性蒸馏在多跳推理和长程检索上取得稳定提升，同时保持有界内存开销。局限性：每步需 n+1 次前向传播导致延迟与分块数成正比；摘要类需要全局理解的场景收益有限；熵-相关性启发式缺乏理论保证；τ 和 β 为静态设定，未来工作可探索动态路由与跨任务超参数分析。

title: HASTE: Hardware-Aware Dynamic Sparse Training for Large Output Spaces
summary: Extreme multi-label classification (XMC) involves learning models over large output spaces with millions of labels, making the output layer a memory-compute bottleneck. While sparsity-based methods reduce arithmetic complexity, they often fail to yield proportional speedups due to irregular memory access, poor hardware utilization, or reliance on auxiliary architectural components in long-tailed regimes. We introduce group-shared fixed fan-in sparsity, a semi-structured output-layer design in which semantically related labels share a sparse input pattern while retaining independent weights. This grouping introduces a task-aligned inductive bias -- encouraging related labels to share feature subsets -- while reducing index memory overhead, increasing feature reuse across labels, and enabling efficient GPU execution via custom CUDA kernels that leverage modern accelerator primitives. As an alternative to auxiliary objectives, we exploit the long-tailed structure of XMC by decomposing the output layer into a small dense head over frequent labels and a group-shared sparse tail over the remainder, providing an informative gradient pathway while preserving the memory benefits of sparsity. Through kernel-level microbenchmarking, we show that group-shared fixed fan-in translates arithmetic reductions into practical wall-clock gains, achieving up to $4.4\times$ speedup in the forward pass and up to $25\times$ speedup in backward passes over standard fixed fan-in sparsity, while operating within a few percent of a FLOPs-matched dense bottleneck. Across large-scale XMC benchmarks, our approach matches or improves precision@k over prior sparse baselines, while narrowing the performance gap to dense.

AI.tldr: HASTE提出了一种面向极端多标签分类（XMC）的硬件感知动态稀疏训练框架，通过"组共享固定fan-in稀疏"设计——将语义相关的标签分组共享相同的稀疏输入特征模式，保留独立权重——实现了比标准固定fan-in稀疏（SPARtex）前向4.4×、反向25×的GPU加速，同时在百万至千万级标签基准上匹配或超越现有稀疏方法，并显著缩小与密集模型的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 极端多标签分类的输出层是内存-计算瓶颈：标准固定fan-in稀疏虽然降低了算术复杂度，但因每标签独立随机访存导致非合并内存访问，硬件利用率低且受限于内存墙；同时长尾分布下稀疏连接对编码器提供弱梯度信号，现有方案依赖不稳定的辅助目标。需要在结构化稀疏（高效但表达力受限）与非结构化稀疏（灵活但硬件不友好）之间找到平衡，并解决长尾训练的稳定性问题。
AI.method: 核心方法是组共享固定fan-in稀疏（Group-Shared Fixed Fan-in Sparsity）：1）将语义相关标签分组（G个标签一组），每组共享同一随机选取的fan-in索引集I_k（大小F），但保持各标签独立权重；2）通过离线计算标签嵌入（正样本实例表示的平均+归一化）并采用粗粒度球面K-means+贪心近邻的两阶段算法形成语义组；3）设计自定义CUDA核——利用"gather-once and dense MMA"模式，每组内做密集GEMM以利用Tensor Core，反向使用Split-K并行化标签维规约；4）提出头-尾分解策略：将高频标签（2-5%）用小型密集层处理，尾部标签用组共享稀疏层处理，共享编码器但用独立轻量投影；5）动态稀疏训练采用交替最小化（参数拟合阶段+周期性rewiring阶段）。索引存储量从LF降至(L/G)F，相对标准固定fan-in减少G倍。
AI.result: 在A100 GPU上：核级微基准测试显示组共享固定fan-in相比标准固定fan-in前向加速达4.4×，反向加速达25×，且接近FLOPs匹配的密集瓶颈基线。在AmazonTitles-670K（sparsity 83%）上P@1=43.0，超过SPARtex（42.6）、block sparse（39.4），峰值内存3.2 GiB（SPARtex为5.0 GiB），epoch时间1:46（SPARtex为4:44）。在Amazon-3M上P@1=52.5（92%稀疏度），超过SPARtex的50.2。在LF-Paper2Keywords-8.6M上P@1=47.5，PSP@1=6.7，均优于SPARtex和量化基线ELMO。消融实验证实：语义分组（48.1 P@1）优于随机分组（46.3）和频率分组（46.7）；头-尾分解带来+1.3 P@1提升且改善尾部PSP；组大小G=16最优，G增大时精度略降但内核效率提升。输出层在SPARtex中占训练步85%时间，在HASTE中降至21%。
AI.conclusion: HASTE成功地将稀疏性的算术节省转化为实际的GPU墙钟加速，通过结构化特征共享和头-尾分解在保持内存效率的同时大幅改善了尾部标签性能，显著优于先前的稀疏训练方法。Tensor Core友好的设计为未来结合结构化稀疏与低精度训练（量化）提供了自然基础，有望在极大规模输出空间中进一步提升训练效率。

title: STARFISH: faST Accuracy Recovery in pruned networks From Internal State Healing
summary: Pruning is a process designed to reduce the number of weights in a large neural network. This can substantially speed up inference but might cause a considerable reduction in the model's accuracy, and thus it is usually followed by a healing process that regains some of the lost accuracy. In this paper, we propose a new healing method, STARFISH, that can recover (most of) the accuracy of any pruned network efficiently. The main idea of STARFISH is to optimize the pruned network to align with the original network's internal state representations using a tiny calibration set of unlabeled examples. For the common case of removing 50% of the weights, STARFISH healing improves the recovered accuracy by up to 22% over the state-of-the-art methods on ViT-based networks. Its advantage is even more pronounced under aggressive pruning. For example, after eliminating 75% of the weights in a DeiT-B network for ImageNet, STARFISH uses only 0.4% of the number of training images as a calibration set and recovers 82% of the original dense accuracy, whereas competing recovery techniques reach only 40% of the dense model accuracy.

AI.tldr: STARFISH是一种高效的剪枝后精度恢复方法，通过在小规模无标签校准集上对齐剪枝网络与原始密集网络的中间表示（余弦相似度），在多种稀疏度、剪枝模式和架构下显著优于现有恢复方法，尤其在高稀疏度（如0.8-0.85）场景下优势更明显。
AI.motivation: 神经网络剪枝可大幅加速推理，但会显著降低精度，且现有恢复方法（如重训练、基于曲率的方法、SNOWS、CORP）通常计算昂贵、需要训练集、或仅适用于特定剪枝模式。需要一种通用、高效且仅需极小无标签校准集的恢复方法。
AI.method: STARFISH通过两步流程实现：（1）在小规模无标签校准集上对密集模型进行前向传播，缓存每个block的中间表示作为目标；（2）仅更新剪枝后保留的权重，使剪枝模型的每个block的中间表示与密集模型的对应表示对齐。对齐损失为各block余弦相似度的平均值（公式1）。该方法与剪枝方法、稀疏度模式、剪枝范围和架构无关。理论上证明了输出logit的KL散度可由分类头输入表示的距离上界控制。
AI.result: 在半稀疏度（0.5）设置下，STARFISH在ViT架构上比CORP最多提升31.54个百分点的精度保留率；在高稀疏度（0.75-0.85）下优势更显著，例如DeiT-B在0.75稀疏度下恢复82%密集精度（CORP仅40%），DeiT3-H在0.85稀疏度下恢复92.08%密集精度。在0.5稀疏度下，针对不同DeiT模型最高达到99.84%的密集精度保留。相较于CE、KL等基于输出的目标，余弦对齐在高稀疏度下表现更优（如0.8稀疏度DeiT-B上提升13-16个百分点）。计算成本与CORP相当，使用500-9000个校准样本（≤0.7%训练集），在A10 GPU上16分钟可完成DeiT3-H恢复。
AI.conclusion: STARFISH提出将剪枝后恢复视为内部状态"治愈"，通过中间表示对齐实现高效恢复。该方法模块化、通用性强，在不同稀疏度、剪枝模式（非结构化、结构化、2:4半结构化）、范围和架构上一致优于现有方法。未来方向包括：自适应block加权、扩展至多模态和语言模型、在训练中引入稀疏感知的表示对齐目标以产生"易恢复"的密集模型。

title: ASE-26: a curriculum for agentic software engineering as a discipline
comment: 12 pages, 20 references. Companion paper to the ASE-26 curriculum deposited on Zenodo at doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20468021 . Part 1 of a planned series of two pre-prints on the curriculum and its conceptual core
summary: The work of a professional software engineer has begun to consist, increasingly, of directing agents rather than writing code, and the empirical evidence for the shift is now several years deep. Anthropic's Economic Index puts automation at 79 per cent of Claude Code interactions [2]; Handa and colleagues at Anthropic find AI exposure for Computer Programmer tasks at approximately 75 per cent of the role's distinct activities [3]; Brynjolfsson and colleagues at Stanford's Digital Economy Lab report a 13 per cent relative decline in employment for workers aged 22 to 25 in occupations most exposed to AI [4]. The shift is also unfinished, and the academic literature on agentic software engineering converges on the finding that the missing capability is not better models but structured practitioner discipline. This paper presents ASE-26, a comprehensive undergraduate curriculum for agentic software engineering as a discipline, deposited as a citable reference on Zenodo under CC BY-ND 4.0 [12]. The paper sets out the discipline framing the curriculum rests on, the conceptual contributions it makes (most importantly, the evolutionary spiral as the operational form of the co-evolution of intent and build), the twenty-one-module structure that organises the discipline for teaching, the pedagogical commitments that follow from grading work co-produced with an agent, what graduates leave with, and how the discipline as taught is designed to outlast the specific capabilities of today's models. The position the paper takes is that the practitioner skills the industry currently lacks are precisely the skills the discipline names, and that structured undergraduate curricula in agentic software engineering are the principal mechanism by which the gap closes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ASE-26 —— 一套面向智能体软件工程（agentic software engineering）的本科课程体系，已以 CC BY-ND 4.0 协议在 Zenodo 存档并可引用，涵盖 21 个教学模块，核心主张是：当下面向 AI 智能体的软件工程实践能力缺口应通过结构化学科训练而非更强的模型来弥合。
AI.motivation: 软件工程师的工作正从"编写代码"转向"指挥智能体"，但现有经验证据（如 Anthropic Economic Index 显示 Claude Code 交互自动化率达 79%，斯坦福数字经济实验室报告 22–25 岁高 AI 暴露职业就业下降 13%）表明这一转型尚未完成；学界共识是缺口不在模型能力，而在从业者的结构化训练与学科纪律。
AI.method: 论文以"智能体软件工程作为一门学科"为框架，提出三大概念贡献（其中最重要的是"演化螺旋"——意图与构建协同演化的操作形式），设计 21 模块课程结构，并阐述与智能体协作产出的评估（grading）所对应的教学承诺，最终目标是让该学科训练超越当下模型的具体能力而保持长期有效性。
AI.result: 产出了一份可在 Zenodo 上引用的完整本科课程参考 ASE-26，包含学科定位、核心概念、模块化教学组织、毕业能力目标及面向未来模型迭代的可持续设计。
AI.conclusion: 工业界当前所缺的从业者技能，恰好正是该学科所命名的内容；结构化的本科课程是缩小该能力缺口的主要机制。

title: When Data Is Scarce: Scaling Sparse Language Models with Repeated Training
summary: Scaling laws for dense LLMs under infinite data are well explored, but how sparsity interacts with limited data is not. In this work, we study sparse training in data-constrained regimes where limited unique tokens require multi-epoch training. Our experiments span models up to 1.92B parameters in the fitting set, sparsity up to 93.75%, unique data budgets up to 2.6B tokens, and total training tokens up to 41.6B over 16 epochs; we further validate extrapolation on held-out dense-equivalent models up to 7.68B parameters. We find that: 1. Sparse scaling in data-limited settings: We introduce a scaling law that models loss as a function of active parameters, unique tokens, data repetition, and sparsity, accurately predicting performance across compute and data budgets. 2. Delayed data saturation: sparse training postpones diminishing returns from repeated data, making multi-epoch training more effective. 3. Resource trade-offs: With fixed data, loss-optimal sparsity is moderate ~ 50%, while compute-optimal sparsity is higher and grows with data scale. Overall, sparsity is not just a tool for efficiency, but a mechanism for improving scaling trade-offs under data scarcity. Our code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文研究了数据受限场景下稀疏训练LLM的扩展规律,发现稀疏性不仅能提升效率,还能改善数据稀缺时的缩放权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有密集LLM在无限数据下的缩放定律已较为成熟,但稀疏训练与有限数据(特别是需要多epoch训练的场景)之间的相互作用尚不清楚。核心动机是理解在数据受限的预训练环境中,稀疏性如何影响模型性能与扩展行为。
AI.method: 实验方法涵盖拟合集模型达1.92B参数、稀疏度最高93.75%、唯一数据预算达2.6B tokens、总训练tokens达41.6B(跨16个epoch),并在最高7.68B参数的密集等价模型上进行外推验证。提出一种新的扩展律,将损失建模为活跃参数、唯一tokens、数据重复次数和稀疏度的函数。
AI.result: 三项主要发现:1) 提出了一个能跨计算与数据预算准确预测性能的稀疏扩展律;2) 稀疏训练延迟了重复数据带来的收益递减,使多epoch训练更有效;3) 固定数据下损失最优稀疏度约50%,而计算最优稀疏度更高并随数据规模增长。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏性不仅是效率工具,更是改善数据稀缺下缩放权衡的机制,这一发现为数据受限场景下设计更优的稀疏LLM训练方案提供了理论指导。

title: AI From the Margins (AIM): Rethinking Participatory AI Design Through the Lived Experience of Minoritized Communities
comment: Under review at the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026)
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) can reproduce and amplify the structural inequities faced by minoritized communities. Participatory AI has been proposed as a response, but participation typically starts after problem definitions and success criteria have been set, leaving limited room for minoritized communities to reshape what an AI system is for. We propose AI From the Margins (AIM): a methodological stance that articulates the conditions under which lived experiences of minoritized communities can be elicited, centered, and carried forward to inform participatory AI design. AIM is not a fixed protocol; it articulates a set of preconditions that can be enacted through different techniques in different settings. We applied AIM in a Dutch healthcare context in eight sessions with 13 women and non-binary people of color and five municipal policy workers, namely through (1) narrative elicitation using the Biographic Narrative Interpretive Method (BNIM); (2) co-constructed rule-making; (3) participants' determination of whether, where, and how AI should be involved; and (4) translating lived experience into AI policy through dialogue with policymakers. In their reflections on the sessions, participants described the engagement as substantive and called for its continuation, demonstrating how preparatory orientation fundamentally grounded in lived experience shapes what participatory AI design is for.

AI.tldr: AIM（AI From the Margins）是一种方法论立场（非固定协议），由七项先决条件构成，旨在将边缘化群体的生活经验作为参与式AI设计的前置基础。该框架在荷兰医疗场景中通过八次"生活经验会话"（含BNIM叙事引出、共建规则、AI介入判断、政策对话）进行应用与验证，强调预备阶段先于技术框架定型。
AI.motivation: 现有参与式AI实践中，参与通常发生在问题定义与成功标准已被设定之后，边缘化群体难以重塑"AI系统为何而存在"，参与沦为表演性或工具性操作；亟需一种在技术框架建立之前、以边缘化立场认识论为起点的方法论，纠正AI对结构性不平等的再生产。
AI.method: 提出AIM的七项先决条件：互惠、去殖民化立场、边缘化立场中心化、方法灵活性、拒绝权的结构性可及性、多维度可达性、共同所有权。这些先决条件通过四项会话落地：（1）基于BNIM的SQUIN叙事引出与苏格拉底式对话；（2）从个体叙事转向共建规则；（3）引入Rich Picture，让参与者决定AI是否、应在何处、如何介入（含拒绝AI本身的合法选项）；（4）邀请市政政策工作者对话，将生活经验转化为政策参考。应用对象为13位有色人种女性/非二元者及5位荷兰地方政策工作者，分两组平行进行，每组四次会话，每周一次。
AI.result: 参与者将参与描述为实质性（substantive）并呼吁延续；七项先决条件呈相互构成关系（缺一则其他无法真正实现），不可作为独立平行原则处理；Session 2产出了参与者集体撰写并要求获取副本与付诸实施的规则；Session 3中参与者明确主张"应先彻底调查生活经验，再启动AI设计"；Session 4虽未产出具体政策指南，但使制度方与经验方之间的认识不对称（信息与权力落差）变得可见，政策工作者对参与者AI技术知识有限的挫败感本身即揭示了治理框架的方法论盲点；参与者从共享经验逐步走向集体能动性，演变为对制度方的问责政治。
AI.conclusion: AIM通过将生活经验定位为预备基础而非补充输入，弥合了包容性AI理论承诺与有意义参与实践条件之间的鸿沟。关键洞见在于：可迁移的是先决条件而非具体技术；认识论排序（epistemic sequencing）是政治性问题；治理负担应落在政策制定者身上而非参与者；揭示制度—经验之间的不对称本身即为合法的治理成果。AIM需在不同社会技术场景中进一步验证，并作为反思性框架持续迭代。

title: Physics-Informed Deep Learning for Entropy Prediction in Heterogeneous Systems: Thermodynamic and Information-Theoretic Case Studies
summary: Entropy production governs irreversibility and uncertainty in both physical and information-theoretic systems. While Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) successfully solve differential equations, current architectures remain inherently domain-specific. The extraction of domain-invariant entropy representations across fundamentally different physical laws remains unexplored. This paper introduces a unified Physics-Informed Deep Learning (PIDL) framework that simultaneously enforces differential equation residuals and information-theoretic bounds within a single neural architecture. We demonstrate this framework via two canonical studies: (i) a thermodynamic continuous stirred-tank reactor (CSTR) model solving governing ODEs, where a Softplus constraint strictly enforces the Second Law of Thermodynamics; and (ii) an information-theoretic financial market model solving the inverse Fokker-Planck PDE to infer latent drift and diffusion coefficients, guaranteeing diffusion positivity via a Softplus constraint while naturally inducing Shannon entropy. Three model variants are evaluated: two domain-specific baselines and one shared-encoder architecture. The PIDL framework guarantees absolute thermodynamic admissibility with zero Second-Law violations and exhibits exceptional data efficiency, retaining >90% predictive accuracy using merely 30% of available training data. Furthermore, a post-hoc Ruppeiner Riemannian geometric analysis of the learned entropy surface successfully identifies thermodynamic phase instabilities. This methodology provides a robust, domain-agnostic architecture for physics-constrained entropy modeling, advancing applications in sustainable process design and quantitative financial risk assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的物理信息深度学习（PIDL）框架，通过Softplus硬约束强制热力学第二定律，在CSTR热力学和信息论金融两个跨域案例中验证了熵预测的准确性、数据效率和共享表示学习能力。
AI.motivation: 现有PINN架构本质上是领域特定的，从根本上不同的物理定律中提取领域不变的熵表示尚未被探索。需要一个统一框架同时强制微分方程残差和信息论界限。
AI.method: 提出PIDL框架包含三个模型变体：两个领域特定基线和一个共享编码器架构。使用Softplus激活作为硬架构约束强制σ≥0（第二定律）和扩散系数正定性。损失函数包含数据保真度、ODE/PDE残差、初始条件、归一化约束。共享编码器使用梯度投影机制防止冲突梯度。后验应用Ruppeiner黎曼几何分析学习到的熵曲面。
AI.result: CSTR案例中浓度MAPE 0.42%，温度0.18%，熵产生率1.87%，软约束变体出现2.3%第二定律违反。金融Fokker-Planck逆问题Shannon熵MSE=3.2×10⁻³。共享编码器用19%更少参数达到略优性能。仅用30%训练数据保留>90%预测精度。Ruppeiner曲率正确识别热失控不稳定区域（负曲率）和熄灭分支稳定区（正曲率）。
AI.conclusion: PIDL框架实现了热力学可接受性保证（零第二定律违反）、跨异质物理域的可学习域不变熵表示，以及通过Ruppeiner几何对热力学不稳定性的可解释检测。软惩罚与硬架构约束的对比表明后者对安全关键工程应用具有必要性。

title: CA-BED: Conversation-Aware Bayesian Experimental Design
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at static reasoning tasks, yet their performance often degrades in interactive scenarios where information must be actively acquired through questioning. A key challenge lies in selecting questions that reduce uncertainty while incorporating responses that may be ambiguous or only partially informative. To address this, we propose Conversation-Aware Bayesian Experimental Design (CA-BED), an inference-time probabilistic dialog planning framework that integrates Bayesian Experimental Design with LLM-based likelihood estimation to optimize question selection over multiple conversational turns. CA-BED maintains a belief distribution over hypotheses, anticipates possible answers, and propagates expected information gain through a simulated conversation tree. Across two structured entity-deduction benchmarks, CA-BED yields an average 21.8% improvement in success rates over direct prompting, with comparable gains relative to alternative information-seeking methods. It achieves these gains with an average increase of only 1.8 conversational turns compared to direct prompting.

AI.tldr: CA-BED 是一个推理时的概率对话规划框架，将贝叶斯实验设计（BED）与基于 LLM 的似然估计相结合，通过维护假设上的信念分布、预测可能答案并通过模拟对话树传播预期信息增益，来优化多轮对话中的问题选择。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在静态推理任务中表现出色，但在需要主动通过提问获取信息的交互式场景中性能下降。现有方法（如 Uncertainty of Thoughts）依赖二元硬划分，在面对模糊或部分信息化的回答时容易过早消除正确假设，导致鲁棒性不足。需要一种原则性的方法来表示分级证据并在对话中传播不确定性。
AI.method: 1) 概率模型：维护假设集 H 上的后验信念分布 B_k(h_i) = P(h_i|E_{1:k})；2) 对话树模型：由 QuestionNode 和 EvidenceNode 交替构成；3) 奖励函数 R(v) 递归定义：QuestionNode 取期望值，EvidenceNode 取最大值，终端节点为 H(B_0)-H(B_v) 的信息增益；4) 树构建：LLM 生成 M_q 个候选问题，通过文本提取似然 P(E|h_i) 并使用置信度加权平滑（ε 参数）拉向均匀基线；5) 信念更新采用朴素贝叶斯假设；6) 预读 D_sim 步并通过似然缓存缓解 O((M_q·K)^D_sim) 的指数复杂度。提出变体 CA-BED + Answer Planning 允许多选题代替二元问题。
AI.result: 在 Detective Cases 和 20 Questions 两个基准上：CA-BED 相比直接提示平均提升 21.8% 成功率；Detective Cases 上从 27.6% 提升至 46.0%；20 Questions 上从 57.7% 提升至 82.9%，加入答案规划后达 89.2%。Top-3 准确率显著优于 UoT（90.0% vs 29.0% in Detective Cases）。代价是对话轮数平均仅增加 1.8 轮。在 GPT-5.4-nano 和 Gemini-3.1-flash-lite 替代 Questioner 时仍保持鲁棒性。但答案规划在开放域（Detective Cases）上因候选答案互斥性差而退化（46.0%→38.0%），且推理时计算开销较大。
AI.conclusion: CA-BED 证明概率对话规划是结构化信息获取场景中交互式推理的有前景方向。软概率信念更新结合贝叶斯问题选择在多个 LLM 上均带来稳定增益，尤其对较弱模型帮助显著，但需权衡推理时计算成本与对话可解释性（外部推理器对 CA-BED 转录的 PD-SR 较低）。未来需扩展至开放域对话、跨域验证、人类在环评估，并提升计算效率。

title: Low-Resource Safety Failures Are Action Failures, Not Representation Failures
summary: Safety alignment learned in high-resource languages transfers poorly to low-resource languages. Models refuse harmful prompts in English but fail to refuse when the same prompts are translated into Swahili or Burmese. Adaptive steering methods like AdaSteer and CAST inherit this failure cross-lingually. We diagnose where transfer breaks down. Across Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma-2-9B, and Llama-3.1-8B on 23 languages, the harmfulness direction extracted from high-resource activations linearly separates harmful from harmless low-resource prompts nearly as well as high-resource ones. The relevant representation is present. Yet harmful refusal drops from 87.9% to 43.9%. The model fails to convert the representation into refusal. What fails to transfer is calibration of the safety decision, not the underlying representation. We exploit this by recalibrating, rather than retraining, a high-resource gate: a low-rank logistic readout with its decision threshold reset using as few as 1 to 4 target-language examples per class. The gate routes between refusal steering and harmfulness-direction ablation, substantially raising mean refusal selectivity ($\Delta$ = harmful $-$ harmless refusal) from 33.6 for the strongest adapted baseline to 54.5 while preserving MMLU utility. These results suggest that some low-resource safety failures can be repaired by recalibrating existing representations rather than learning new ones. Our code is released: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文诊断了大语言模型在低资源语言上安全对齐失效的根本原因：不是缺乏对"有害性"（harmfulness）的内部表征，而是模型未能将该表征转化为拒绝决策——属于"动作失败"而非"表征失败"。据此提出一种仅需1–4个目标语言样本即可重新校准决策阈值的少样本潜在门控（few-shot latent gate）方法，在6种低资源语言上显著提升选择性拒绝率（Δ从33.6提升至54.5），且不损害MMLU通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在英语等高资源语言上能够拒绝有害请求，但在斯瓦希里语、缅甸语等低资源语言的等价请求上却常常顺从执行。以往工作（如AdaSteer、CAST）多在行为层面进行修补（如迁移英语安全信号），但未回答根本问题：模型在低资源语言中究竟是因为**没有形成对"有害"的语义表征**，还是**已经表征但未能路由到拒绝行为**？这两种失败模式在外部行为上无法区分，却需要截然不同的修复方案：前者需重新学习表征，后者仅需重新校准决策阈值。
AI.method:
1. **数据集**：将PolyRefuse扩展至23种语言（10种HRL、7种MRL、6种LRL，如斯瓦希里语、阿姆哈拉语、缅甸语、高棉语、僧伽罗语、约鲁巴语）。
2. **模型**：Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Gemma-2-9B-it、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct；以GPT-4o-mini作为拒绝裁判（与人类标注者皮尔逊相关系数0.79）。
3. **诊断工具**：使用对比均值法（contrastive mean difference）从残差流激活中提取一维"有害性方向"v_HRL；在提取层（Qwen第15层、Gemma第20层、Llama第10层）通过线性可分性测试与因果消融/添加实验判断表征是否完整。
4. **干预方法**：提出**少样本潜在门控**——先从HRL池化方向构建秩-10有害性子空间，再用一个低秩逻辑回归读出器（logistic readout）配合目标语言1–4个示例/类重置决策阈值τ。门控将有害样本路由到"拒绝方向添加"，无害样本路由到"有害性方向消融"。
5. **基线对比**：CAST、AdaSteer、OMNIGuard/MultiGuard；评估在PolyRefuse、MultiJail、IndoSafety上进行，并保留Global-MMLU评估效用。
AI.result:
1. **行为差距确实存在**：平均有害拒绝率从HRL的87.9%降至LRL的43.9%（Qwen从85.6%→28.8%；Llama从83.5%→32.5%；Gemma从94.5%→70.3%），无害拒绝率全程保持低位（LRL平均9.8%），证实失败具有选择性。
2. **表征完好**：以HRL方向v_HRL在LRL激活上做投影，测试AUC在多数语言上仍高于0.85，且对v_HRL的消融可显著降低有害拒绝率——证明有害性表征不仅存在，还具有因果中介作用。
3. **失败在于量级**：LRL样本在v_HRL上的投影分数分布整体下移，未能跨越模型隐式拒绝阈值；通过增加v_HRL强度可恢复LRL拒绝，但所需λ比HRL更大。
4. **门控方法显著优于基线**：在18个模型-语言对中的17对上，HRL+32 LRL校准配置取得最佳选择性Δ，平均Δ从最强适配基线CAST的33.6提升至54.5；有害拒绝率67.2%而无辜拒绝率仅12.7%（AdaSteer无辜拒绝率高达52.8%）。
5. **泛化能力**：在MultiJail和IndoSafety等分布外基准上，Gemma门控零样本平衡准确率可达0.933/0.902；MMLU能力几乎无损。
6. **模型差异**：Qwen和Gemma可受益于零样本HRL路由；Llama需更多目标语言示例才能获得增益。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献在于将多语言安全对齐失效从"表征缺失"重新定位为"决策校准失败"，推翻了以往"低资源语言缺乏有害性理解"的假设。由此引出方法论上的实践路径：先诊断、后修复——若表征存在，则仅需少量目标语言样本进行阈值重置即可，无需重新训练或学习新方向。该工作也提示业界在评估安全时不能仅依赖行为层面的拒绝率，应辅以表征层面的可分性诊断，以避免混淆两类不同的失败机制。局限性包括：仅研究3个开源稠密模型、以Common Crawl份额作为粗粒度资源代理、需要激活访问权限（无法直接用于闭源模型API）、不替代多语言安全训练。

title: Implicit Geographic Inference in LLM Medical Triage: Language-Driven Disparities in Emergency Recommendations
comment: 7 pages, 4 tables. Code and data at this https URL
summary: We investigate whether large language models produce different medical triage recommendations for identical symptoms based solely on the language of the patient prompt. Using Gemini 3.5 Flash, we evaluate a neurological symptom profile (persistent headache, blurred vision, nausea) across six languages (English, Spanish, Chinese, Hindi, Japanese, Arabic) with 30 runs per condition (n=450 total API calls). We find that the model recommends emergency room visits at rates ranging from 0% (Japanese, Hindi) to 30% (English, Arabic), despite assigning nearly identical severity scores (7.7-8.0/10) across all languages. Adding a single sentence specifying the patient's US location increases ER recommendations by up to 76.7 percentage points for non-English prompts, while the reverse anchor (English prompt with a Tokyo location) reduces the ER rate from 30% to 6.7%. A back-translation control (Japanese to English) produces ER rates comparable to the English baseline, confirming that the disparity is not caused by translation quality but by implicit geographic inference from the input language. We release the complete dataset, experiment code, and results.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型（Gemini 3.5 Flash）是否仅根据患者提示语言的不同，而对相同症状产生不同的医疗分诊建议。研究发现模型将语言作为地理位置的隐式代理，进而应用该地区特有的医疗规范（如日本采用"诊所优先"路径，而美国采用防御性医疗），导致英语提示30%推荐急诊，而日语和印地语提示为0%。通过位置锚定和回译控制实验，验证了这一机制，并提出了解耦语言与地理位置的缓解方案。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地被部署在医疗辅助应用中（如分诊助手、症状检查器）。一个关键假设是模型的临床建议应仅由医学内容驱动，而非表层特征如语言。然而，这一假设尚未得到直接验证。如果模型将语言误用作地理位置的代理变量，则会对移民、侨民、游客和多语种用户产生严重的公平性后果。
AI.method: 使用Gemini 3.5 Flash（temperature=0.3），针对一个神经症状档案（38岁患者持续头痛、视力模糊、晨吐、视觉障碍）进行测试。1）基线实验：6种语言（英、西、中、印地、日、阿拉伯）人工撰写的等价提示，每种30次运行；2）US位置锚定：在非英语提示中追加"假设患者位于美国"；3）反向锚定：英语提示+东京/孟买位置；4）回译控制：日语提示回译为英语后再分诊。系统提示固定为英语，输出结构化JSON。总计约450次API调用，使用Wilson得分95%置信区间。
AI.result: 基线ER推荐率：英语和阿拉伯30%，中文20%，西班牙13.3%，印地语和日语0%。但严重程度评分在所有语言中几乎相同（7.7-8.0/10）。添加US位置锚定后，非英语语言的ER推荐率提升46.7-76.7个百分点（中文达96.7%），英语仅提升10pp（已隐含US假设）。反向锚定：英语+东京ER率降至6.7%，英语+孟买降至0%。日语回译至英语后ER率为36.7%，与英语基线置信区间重叠，确认理解无差异。模型推理字段中未提及地理位置，地理推断完全隐式。
AI.conclusion: LLM通过"语言→推断国家→地区医疗规范→建议行动"的推理链产生系统性的医疗分诊差异。这种行为对单语用户在该国境内是合理的，但对语言与所在地不匹配的用户（移民、外籍人士、游客、多语种用户）会造成伤害。缓解方案是在系统提示中显式锚定患者地理位置，将语言与地理位置解耦——语言应决定"如何沟通"而非"建议什么"。代码、数据和结果已开源。

title: DiscourseFlip: An Oblique Discourse-Level Opinion Manipulation Attack against Black-box Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are widely deployed and increasingly influential, but their reliance on external corpora exposes new security risks from poisoned retrieval content. Existing RAG attacks are largely focusing on individual queries or narrow topic-local query sets, which limits their practical reach and offers limited camouflage in real-world settings. In this paper, we introduce discourse-level opinion manipulation, a new threat model in which coordinated influence across a semantic query network induces opinion shifts over a holistic, multi-topic query space. We formalize this threat in a black-box setting and propose DiscourseFlip, an agentic, graph-guided attack that dynamically allocates a limited poisoning budget to maximize discourse-level opinion deviation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiscourseFlip consistently induces targeted opinion shifts across the contextualized query network and significantly outperforms existing baselines in terms of coverage and effectiveness. User studies further confirm that DiscourseFlip is effective while remaining well camouflaged from user detection. Moreover, systematic analyses show that existing mitigation strategies are ineffective against discourse-level manipulation, underscoring the urgent need for more robust and adaptive defenses to address discourse-level vulnerabilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种针对黑盒检索增强生成（RAG）系统的新型攻击范式——话语级意见操控（discourse-level opinion manipulation），并设计了名为DiscourseFlip的攻击框架。该攻击通过在语义查询网络（而非单一查询或单一主题）上协调投毒内容，实现对根主题的整体性意见偏移，同时保持高隐蔽性，并使现有防御机制失效。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG投毒攻击主要针对单一查询或主题局部查询集，存在以下局限：（1）影响范围有限，局限于与目标主题直接相关的查询；（2）隐蔽性低，当目标主题受到审查时容易被隔离和审计；（3）投毒成本高。真实场景中，根主题周围的查询跨越多个相关主题和上下文关联，攻击者应能通过操控语义网络中的间接邻居节点，实现对根主题的系统性意见影响，同时绕过针对敏感主题的直接保护机制。
AI.method:
DiscourseFlip采用基于图引导的智能体优化框架，包含两大核心设计：

1. **层次化攻击面组织**：构建融合统计层（基于检索重叠的tf-idf向量建模检索邻近性）和知识层（利用LLM提取因果依赖与逻辑蕴含）的混合语义图G，通过PageRank量化节点结构中心性，再采用粗到细策略（Leiden算法+k-means聚类）将图分解为原子语义单元（ASU）。

2. **图引导的智能体过程优化**：将攻击形式化为预算约束下的最大覆盖问题，通过三阶段"稳定-扩展-巩固"循环进行优化：
   - **稳定阶段**：利用Rewrite/Inject/Compress三个操作符，基于诊断反馈（态度对齐分数ρ_succ、核心覆盖率σ_core、拒绝次数η_ref）对文档进行全局重写、局部注入和压缩；
   - **扩展阶段**：通过前瞻评估机制尝试合并邻接ASU，仅在核心覆盖不下降时接受扩展；
   - **巩固阶段**：在SEO预算T₂约束下进行检索导向的最小重写以提升检索可见性。

约束条件包括文档数量M、生成预算T₁（≤500 tokens）和SEO预算T₂（≤100 tokens）。整个过程无需访问检索器或LLM的内部参数。
AI.result:
**主要攻击效果（RQ1）**：在两种LLM（Llama3.1、Qwen3）和三种检索器（BGE、Qwen-Embedding、DPR）配置下，DiscourseFlip在所有指标上均显著优于PoisonedRAG、Topic-FlipRAG和Unic-RAG基线。例如在BGE+Llama3.1的PRO方向上，RASR达44.48%（vs最强基线20.35%），COV达27.09%（vs 8.97%），DLI达94.81%。在强检索器（Qwen-Embedding）下基线RASR接近零，而DiscourseFlip仍能保持13-16%的成功率。

**用户研究（RQ2）**：81名大学生参与的随机对照实验显示，51.85%的用户意见向攻击者目标方向偏移（平均偏移约23%），但超过85%的用户未察觉被操控或将其归因于其他无关实体，验证了高隐蔽性。

**防御评估（RQ3）**：系统评估了5类防御表面（查询改写、随机掩码、困惑度过滤、GRADA重排序、Top-k中性化、主题导向意见保护），结果显示：（1）查询改写对DiscourseFlip效果有限；（2）随机掩码几乎不影响其性能（基于自然语义而非触发词）；（3）困惑度过滤因投毒文档与正常文档分布重叠而失效；（4）主题导向保护仅能保留DiscourseFlip约60%的覆盖率和45%的ASV，因大量被操控查询处于保护范围之外。

**消融实验**：验证了混合图（统计层+知识层）、两阶段分区策略（Leiden+k-means）、节点过滤和SEO操作符的必要性。超参数分析表明M=10为效果与隐蔽性的最佳平衡点。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了RAG系统面临的一个关键且被低估的漏洞：在现实黑盒设置下，攻击者可通过协调语义查询网络上的投毒内容诱导整体性立场偏移，同时保持高隐蔽性。DiscourseFlip作为一种智能体图引导优化框架，能在有限投毒预算下最大化话语级意见偏差。实验证明其在覆盖率和意见偏移强度上显著优于现有基线，用户研究证实其能引发可衡量的用户意见变化但几乎不可被察觉。系统性的缓解分析表明，无论是通用RAG防御还是针对意见的专项保护，都无法可靠抵御话语级操控，迫切需要构建能够在检索、证据一致性和生成行为上联合推理的、自适应的、面向语义邻域扩展的系统级防御体系。

title: Fine-Tuning Diffusion Models for Molecular Generation via Reinforcement Learning and Fast Sampling
summary: Generating molecules that simultaneously satisfy drug-like properties and conform to the 3D structure of a target protein is a core challenge in structure-based drug design (SBDD). Existing generative approaches, however, often rely on costly post-hoc processing during Sampling or require carefully curated datasets during training, yet still achieve modest gains. These limitations are especially pronounced in multi-objective settings, where balancing conflicting criteria remains a core challenge. To address these challenges, We propose FTDiff, a reinforcement learning fine-tuning framework tailored for diffusion-based molecular generation under structural constraints. To ensure stable and sample-efficient optimization, FTDiff adopts a group relative policy optimization (GRPO) style strategy. Furthermore, FTDiff builds upon a time-free pretrained diffusion model and incorporates a fast sampling mechanism that reduces the number of denoising steps, significantly accelerating both training and inference while maintaining generation quality. By optimizing a fixed threshold-aware reward, FTDiff effectively guides the model to produce valid, diverse, and high- quality molecules that balance multiple drug design objectives. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that FTDiff consistently outperforms prior methods, without requiring expensive post-hoc optimization or intricate data engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FTDiff，一个用于基于结构的药物设计（SBDD）中扩散模型分子生成的强化学习微调框架。该方法结合了GRPO风格的策略优化、免时间步的快速采样机制以及阈值感知奖励函数，实现了在多目标药物设计场景下高效、稳定地生成满足类药性、合成可行性和高结合亲和力的3D分子。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的3D分子生成方法在训练目标上仅限于从噪声输入重建分子，缺乏对药理学相关属性的显式优化。现有改进方案（如采样时外部引导或DPO微调）面临计算成本高、需要精心构建偏好数据集、以及在多目标冲突场景中增益有限等问题。因此，亟需一种无需昂贵后处理或复杂数据工程的、高效稳定的多目标分子优化框架。
AI.method: FTDiff包含三大核心组件：(1) **GRPO风格策略优化**：将去噪过程建模为多步决策过程，利用组内奖励统计量估计优势函数，无需学习价值函数，并设计双头裁剪损失（Double Head Clipped Loss, L_DHC）分别对坐标和原子类型两种模态的重要性比进行裁剪优化，还提出L_DHC_rectified变体对各坐标维度独立计算裁剪损失；(2) **免时间步快速采样**：提出无显式时间步调度的自适应插值策略，插值系数由预测清洁样本与当前噪声状态间的距离（坐标用L2距离、原子类型用KL散度）动态决定，实现仅需10步的高质量采样（相比标准1000步DDPM大幅加速）；(3) **阈值感知奖励函数**：对各归一化属性分数应用以阈值θ_i为中心的sigmoid变换后再加权求和，避免对单一目标的过度优化，更有效地平衡结合亲和力、QED和SA等多目标。
AI.result: 在CrossDocked2020基准上的实验表明，FTDiff在多目标和单目标设置下均优于现有方法。多目标设置下，平均Vina Score达-7.18，Vina Min达-8.48，Vina Dock达-9.44，高亲和力率78.6%（中位数88.9%），QED为0.56，SA为0.61，优于包括Pocket2Mol、TargetDiff、DecompDiff、IPDiff、DecompOpt、TAGMol、ALIDiff等基线。在最严格三重约束（Vina<-8, QED>0.5, SA>0.5）下通过率达22.3%，超出次优方法8.2个百分点。单目标设置下超越KGDiff。消融实验验证了L_DHC_rectified相比vanilla损失的优越性，以及阈值感知奖励相比线性加权奖励的平衡优势。连接性（无断键）达95.8%。
AI.conclusion: FTDiff通过将GRPO风格强化学习、免时间步快速采样和阈值感知奖励三者有机结合，有效解决了扩散模型分子生成在多目标优化中面临的训练不稳定、采样效率低和目标冲突等核心问题。实验证明其能以显著加速的推理速度（10步 vs 1000步）生成多样、有效且高亲和力的药物分子。未来方向包括引入动态加权策略以更好地探索多目标的Pareto前沿。

title: Hybrid Imbalanced Regression Through Unified Data-Level and Algorithm-Level Balancing
comment: 52 pages, 20 figures, accepted at Expert Systems with Applications
summary: Imbalanced learning is a critical challenge in machine learning, where underrepresented target values can bias models and degrade prediction performance on rare but important cases. Although extensively studied in classification, imbalanced regression remains relatively underexplored. Existing methods mainly focus on either data-level balancing, which may introduce noise and overfitting, or algorithm-level balancing, which often struggles with highly complex target distributions. To address these limitations, we propose a unified hybrid framework that integrates both data- and algorithm-level balancing strategies into a regressor-agnostic pipeline. The proposed framework consists of five stages: (1) adaptive bin partitioning to dynamically segment the target space based on local linear coherence; (2) target-conditioned representation learning using a Conditional Variational Autoencoder; (3) multistage data-level balancing through feature-space clustering and oversampling of minority clusters; (4) algorithm-level balancing using a novel Latent-Density Weighted Loss (LDWL) to emphasize rare samples in latent and target spaces; and (5) attention-based gated fusion for final regression. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves predictive performance compared to standalone regressors and existing imbalanced regression approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的五阶段混合框架，将数据级（过采样）和算法级（损失重加权）平衡策略整合到回归器无关的流水线中，用于解决不平衡回归问题。该框架在16个基准数据集上验证，相比独立策略和标准回归器均取得一致性能提升。
AI.motivation: 不平衡回归中，目标值在连续空间分布不均，导致标准模型偏向多数区域而在罕见但重要的少数区域表现不佳。现有方法要么仅采用数据级方法（易引入噪声和过拟合），要么仅采用算法级方法（难以处理复杂分布），二者的互补优势在回归任务中尚未被真正融合利用。本文旨在填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 框架包含五个阶段：（1）基于局部R²一致性得分的自适应目标空间分箱划分；（2）以目标变量为条件的条件变分自编码器（CVAE）进行目标感知表示学习；（3）多阶段数据级平衡：先在各分箱内用DBSCAN聚类识别少数簇，再采用改进的SMOGN在潜在空间中进行局部过采样；（4）算法级平衡：提出潜在密度加权损失（LDWL），通过联合潜在空间和目标空间KDE密度估计对少数样本加权；（5）基于注意力门控机制的数据级与算法级特征融合。整体时间复杂度约为O(N²/B)。
AI.result: 在16个基准数据集上，使用6种回归器（MLP、XGBoost、LR、KNN、SVR、Ridge）进行10折交叉验证。结果显示：相比独立数据级或算法级方法，混合框架在MAE、RMSE和R²上均持续优越；相比独立回归器平均提升约23%；目标偏度与性能提升呈显著正相关（Spearman ρ=0.55-0.62，p<0.05）；消融实验证实各阶段均不可或缺（去除任一阶段性能均下降）；但在样本量小于1000的小数据集上表现不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明数据级与算法级平衡策略在统一框架中的深度融合可显著提升不平衡回归性能，且性能增益随目标偏度增大而增强。主要局限在于对数据量的依赖，未来工作应聚焦于框架各组件的自适应参数调优。

title: Connecting the Dots: Benchmarking Reflective Memory in Long-Horizon Dialogue
summary: Despite substantial progress in long-context modeling, existing benchmarks remain confined to factual memory for explicit recall, failing to measure the reflective memory required to synthesize fragmented, multimodal cues into high-level interpretations. To address this gap, we introduce RefMem-Bench, a benchmark for reflective memory in long-horizon dialogue. RefMem-Bench contains 26K annotated QA instances with eight reflective-memory dimensions and three task formats, requiring models to move beyond surface-level retrieval and infer latent meanings from evidence distributed across interaction histories. To enhance reflective memory capability, we propose REflective Memory INDuction (REMIND), a hierarchical framework that treats reflective memory as progressive meaning construction. REMIND couples question-conditioned evidence retrieval, salience-aware grounding, and abstraction-level supervision, and uses Progressive Reflective Alignment to distill high-level reflective reasoning into the factual inference pathway. Experiments show RefMem-Bench poses a substantial challenge to current models, while REMIND consistently improves both answer accuracy and memory recall through progressive evidence perception, grounding, and abstraction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RefMem-Bench基准测试和REMIND框架，用于评估和增强大语言模型在长程多模态对话中的"反思性记忆"能力——即超越显式事实检索，合成分散证据形成高层语义推断的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有长上下文记忆评估基准（如LongBench、LoCoMo、LongMemEval）主要聚焦于显式事实回忆（factual memory），即检索对话历史中直接陈述的信息。然而，从schema-based记忆理论出发，有效的记忆不仅需要保留细节，还需将分散信号综合为结构化的高层表征。在长程对话中，模型应能整合历史线索推断潜在用户状态、行为模式或性格特征，但当前基准缺乏对这种"反思性记忆"的系统评估。
AI.method: 方法包含两个核心部分：1）RefMem-Bench基准构建：基于REALTALK、DialSim、LoCoMo三源数据，通过半自动流程（文本分支用层次聚类+K-Means细粒度聚类，图像分支用CLIP编码聚类）生成26,449个QA实例，覆盖8个反思性记忆维度（时间动态、模式归纳、信念建模、经验规划、隐式边界建模、跨模态潜在推理、个性化视觉基线、主题视觉原型）和3种任务格式（单选、多选、直接回答），由3位专家进行证据锚定和人核验证。2）REMIND框架：提出三层认知金字塔（事实层-注意力层-反思层），通过渐进式反思对齐（PRA）将高层反思推理蒸馏到事实推理路径中。包含三个关键模块：问题条件证据检索（问题分解为推理指令和答案锚点+段级事件线索相关性排序）、显著性引导记忆定位（Top-K SAE稀疏编码+策略引导向量+语义共振评分+说话人条件广播+高斯平滑+模态融合）、反思抽象归纳（LLM生成反思摘要）。训练采用双向KL蒸馏损失+硬监督损失的联合目标。
AI.result: 在RefMem-Bench上，REMIND在所有任务格式和后端设置上一致取得最佳性能。Multi-Choice任务Acc从基线33.2提升至59.4（+26.2），MemR从45.0提升至58.1（+13.1）；Single-Choice任务Acc从45.0提升至66.2（+21.2），MemR从37.8提升至52.3（+14.5）；Direct-Answer任务Acc从21.1提升至32.9（+11.8），MemR从37.9提升至55.4（+17.5），B1从17.8提升至27.6，F1从21.3提升至30.4。消融实验验证了证据检索、反思策略、记忆定位各模块的贡献，层级分析显示从第1层到第3层性能逐步提升，验证了渐进式蒸馏策略的有效性。在Implicit Boundary Modeling和Pattern Induction两个维度的案例研究中，REMIND能比LightMem识别更具有判别性的线索（如避免行为、脆弱性抑制、责备转移模式）。训练轨迹分析揭示了REMIND呈现自底向上的学习课程：先锚定任务正确性，然后吸收注意力定位，最后巩固反思抽象。复杂度分析显示REMIND将测试时推理成本从O(N)·C_LLM降为O(N)·C_sim + O(1)·C_LLM，LLM成本与对话长度N解耦。
AI.conclusion: 本文将反思性记忆形式化为长程LLM评估的独立目标，引入RefMem-Bench作为大规模多模态、证据锚定、人核验证的基准，涵盖8个反思性记忆维度和3种任务格式。同时提出REMIND分层框架，通过证据感知、显著性引导定位和反思抽象的有机结合，结合渐进式反思对齐策略将高层反思推理蒸馏到事实推理路径。实验证明RefMem-Bench对当前模型具有显著挑战性，而REMIND在所有任务格式和后端设置上一致提升答案准确率和记忆召回率，展示了层次化定位与抽象在构建长程记忆智能体方面的潜力。局限性：人核标注限制了数据集可扩展性；认知金字塔结构对高度开放性任务的适配需进一步任务特定设计；更强的长程记忆能力可能带来隐私和公平性风险。

title: Understanding LLM Behavior in Multi-Target Cross-Lingual Summarization
summary: Multi-target cross-lingual text summarization (MTXLS), which summarizes a source document into multiple target languages, is increasingly important as users consume content in diverse languages, but remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce multi-target cross-lingual element-aware (MEA), a new MTXLS benchmark covering 24 target languages. We benchmark end-to-end and pipeline approaches across various LLMs and show that MTXLS performance still substantially lags behind English monolingual summarization. To better understand MTXLS in LLMs, we propose a layer-wise analysis framework for investigating how LLMs internally perform MTXLS. Our analyses suggest that translation and summarization behaviors emerge jointly within later layers rather than as distinctly decomposed stages. Most task-relevant processing occurs within these layers, and errors also tend to arise at similar depths. Motivated by these findings, we introduce an inference-time activation steering method that leverages hidden representations from English summarization to guide MTXLS generation. Experiments show that our method consistently improves MTXLS quality across target languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多目标跨语言元素感知（MEA）基准，覆盖24种目标语言，评估大语言模型在多目标跨语言摘要（MTXLS）任务上的表现；通过层级分析揭示翻译与摘要行为的联合涌现机制，并提出基于激活引导的推理时干预方法以提升摘要质量。
AI.motivation: 随着用户消费多语言内容的需求增长，跨语言摘要变得日益重要。然而现有研究多聚焦于单目标或单语摘要，多目标跨语言摘要（同时将源文档摘要为多种目标语言）仍缺乏系统研究，且大模型在该任务上的内部工作机制尚不清晰，性能显著落后于英语单语摘要。
AI.method: 1) 构建MEA基准数据集，覆盖24种目标语言的MTXLS任务；2) 对端到端与管线式方法在多种LLM上进行基准评测；3) 提出层级分析框架，探查LLM内部各层在MTXLS中的功能分工；4) 基于分析发现，提出推理时激活引导（activation steering）方法，利用英语摘要的隐藏表示来引导跨语言摘要生成。
AI.result: 实验表明：MTXLS性能仍显著低于英语单语摘要；层级分析显示翻译与摘要行为在LLM较后层联合涌现而非解耦为独立阶段，且任务相关处理与错误也集中发生于这些层；所提激活引导方法在不同目标语言上均能稳定提升MTXLS生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过MEA基准、层级分析框架与激活引导方法，揭示了LLM处理MTXLS的内部机制（翻译与摘要联合涌现），并提供了一种无需重新训练即可提升多语言摘要性能的有效干预手段，为多目标跨语言摘要的进一步研究提供了基准与分析工具。

title: IndoBias: A Dual Track Culturally Grounded Benchmark for LLMs Bias Evaluation in Indonesian Languages
summary: Despite being home to more than 1300 ethnic groups and 700 indigenous languages, bias in Large Language Models has not been fully studied in Indonesia, thus leaving a critical gap in evaluating representational fairness and localized stereotypes within its uniquely vast, multilingual, and diverse sociocultural landscape. To address this, we introduce IndoBias as a culturally-grounded bias benchmark to assess LLMs bias in Indonesian and three local languages: Javanese, Sundanese, and Makasar. IndoBias features dual perspective evaluation tracks: depth-oriented (with contrastive-pairs) and breadth-oriented (with generation-based), where the latter is grounded in social science frameworks (SPI, O*NET, and WGI). Our results show that existing LLMs -- particularly decoder models -- exhibit strong bias towards prototypical sentences in Indonesian, while local languages suffer higher bias under Ideology and Religion category. We also find that LLMs responses exhibit a non-uniform Stereotype Polarity when prompted with various local entities. Finally, we discover that, in Indonesian, Common Crawl texts introduce more bias during pretraining, compared to human-reviewed article texts (e.g., Wikipedia, News), whereas introducing local languages to pretraining generally increases bias. This work highlights the importance of studying bias in culture-specific context. Warning: This paper contains example data that may be offensive, harmful, or biased.

AI.tldr: IndoBias 是首个面向印尼语及三种地方语言（爪哇语、巽他语、望加锡语）的文化偏见评估基准，采用双轨设计：深度导向的对比对评估（IndoBias-Pairs，共544对/语言，4,352条）和广度导向的生成式评估（IndoBias-QA，覆盖336个印尼人口群体，6类人口学维度，7种任务复杂度），系统评估了主流LLM在印尼多元社会文化语境中的偏见表现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM偏见研究以英语为中心，忽略了印尼这一拥有1,300+民族和700+语言的多元社会。印尼的偏见具有语言和文化特异性——主流民族（如爪哇族、巽他族）面临固有刻板印象，而巴布亚、加里曼丹等小族群面临"不可见性偏见"。此外，标准对比对方法因依赖广泛认知的刻板印象而结构性排除了缺乏"常见"刻板印象的少数群体，造成评估悖论。亟需一个文化扎根、覆盖多语言、兼具深度与广度的偏见评估框架。
AI.method: 提出 IndoBias 双轨基准：（1）**IndoBias-Pairs**（深度导向）——人工构建544对印尼语句对，涵盖身份人口、经济地位、文化地理、社会家庭角色、意识形态与宗教5大领域、18个子领域，扩展至爪哇、巽他、望加锡三种地方语言；以原型胜率（protypical win rate，基于困惑度）为指标评估encoder和decoder模型。（2）**IndoBias-QA**（广度导向）——基于LLM Stereotype Index框架，组合4个枢轴（人口学、群体、刻板印象对、任务ID），设计7种递增复杂度的任务（简单选择→代码函数），覆盖336个群体、6类人口学（民族、政府机构、姓名、政党、宗教、大学），融入SPI、O*NET、WGI三个社会科学指数；通过Stereotype Polarity评估Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.5-9B、GPT-4.1 mini、GPT-5 mini。此外，进行50万步的预训练模拟实验（基于IndoBERT，6种数据组合），分析语料来源和多语言混合对偏见涌现的影响。
AI.result: （1）Decoder模型偏见显著强于encoder（印尼语原型胜率常超70%，部分接近80%，如Sailor2-8B-Chat在身份人口领域达79.6%）；encoder多在50%附近。（2）印尼语提示下偏见最高，地方语言（如爪哇语）较低，但在意识形态与宗教领域，望加锡语反超印尼语（如Qwen3-8B: 73.5% vs 59.2%）。（3）区域微调（如Komodo、Sailor2）一致增强原型偏见（Sailor2-8B在巽他语上+8.46），提升语言流利度反而放大刻板关联。（4）新型模型（Qwen3.5-9B、GPT-5 mini）在多数人口学类别上呈现更高的SP标准差，表明偏见极性更不均匀、更具上下文依赖性；对Korowai、Bajau等边缘族群的评估低于Javanese、Sundanese，加剧现实不平等。（5）预训练方面，CC-100（未过滤网页爬取）引入最多偏见（终值0.585），Wikipedia和Liputan6较低（0.555、0.546）；引入地方语言几乎一致地增加偏见。
AI.conclusion: IndoBias 作为首个面向印尼文化语境的偏见基准，揭示了LLM在该多元社会中的偏见具有语言特异性、群体非均匀性和语料依赖性。Decoder模型、区域微调和未过滤网络语料均显著放大原型偏见；新模型虽能力更强却呈现更不稳定的刻板印象极性。该工作强调非英语、多语言社会中偏见评估的必要性，主张以文化扎根的方式衡量代表性公平性，并希望 IndoBias 推动面向印尼乃至更广泛多元文化区域的更公平语言技术发展。

title: PALTO: Physics-Informed Active Learning for Tri-Gate FinFET Design Optimization for Vertical Power Delivery
summary: This paper demonstrates the effectiveness of machine learning-driven optimization for designing application-specific GaN tri-gate FinFETs in vertical power delivery systems. Conventional TCAD-based approaches are computationally intensive and insufficient for navigating the high-dimensional, nonlinear design space of advanced GaN devices. To address this, a physics-informed active learning framework is used to intelligently guide simulations, accelerating convergence while preserving accuracy. This ML-guided approach enables the discovery of optimal configurations by efficiently exploring key structural parameters -- most notably the GaN-to-AlGaN thickness ratio -- a long-standing focus of debate in device design. By systematically exploring key structural parameters, two optimized devices with aggressively scaled gate-to-drain lengths are identified. Single-fin, multi-channel simulations show that device~D2, with a thinner GaN channel relative to the AlGaN barrier, achieves higher drive current. However, in a 300-fin configuration, device~D1 outperforms device~D2 by delivering 3.3\,A at 0.49~ohm on-resistance -- approximately 2$\times$ better -- despite slightly higher parasitics. Both devices operate in a normally-off mode. Based on an application-specific figure of merit, device~D1 achieves 5\,pC$\cdot$ohm, demonstrating 2$\times$ greater switching efficiency than device~D2, while both designs outperform industrial benchmarks from different performance standpoints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PALTO框架，利用物理信息驱动的主动学习（active learning）方法优化GaN三栅FinFET在垂直功率传输（VPD）系统中的设计，通过多任务神经网络集成与query-by-committee策略高效探索高维设计空间，相比NSGA-II和随机搜索减少3.2倍TCAD仿真成本，并识别出两种性能优越的优化器件D1和D2。
AI.motivation: 传统TCAD仿真方法计算成本极高（单次仿真从1.5分钟到6.25小时不等），难以应对GaN三栅FinFET高维、非线性的设计空间探索。垂直功率传输（VPD）架构对功率开关提出了严苛要求（高电流密度、正常关断模式、低导通电阻与开关损耗的平衡），而GaN/AlGaN厚度比等关键结构参数的优化长期存在争议，亟需一种数据高效、智能化的优化策略来快速找到满足应用需求的器件配置。
AI.method: 1. 初始化：使用拉丁超立方采样（LHS）生成约10³个器件配置作为初始标注数据集；2. 代理模型：训练N=10个多任务神经网络集成（共享全连接骨干+两个任务特定输出头），同时预测I_DS,max和V_th，损失函数采用同方差不确定性加权并对V_th>0区域施加10倍惩罚；3. 主动学习循环：query-by-committee策略——从10⁶候选中基于集成方差选择高不确定性样本，经greedy farthest-first去冗余后筛选100个送TCAD仿真；4. 特征分析：使用SHAP（DeepExplainer）量化各设计参数对模型输出的贡献；5. 基准对比：与NSGA-II多目标遗传算法和随机搜索比较收敛效率。
AI.result: 1. 框架效率：R²>0.98收敛后可在约10分钟内评估6×10⁹个设计，仅需约10⁴次TCAD调用，比NSGA-II减少3.2倍仿真成本；2. 单鳍性能：器件D2（薄GaN/厚AlGaN）在单鳍配置下电流密度达28,636 mA/mm（V_DS=12V），约为基线的10.6倍，跨导峰值7,287 mS/mm；3. 多鳍扩展（300鳍）：器件D1（厚GaN）表现更优，实现I_DS=3.3A、R_on=0.49Ω，FoM=5.29 pΩ·C，相比EPC2023商业产品（32.19 pΩ·C）提升约6倍，总栅极电荷仅270 pC（降低82倍）；4. 击穿电压：器件D1在25°C下达200V（150°C为157V），器件D2为94V（150°C为64V），均满足>50V目标；5. 两种器件均保持增强型（E-mode）正常关断模式，V_th在0.45-0.49V之间，热稳定性良好。
AI.conclusion: PALTO框架通过物理信息驱动的主动学习显著加速了GaN三栅FinFET的TCAD优化流程，在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算成本。所提出的两种优化器件在电流驱动能力、导通电阻和开关效率方面均显著超越现有基线和商业产品，证明了ML引导的多维设计空间探索在复杂半导体器件优化中的有效性，为面向应用的高性能功率开关设计开辟了新路径。

title: RLVR without Ineffective Samples: Group Prioritized Off-Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, its effectiveness is substantially hindered by the prevalence of ineffective training data: many sampled prompts yield response groups that are either entirely correct or entirely incorrect, resulting in zero-variance rewards and limited learning signals. Recent state-of-the-art methods address this issue through extensive LLM rollouts to filter ineffective samples, but at the cost of considerable computational overhead. Alternative approaches, including predictive sampling and trajectory replay, aim to improve data efficiency but often remain insufficient and may introduce additional issues such as systematic bias or suboptimal constraints. To address these limitations, we propose Group Prioritized Off-Policy Optimization (POPO), a simple yet effective framework that fully exploits effective training batches without additional rollout overhead. POPO comprises two key components: prioritized group replay and decoupled off-policy optimization. The former replaces ineffective on-policy groups with effective off-policy groups via a recency-based replay mechanism that jointly considers sample quality and the degree of off-policiness. To further mitigate the off-policy gap, POPO employs decoupled importance sampling to correct off-policy bias while maintaining stable policy updates under consistent trust-region constraints. Empirical evaluations across diverse reasoning tasks, including mathematics, planning, and visual geometry, demonstrate that POPO substantially accelerates RL finetuning and achieves strong reasoning performance with significantly fewer rollouts.

AI.tldr: 提出Group Prioritized Off-Policy Optimization (POPO)框架，通过基于时近性的组级优先回放和解耦离策略优化，在不增加额外rollout开销的情况下构建完全有效的训练批次，显著加速RLVR对LLM推理能力的微调。
AI.motivation: RLVR在提升LLM推理能力方面效果显著，但训练数据中大量"无效样本"（prompt对应的响应组全对或全错，导致奖励方差为零）严重限制了学习信号。现有的SOTA方法（如DAPO）通过对候选批次进行大量LLM rollout来过滤无效样本，但计算开销巨大。预测采样方法预测准确率有限且可能引入系统偏差；轨迹回放方法无法根本解决prompt低效问题，且其离策略优化目标存在难以处理的偏差、次优约束或无效优势估计等问题。
AI.method: POPO包含两个核心组件：(1) 优先组回放（Prioritized Group Replay）：在组级别上用回放缓冲区中有效的离策略组替换无效的on-policy组，同时考虑样本质量（非零奖励方差）和离策略程度（基于时近性的FIFO回放策略），理论依据为Lemma 4.1表明近端策略更新下策略间总变差与步数差呈线性关系；(2) 解耦离策略优化（Decoupled Off-Policy Optimization）：通过将重要性比分解为ρ(θ,θ_old)·ρ(θ_old,β)的乘积，保持以π_θ_old作为裁剪中的近端策略而非行为策略π_β，从而在修正离策略偏差的同时保持跨on-policy和off-policy样本的一致信任域约束。整体算法无需额外计算开销，仅需在损失聚合前为回放样本乘以ρ(θ_old,β)。
AI.result: 在数学竞赛（DeepScaleR，DSR-1.5B/7B）、数值规划（Countdown）和视觉几何（Geometry3k）三个推理任务上的实验表明：POPO在各项任务上一致匹配DAPO性能同时显著超越GRPO、ARPO、MoPPS等基线；仅用DAPO约30%的rollout预算即可达到可比性能；运行时间约为DAPO的一半；POPO+MoPPS组合带来进一步性能提升；POPO可兼容RLOO、PPO等基础RLVR算法，并在不同响应组大小下保持稳健。消融实验验证了优先回放中质量与时近性标准的必要性，以及解耦离策略优化目标相对于朴素离策略目标的优越性。
AI.conclusion: POPO是一个简单而有效的RLVR样本效率提升框架，通过组级优先回放和解耦离策略优化，在不增加rollout成本的前提下构建完全有效的训练批次，实现了稳定高效的策略优化。实验证明POPO在多种推理任务上以显著更少的rollout达到与SOTA方法相当的性能，具有广泛的适用性和实用价值。未来工作可探索混合短期缓冲与长期储层的策略以进一步提升样本多样性。

title: BenchEvolver: Frontier Task Synthesis via Solution-Centric Evolution
summary: The rapid progress of frontier large language models has led to widespread benchmark saturation, limiting the ability of existing datasets to differentiate model capabilities or provide useful training signal. For instance, on LiveCodeBench, frontier models achieve over 99% Pass@1 on easy splits and exceed 90% Pass@1 on average across difficulty levels. Constructing new, challenging datasets typically requires substantial human effort, creating a bottleneck for progress. We introduce BenchEvolver, a solution-centric evolutionary framework that automatically transforms existing coding problems into harder variants. Rather than generating problems from scratch, BenchEvolver evolves reference solutions through structured transformations and derives corresponding statements and tests from the evolved solutions. This design grounds generation in executable semantics, enabling scalable construction of high-quality, diverse, and difficult tasks with verifiable correctness. Applying BenchEvolver to LiveCodeBench and SciCode, we obtain evolved tasks that are substantially harder while maintaining validity, reference correctness, and diversity. We further curate LiveCodeBench-Plus, a 91-problem benchmark combining evolved and difficult original LCB-v6 tasks, where frontier-model Pass@1 ranges from 27.5% to 62.6%, restoring clear discrimination among strong coding models. Importantly, evolved tasks remain challenging even for the model that generates them, enabling self-improvement. We further show that RL on evolved LCB tasks improves held-out coding performance: for gpt-oss-20b, seed+evolved training achieves +8.7 and +8.3 Pass@1 gains on LCB v6 Hard and LCB-Pro Easy, exceeding seed-only gains by 70.7% and 34.8%, respectively. Our results show that BenchEvolver can convert saturated benchmarks into frontier-level evaluation suites and reusable training signal.

AI.tldr: BenchEvolver提出了一种以解为中心的演化框架，通过对参考解进行结构化变换并据此推导问题描述和测试，将饱和的代码基准自动转化为更难的可验证变体。应用该框架构建了LiveCodeBench-Plus（91题），并证明演化任务可作为强化学习训练信号实现自改进循环。
AI.motivation: 前沿大语言模型在主流代码基准（如LiveCodeBench）上已达到超过99%（简单）和90%（平均）的Pass@1，基准饱和问题严重削弱了数据集区分模型能力和提供训练信号的能力。同时，人工构建新基准成本高昂且难以规模化。现有合成数据方法多采用教师-学生范式，由更强模型生成数据给更弱模型使用，无法实现"自挑战"式的自我改进。
AI.method: 核心是"以解为先"（solution-centric）的演化流程：Proposer首先对参考解C进行结构化变异引入"主导性算法跃迁"（dominant algorithmic lift），再围绕演化后的解C'推导问题描述S'和测试T'。Evaluator通过三方面验证：1）对于竞赛编程采用暴力解三角验证法（参考解、暴力解、公开输出oracle三方一致）；2）对于科学计算采用陈述忠实性检查（独立解对测试通过率≥0.5）；3）经验难度筛选（被目标模型集多次尝试后必须降低通过率）。Memory模块维护局部（每个种子的演化历史）和全局（跨种子的变异家族）记忆以引导多样化搜索。任务难度按经验通过率（而非启发式）定义。
AI.result: 在LiveCodeBench上：1）65个种子的对照实验中，BenchEvolver较问题中心基线显著提升演化成功率（如GPT-5.4-mini从54.5%/47.8%/30.0%提升至77.3%/69.6%/60.0%）；2）人类专家评审100条演化谱系，难度评分从1.83升至3.21，Codeforces估计评分中位数从1125升至2100，算法类别从19种扩展到30种，95.6%的谱系引入了新算法类别；3）构建的LiveCodeBench-Plus基准（91题）上8个前沿模型Pass@1从27.5%到62.6%不等，恢复了对强模型的区分能力。在SciCode上同样生成有效且更难的科学计算任务。强化学习自改进实验中，gpt-oss-20b使用seed+evolved混合训练，在LCB v6 Hard上较seed-only多获得+3.6 Pass@1增益（提升70.7%），在LCB-Pro Easy上多获得+2.1（提升34.8%），在独立Gemini-3-Flash生成的LCB-Evolved Medium上获得+7.77点的绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: BenchEvolver可将饱和的可执行代码基准转化为前沿级别的评估套件和可重用的训练信号。实验证明其生成的演化任务在保持有效性和多样性的同时显著降低目标模型通过率（即便对生成者本身），且通过强化学习能将这些自生成挑战转化为模型能力提升。未来方向包括：1）将单轮自改进扩展为多轮闭环（改进后的模型作为下一轮演化器）；2）构建"活基准"——通过可复现的演化流水线持续生成、验证和校准新任务。核心启示是基准构建应从静态工件转向自适应、版本化的演化管线。

title: What Makes a Strong Model? A Unified Spectral Analysis of Knowledge Transfer over High-dimensional Linear Regression
summary: Teacher-Student Knowledge Transfer (KT) is ubiquitous in modern machine learning, ranging from classical model compression via Knowledge Distillation (KD) to the emergent phenomenon of Weak-to-Strong (W2S) generalization. While existing studies offer isolated insights, a unified theoretical framework explaining the efficacy of KT across these disparate regimes remains lacking. In this work, we establish a unified spectral analysis of SGD dynamics in high-dimensional linear regression, elucidating the efficiency of KT across seemingly disparate regimes. We characterize KT efficiency through two distinct mechanisms: \emph{Spectral Horizon Expansion} in KD, which enables the capture of statistically inaccessible high-frequency signals, and \emph{Spectral Denoising} in W2S, where the student acts as a filter for optimization noise. Our framework unifies these phenomena, revealing that the efficacy of transfer is governed by the interplay between implicit regularization and heterogeneous spectral learning speeds over the spectrum.

AI.tldr: 本文在过参数化线性回归与SGD动力学框架下，建立了统一的谱分析理论以解释教师-学生知识传递（KT）现象，涵盖知识蒸馏（KD）、自蒸馏（SD）和弱到强泛化（W2S）三种看似矛盾的范式。核心发现为两种机制：KD中的"谱视域扩展"（强教师拓展弱学生的优化边界以捕获高频信号）和W2S中的"谱去噪"（学生利用额外容量过滤教师的优化噪声）。论文还刻画了"强模型"的三个谱指标：表示秩、谱衰减率与任务内在维度。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏（KD）、自蒸馏（SD）和弱到强（W2S）泛化等知识传递现象在现代机器学习中广泛存在（如模型压缩、大模型微调与对齐），但现有理论研究多为孤立的、案例式分析，缺乏统一框架解释其共通的底层机理。尤其地，先前理论工作普遍忽略了数据协方差矩阵的谱性质——这一本质上决定学习动力学快慢的关键因素——对知识传递效率的调控作用。此外，KD中为何学生能超越其模仿源、SD中为何同架构学生可优于教师等反直觉现象，亟需系统性理论解释。
AI.method: 论文以高维线性回归为基本模型，假设特征映射作用于正交语义基，采用步进式学习率调度的单遍SGD动力学。在四阶矩条件（弱于高斯性）假设下，通过引入二阶矩张量与迭代算子（确定性算子、随机算子、四阶矩算子、方差算子），精细刻画SGD的偏置-方差分解。核心结果为定理1的有限样本风险分解定理，将传递风险严格拆分为三部分：(I)传播的教师误差（按学生谱截止k*分头尾投影）、(II)学生优化误差（可由数据量控制）、(III)不可约对齐偏差（几何失配）。进一步在谱兼容学生（教师特征空间的子空间映射）、多项式谱衰减（λ_k∝k^{-α}）与低内在维度（k†有界）假设下，分别推导KD、W2S、SD场景的渐近收敛速率（定理2-5与推论1），并通过将线性模型等价于核方法/NTK回归证明理论的普适性。实验部分在合成数据与UTKFace、ImageNet真实数据上验证谱衰减率、谱视域扩展、提前停止W2S、内在维度等关键结论。
AI.result: 1) 统一风险分解（定理1）严格刻画传递误差三组分，揭示头部（k≤k*）教师误差1:1继承、尾部（k>k*）误差以O(δ²)阻尼——后者是W2S机制的本质。2) KD方面：定理2证明谱兼容弱学生可严格获益于蒸馏（DER>1），机制为用教师低近似偏差替代学生高近似噪声；定理3给出误设定任务下风险速率为Õ(N^{-[α_T-(1+β)]/α_T})，且当学生严格弱（α_S>α_T）时DER以N^κ发散（κ>0），即"谱视域扩展"——教师继承的k*_T∝N^{1/α_T}远快于学生自身k*_S。3) W2S方面：定理4证明强学生风险严格低于弱教师（δ阻尼使尾部噪声消失）；定理5给出最优提前停止点n_opt与PGR→1（全能力恢复）的渐近速率，揭示继承方差与阻尼方差之间的均衡（变分-阻尼权衡）。4) SD作为特例（推论1）严格享有正速率增益Δ_SD=2/(2α_T+1)>0。5) 最终提炼"强模型三签名"：表示秩（与RankMe对应）、谱衰减率（与α-ReQ对应）、任务特定内在维度k†（本文新指标，强调低维几何对齐方为真正的强）。
AI.conclusion: 本文回答了标题之问："什么造就了强模型？"——强模型不仅需高容量（慢谱衰减率α→1，小α_ν对应大RKHS），更需其特征几何能将任务信号压缩到低维子空间（小k†，使δ∝(k†)^{2α_S}阻尼更强）。理论贡献在于将KD、W2S、SD三大知识传递范式统一于谱分析视角，揭示其本质差异在于谱截止k*与谱衰减率α的相互作用：教师用慢衰减拓展学生视域，学生用额外容量作谱滤波器。三大谱指标（表示秩、谱衰减率、内在维度）构成了评估模型迁移能力的原则性工具，超越既有启发式指标，指向"低维几何对齐"才是模型强度的根本属性——这对未来模型选择、对齐方法设计具有直接指导意义。

title: ChronosAD: Leveraging Time Series Foundation Models for Accurate Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted at the 24th IEEE International Conference on Industrial Informatics (INDIN) 2026
summary: Time series anomaly detection is a crucial task in various domains, including finance, healthcare, and industry. However, existing methods often struggle to generalize across different datasets, especially when anomalies are subtle or context-dependent. To solve this issue, we introduce ChronosAD, a novel architecture for anomaly detection that uses a time series foundation model as a feature extractor. Specifically, it employs a two-stage pipeline: first, it uses the foundation model to extract embeddings for each time series in a zero-shot manner. Then, a custom-developed Temporal Block, composed of Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) and Multi-Head Attention, refines these embeddings to capture temporal dependencies and highlight salient patterns. Unlike previous approaches, our model requires minimal task-specific tuning and demonstrates robust generalization across a wide range of domains, including industrial, medical, cyber-physical, and automotive systems. Extensive experiments on 11 benchmarks show that ChronosAD outperforms existing methods by 4.72% in AUC and 6.60% in AP on average. The source code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ChronosAD是一种用于时间序列异常检测的两阶段深度学习架构，利用Chronos时间序列基础模型作为零样本特征提取器，并结合自定义的Temporal Block（BiLSTM+多头注意力）来捕捉时序依赖关系。该方法在11个跨领域基准数据集上表现优异，平均AUC和AP分别比现有方法提升4.72%和6.60%。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测方法通常针对特定领域设计，依赖手工特征或领域启发式方法，泛化能力差，且在处理微妙或上下文相关的异常时表现不佳。时间序列基础模型虽然在预测任务上展现出强大的零样本泛化能力，但尚未被充分探索用于异常检测任务。
AI.method: 提出两阶段流水线：(1) 使用Chronos基础模型以零样本方式为每个单变量通道提取嵌入向量，同时获得缩放因子；(2) 通过自定义Temporal Block（含BiLSTM和多头注意力机制）精炼嵌入以捕捉时序依赖。处理流程包括L2归一化、SeLU激活、跨通道特征拼接，最终通过全连接网络输出二分类预测，使用加权二值交叉熵损失训练。
AI.result: 在11个多领域基准数据集（包括UCR Archive 7个数据集、CWRU轴承、MIT-BIH心电图、SWaT水处理和Waveform模拟数据）上，ChronosAD优于11种现有方法（包括AnoGAN、Deep-SVDD、BeatGAN、USAD、KalmanAE等），平均AUC达到97.15%，AP达到97.36%。在TwoPatterns、TwoLeadECG、UWaveGestureLibraryY、CWRU等数据集上达到接近100%的性能。消融研究表明Chronos编码器、L2归一化和注意力机制是最关键的组件。
AI.conclusion: ChronosAD验证了时间序列基础模型作为异常检测特征提取器的可行性，展示了跨领域（工业、医疗、网络物理系统、汽车）的强鲁棒泛化能力。作为初步研究，采用监督设置验证了方法的有效性，未来工作将扩展到无监督设置以便与现有方法进行更直接的比较。

title: SkillAdaptor: Self-Adapting Skills for LLM Agents from Trajectories
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on reusable external skills to solve long-horizon interactive tasks. Existing training-free skill adaptation pipelines usually update skills from full trajectories or session-level feedback, which makes failure attribution coarse and often produces unstable or overly broad revisions. We propose SkillAdaptor, a training-free step-level skill adaptation framework with explicit failure attribution, and it can plug into OpenClaw-class agent harnesses. Given a failed trajectory, SkillAdaptor identifies a first actionable fault step, links responsibility to candidate skills, and applies targeted updates under explicit acceptance checks while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate on WebShop, PinchBench, and Claw-Eval with Kimi-K2.5, GLM-5, and GPT-5.2. SkillAdaptor improves over no-skill and skill-adaptation baselines on all three suites, with the largest single-metric improvements of +1.5 points on PinchBench Avg Score%, +1.8 on Claw-Eval Avg Score, and +1.7 on WebShop success rate. These results indicate that step-level attribution supports more stable and auditable training-free skill maintenance\footnote{The code will be released at this https URL .}.

AI.tldr: SkillAdaptor 是一个无需训练的智能体技能自适应框架，通过对失败轨迹进行步级（step-level）显式归因，定位首个可行动的错误步骤并关联到具体技能，再以接受门控（acceptance gate）的定向修改/生成方式更新技能库，骨干模型保持冻结，可作为 OpenClaw 类智能体运行时的插件组件。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练技能自适应方法多基于完整轨迹或会话级反馈进行更新，导致失败归因粒度过粗、修订不稳定且范围过宽——长时程任务中一个早期错误会污染后续众多步骤，轨迹级反思难以精确定位责任技能，从而产生误向或过度的技能修改。
AI.method: 三阶段闭环：(1) Attribution——Localizer 定位失败轨迹中"首个可行动错误步骤 t*"，Linker 估计各候选技能的加权责任集并选择修订（revise）或生成（generate）动作；(2) Modification——按动作定向重写最高责任技能或合成新技能（带 θ_dup 去重）；(3) Qualification——在当前与候选技能库下重新执行任务，仅当期望收益 Δ≥0 时才提交更新。技能检索使用 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 余弦相似度 + LLM 重排，技能以 SKILL.md 格式存储，最多 10 轮或连续 3 轮无变化时早停。
AI.result: 在 WebShop、PinchBench、Claw-Eval 三个基准上，使用 Kimi-K2.5、GLM-5、GPT-5.2 三个骨干模型，SkillAdaptor 全面优于无技能与已有技能自适应基线。最大单指标增益：PinchBench Avg Score% +1.5、Claw-Eval Avg Score +1.8、WebShop 成功率 +1.7；最强匹配基线下 WebShop Score（GLM-5）+2.3、WebShop 成功率（Kimi-K2.5）+1.7pp。消融显示 Localizer+Linker 决定精度，Qualifier 抑制波动，初始技能单独使用增益消失。约 64%–75% 的合格写入集中在前两轮，五轮后基本停止。代价是 prompt 增大（WebShop 1.5k→2.7k tokens），但平均交互步数在三个基准上一致减少。
AI.conclusion: 步级失败归因比轨迹级反思更精准、稳定且可审计，可在免训练、冻结骨干的前提下实现持续技能维护；当失败信号可被局部化、且执行轨迹暴露中间结构时效果最佳（如数据/代码类任务），但在依赖外部系统、持久状态或跨会话上下文的任务（Research/Memory/Security）上增益有限。局限在于稀疏/延迟反馈与缺失外部接口时性能可能下降，且尚未在长期部署与分布外偏移下充分验证。

title: TukaBench: A Culturally Grounded Jailbreak Benchmark for African Languages
summary: Safety evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) remains heavily English-centric, leaving Low-Resource Languages (LRLs), particularly African ones, critically underexplored. We introduce TUKABENCH, a jailbreak benchmark for seven African languages that extends JailbreakBench (JBB) beyond direct translation through four settings: human translation of JBB prompts, English adaptation to African contexts followed by human translation, human-curated prompts validated through interactions with GPT-5.2, and code-switched prompts combining English and African languages, isolating the effect of language, cultural grounding, and prompt evasiveness on model safety. Across closed and open models, prompting in African languages reduces refusal relative to English, with culturally adapted prompts leading to least refusal. The evaluation also surfaces two structural limitations: model comprehension failures and reduced LLM-as-a-judge reliability in LRLs. To capture the first, we introduce Deflection alongside Refused and Jailbroken; to assess the second, we validate outputs with human annotations, showing that judge-human agreement drops in lower-resource languages and less commonly supported scripts.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了TukaBench，这是一个针对七种非洲语言（阿姆哈拉语、豪萨语、伊博语、奇切瓦语、斯瓦希里语、约鲁巴语和科萨语）的越狱安全评估基准。该基准基于JailbreakBench (JBB) 构建，包含四种设置：人工翻译、文化适配、人工编写（通过与GPT-5.2交互验证）以及英非混合语码转换提示。论文提出三分类评估方案（越狱/拒绝/偏转），并通过人工标注验证了LLM-as-a-judge在低资源语言中的可靠性下降问题。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM安全评估严重以英语为中心，对低资源语言（尤其是非洲语言）关注不足。现有越狱评估主要针对高资源语言，导致非洲语言缺乏人工策划的越狱基准。这种语言覆盖的不均衡使得LLM在非洲语言环境中的安全性难以得到有效评估。
AI.method:
1. 数据集构建：基于JBB构建五类提示组件（Afri-JBB-Harm、Afri-JBB-Benign、Afri-JBB-Culture、AfriJail-Mono、AfriJail-CS），通过机翻+人工后编辑管线生成
2. 翻译流程：三阶段管线（机器翻译→SSA-COMET-QE质量评估→人工后编辑）
3. 评估模型：13个LLM（闭源：GPT系列、Grok系列、Gemini系列；开源：Gemma、Llama、DeepSeek、GPT-oss、Qwen）
4. 评估方法：直接提示和边界点越狱(BPJ)两种条件；GPT-4.1作为LLM法官进行三分类（越狱/拒绝/偏转）
5. 人工验证：6种语言、5个模型、1500个响应通过3位母语者标注进行验证
6. 评估指标：ASR（攻击成功率）、Deflection Rate（偏转率）、Refusal Rate（拒绝率）
AI.result:
1. 非洲语言提示主要增加偏转而非ASR：模型在非洲语言中更倾向于产生离题响应而非真正的越狱
2. 文化适配提示导致最低拒绝率，表明文化接地显著增加模型脆弱性
3. 资源效应在拉丁字母语言中表现明显：斯瓦希里语安全性最强，伊博语、奇切瓦语、约鲁巴语偏转率最高
4. 阿姆哈拉语（Ge'ez文字）的偏转率异常高，表明文字系统（"token tax"效应）会放大理解困难
5. 新一代模型（GPT-5.2、Grok-4.3）显著改善但仍有差距
6. BPJ攻击提高ASR但不能消除偏转
7. 语码转换降低偏转但不均匀提高ASR
8. 法官-人类一致性在高资源拉丁字母语言中较高（斯瓦希里语80%），在低资源语言和阿姆哈拉语中显著下降
9. 模型在良性提示上存在过度拒绝（~50%）
AI.conclusion: 论文证明ASR单独不足以评估低资源语言的安全性，需要联合考虑Jailbroken和Deflected率。文化适配的提示比直接翻译更能揭示部署风险。理解能力是低资源语言安全评估的主要瓶颈，受资源水平、文字系统和模型代际影响。LLM-as-a-judge在低资源和非拉丁文字语言中可靠性下降，需要通过人工评估来补充。TukaBench将作为开放资源发布，以支持非洲语言安全研究的持续进展。

title: DiffuSent: Towards a Unified Diffusion Framework for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
summary: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) encompasses seven distinct subtasks, each focusing on different extracted elements. Despite the proven success of generative models in unified aspect sentiment analysis, existing approaches often rely on auto-regressive token-by-token generation without grasping the whole information of the aspect and opinion terms, resulting in boundary insensitivity, particularly in context of multi-word aspect and opinion terms. To address these issues, we present DiffuSent, a non-auto-regressive diffusion framework that systematically formulates all ABSA subtasks as boundary denoising diffusion processes, progressively refining boundaries over noisy states. Furthermore, we introduce a contrastive denoising training strategy which effectively address duplicate predictions with subtle variations introduced by diffusion process. Extensive experiments across 28 settings (7 subtasks x 4 datasets) demonstrate that DiffuSent achieves delivers consistent improvements over the strongest generative and span-based systems. DiffuSent exhibits notable gains on multi-word triplets, achieving an average improvement of +2.48 F1, and maintains robust extraction accuracy in sentences containing multiple sentiment triplets. Moreover, the non-auto-regressive decoding enables substantial efficiency benefits, reaching up to 181 times faster inference than auto-regressive generative baselines

AI.tldr: DiffuSent提出了一种统一的非自回归扩散框架，将ABSA全部7个子任务建模为边界去噪扩散过程，通过对比去噪训练策略解决重复预测问题，在4个数据集7个子任务共28个设置上达到SOTA，多词三元组平均提升+2.48 F1，推理速度最高达自回归基线的181倍。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归生成式ABSA方法存在两个关键缺陷：(1) 逐token生成机制无法捕获多词aspect/opinion term的整体上下文，导致边界模糊和不完整截断（如将"new hamburger with special sauce"截断为"hamburger"）；(2) 严格顺序解码导致推理延迟随输出长度线性增长，限制可扩展性。
AI.method: 核心是边界去噪扩散过程：(1) 前向扩散对边界序列添加高斯噪声模拟边界不确定性；(2) 反向扩散使用DDIM非马尔可夫策略迭代精化边界索引，单步并行输出所有预测。网络包含PLM+BiLSTM句子编码器、含自注意力和交叉注意力的Transformer边界解码器、4个索引指针预测aspect/opinion起止位置、情感分类器。训练采用匈牙利算法进行最优匹配，并提出对比去噪策略：通过两个噪声尺度（λ₁<λ₂）构造正/负样本，正样本重建真实边界，负样本分类为"Invalid"，抑制细微边界变异的重复预测。
AI.result: 在D₁₇、D₁₉、D₂₀ₐ、D₂₀b四个SemEval数据集的7个子任务上全面达到SOTA：D₂₀ₐ上12个设置均最优，相对最强基线提升0.07-1.21 F1（p<0.01显著）；D₂₀b ASTE在Lap14/Res14/Res15/Res16均超越包括T5-base的UIE/MvP/SLGM等基线。消融实验验证对比去噪贡献最大（去除后Res15/Res16下降2.23/2.78 F1），最佳扩散时间步=1000，最佳噪声序列数=60。多词三元组提升2.48 F1（vs 单词0.52）。参数量仅112M（约为MvP/SLGM的一半），推理速度达MvP的181.37×，SLGM的7倍+。LLM（ChatGPT-4/4o、LLaMA3-8B）在ABSA上显著落后于BERT基线。
AI.conclusion: DiffuSent通过将ABSA建模为边界去噪扩散过程并引入对比去噪训练，有效解决了自回归方法在多词term边界定位和推理效率上的瓶颈，为统一细粒度情感分析提供了新范式，在准确性和效率上均取得显著优势。

title: FreqLite: A Lightweight Frequency-Decomposed Linear Model with Adaptive Reversible Normalization for Robust Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Long-term time-series forecasting needs models that are accurate yet efficient enough for commodity hardware. Lightweight linear forecasters are remarkably strong in this regime, yet they leave two openings: reversible instance normalization (RevIN) de-normalizes the entire horizon with a single lookback statistic, which is inaccurate under non-stationarity, and time-domain trend/seasonal decomposition relies on a fixed, non-adaptive filter. We present FreqLite, an ultra-lightweight, channel-independent frequency-decomposed linear forecaster: a learnable, lossless, partition-of-unity spectral filter splits the input into bands that are forecast by per-band linear heads and, unlike low-pass-truncation approaches, the high-frequency band is retained and modeled. FreqLite is the best lightweight model on the standard long-term forecasting benchmarks and, at long lookback (L=336), attains a lower average error than a PatchTST Transformer (0.3244 vs. 0.3587 MSE) while using 4x fewer parameters, 2.2x less memory, and 2.2x less time per epoch on a single 4 GB laptop GPU; although modest in magnitude, its improvements are statistically significant under paired Wilcoxon tests across all matched cells (p < 1e-5). We further introduce Adaptive Reversible Instance Normalization (A-RevIN), a regime-adaptive reversible normalization that strictly generalizes RevIN (recovered exactly when its gate is closed), engages under non-stationarity, and reduces to RevIN without harm on stationary data. We validate this on both a real strongly non-stationary dataset (ILI, up to ~5% MSE reduction) and a controlled synthetic drift sweep in which A-RevIN's benefit and its learned gate both rise monotonically with injected non-stationarity. Every component is independently ablatable (Linear and RLinear are special cases of FreqLite), and all results are reproducible on commodity hardware.

AI.tldr: FreqLite 是一种面向长期时间序列预测的超轻量级频率分解线性模型，通过可学习的无损谱滤波器和自适应可逆实例归一化（A-RevIN），在保持线性规模的同时，在标准长期预测基准测试中超越现有轻量级模型，并在长回看窗口（L=336）下以约4倍更少的参数、2.2倍更少的显存和2.2倍更快的训练速度超越 PatchTST Transformer。
AI.motivation: 现有轻量级线性预测器存在两个关键不足：(1) 可逆实例归一化（RevIN）使用单一回看统计量对整个预测视野进行反归一化，在非平稳性条件下不准确；(2) 时域趋势/季节性分解依赖固定且非自适应的滤波器。该研究旨在解决这两个问题，提出更准确、更高效且适合商品硬件部署的长期时间序列预测模型。
AI.method: FreqLite 由三个核心组件构成：(1) 可学习的频率分解——使用基于单位分解的软谱掩码（低/高带），将输入分裂为 K 个频带；(2) 每个频带由独立的线性头预测后相加重组；(3) A-RevIN（自适应可逆实例归一化）——通过可学习门控机制和漂移传播项实现视野自适应的反归一化，严格泛化 RevIN。模型满足严格嵌套关系 Linear⊆RLinear⊆FreqLite，每个组件都可独立消融。在单块 4GB 笔记本 GPU（RTX 3050 Ti）上完成所有实验。
AI.result: 在标准长期预测基准（ETTh1/h2、ETTm1/m2、Weather）上，FreqLite 在 L=336 时以 0.3244 的平均 MSE 成为最佳轻量级模型，超越 RLinear (0.3273)、NLinear (0.3290) 和 FITS (0.3291)；同时以约4倍更少参数、2.2倍更少显存、2.2倍更快训练速度超越 PatchTST-small (0.3587 MSE)。在显著非平稳的 ILI 数据集上，A-RevIN 实现约 5% 的 MSE 降低，且门控值与误差改善随非平稳程度单调增加。在 Electricity (C=321) 高维数据集上保持竞争力。统计显著性经配对 Wilcoxon 检验确认（p ≈ 10⁻⁶）。
AI.conclusion: FreqLite 证明了通过精心设计的、可解释的、条件自适应的归一化（而非增加模型容量）是在商品硬件上实现高效长期时间序列预测的有效方向。其 A-RevIN 的方法论贡献在于揭示了必须将门控初始化在恒等点以避免梯度陷阱，同时 RevIN 在门关闭时仍可精确恢复。该工作在轻量级模型与 Transformer 之间的精度-效率权衡前沿上占据有利位置。

title: BRo-JEPA: Learning Modular Arithmetic in Latent Space
summary: Can neural networks learn abstract algebraic rules, or do they merely memorize training patterns? We investigate this using MNIST digits as states and modular arithmetic operations as actions in a JEPA-style latent world model. Standard supervised baselines and JEPA models with additive operation embeddings fit seen operations but fail to extrapolate reliably to unseen ones. To bridge this gap, we introduce a block-rotation predictor that imposes the circular structure of modulo-10 arithmetic in latent space. This enables strong zero-shot generalization, with the best ResNet-based JEPA block-rotation model achieving 99.46\% zero-shot and 99.46\% rollout accuracy. Our results suggest that latent world models can learn symbolic transformation rules when architecture matches the structure of the problem. Our code can be \href{ this https URL }{accessed here}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BRo-JEPA 模型，通过在 JEPA 潜空间世界模型中引入块旋转（block-rotation）预测器，将模 10 算术的循环结构作为归纳偏置注入模型。在仅用 ±1 操作训练、从未见过 ±2 至 ±9 操作的严格零样本设定下，ResNet + 多频率旋转（ResNet-MFR）达到 99.46% 的零样本准确率和 99.46% 的 rollout 准确率，显著优于监督学习基线和标准加性操作嵌入的 JEPA 模型。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型在算术推理任务上往往依赖训练数据的统计相关性而非学习真正的代数规则，在训练范围之外的数值或操作上泛化能力差。以往工作（如 NALU/NAU）通过特殊结构注入归纳偏置但鲁棒性不足；JEPA 类潜空间世界模型已在连续空间变换上展现强大能力，但在符号化、满足公理性质的变换（如模运算）上尚未被充分探索。本文旨在回答：神经网络的潜空间世界模型能否学习抽象代数规则，实现严格的零样本外推。
AI.method: 1. 任务设定：将 MNIST 数字作为状态，模 10 加法操作作为动作，训练时仅用 {+1, -1}，在 {±2,…,±9} 上测试严格零样本泛化。2. JEPA 框架：上下文编码器与目标编码器（EMA 更新）分别编码上下文与目标图像，MLP 预测器结合操作嵌入预测目标潜表示，以 L2 损失训练并附 VICReg 正则化以防止表征坍缩。3. 块旋转预测器（BRo-JEPA）：用受 RoPE 启发的分块 2D 平面旋转 R_block(θ) 替换 MLP 预测器，预测为 z_p = R_block(k·θ)·z，天然保证 R(θ)^k = R(kθ) 的复合性。4. 两种策略：SFR（所有块共享角度 θ=2π/10）和 MFR（每块独立角度，设为 2π/10·(i mod 5)），角度既可固定也可学习。5. 还引入了加性组合操作嵌入和组合一致性损失作为基线对比方法。
AI.result: 1. 监督基线（MLP/ResNet-18）：训练集准确率 99.5%/99.9%，但零样本准确率仅 5.93%/2.42%，PCA 显示模型仅学到操作符号而未编码幅度。2. 标准 JEPA + 加性嵌入：可见操作准确率 97-99%，零样本仅约 10%，rollout 准确率 98% 但直接外推失败。3. JEPA + 组合一致性损失：弱零样本准确率达 99.31%，但因训练时已接触组合操作，并非严格零样本。4. BRo-JEPA（ResNet-MFR，固定角）：严格零样本准确率 99.46%，rollout 准确率 99.46%，KNN 准确率 70.9%。5. 潜空间几何分析：PCA 呈现清晰的圆形流形，类原型按模 10 顺序排列，反向对（相隔 5 步）呈近 -1 余弦相似度；MFR 在多频率下分解出 13 个独立谐波分量，潜表示更具解耦性。6. 可学习角度下 SFR 易陷入高阶谐波局部最小值而退化，MFR 因多频率冗余而更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 1. JEPA 潜空间世界模型在面对符号化公理变换时，能够学习真正的组合代数结构而非仅记忆训练模式，前提是模型架构与问题的内在对称性相匹配。2. 加性操作嵌入或组合一致性损失等"软"归纳偏置不足以保证严格零样本外推，非线性预测器可能破坏嵌入空间中的线性结构。3. 块旋转预测器通过将模 10 算术的循环群结构直接编码为潜空间中的旋转动力学，提供了强而有效的归纳偏置，使模型在未见过操作上实现近完美的零样本准确率。4. 局限性：实验仅在受控的 MNIST 模运算环境下完成，最强结果依赖与问题周期结构精确匹配的旋转偏置；未来需探索在未知变换群结构、更大状态空间和更复杂视觉域中学习类似结构化潜空间动力学的方法。

title: Beyond Access: Guided LLM Scaffolding for Independent Learning in Undergraduate Statistics
comment: 10 pages, conference: Proceedings of the 34th International Conference on Computers in Education. Asia-Pacific Society for Computers in Education
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly entering students' learning practices, but their educational value depends on whether they support reasoning or enable task completion without engagement. This study examines guided LLM use in an undergraduate Probability and Statistics course, focusing on the gap between assigned access and actual interaction quality. In a four-week quasi-experimental summer program, students were organized into three balanced conditions: no LLM access, unrestricted LLM access, and guided LLM access. The guided condition used the same LLM platform as the unrestricted condition, but students received explicit training and rules promoting reasoning-focused help-seeking, stepwise hints, verification, and ethical use. All quizzes and the delayed final exam were completed without LLM or external assistance, allowing us to distinguish AI-supported practice performance from independent learning. Results show that guided use was associated with clearer learning-oriented interaction patterns than unrestricted access, especially in prioritizing reasoning over final answers and requesting stepwise support. Guided-LLM students showed stronger no-help quiz performance during the intervention phase, whereas unrestricted access appeared more useful for assisted practice completion than for consistently improving independent performance. Available time measures did not support a simple duration-based explanation, and self-assessment calibration suggested better alignment between perceived and demonstrated understanding in the Guided-LLM condition. Overall, LLM access alone appears to be an incomplete educational intervention. For Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED), the central design challenge is to scaffold how students use LLMs so that these systems function as partners in reasoning rather than answer-getting tools.

AI.tldr: 在本科概率统计课程中开展为期四周的准实验研究，对比无LLM访问、无限LLM访问和引导式LLM访问三种条件下学生的学习效果。结果表明，引导式使用LLM与更清晰的学习导向互动模式相关，并能在无辅助测验中表现更佳，提示仅提供LLM访问是不完整的教育干预。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地进入学生学习实践，其教育价值取决于它们是支持推理还是绕过学习过程。本研究旨在探讨"分配访问权限"与"实际互动质量"之间的差距，揭示单纯开放LLM使用的局限性。
AI.method: 在为期四周的暑期准实验项目中，将学生分配到三个平衡条件组：无LLM访问、无限LLM访问和引导式LLM访问。引导组与无限组使用相同平台，但接受明确培训与规则，强调推理导向求助、逐步提示、验证与伦理使用。所有测验和延迟期末考试均在无LLM或外部协助下完成，以分离AI辅助练习表现与独立学习表现。通过分析互动模式、无辅助测验成绩、可用时间及自我评估校准等指标进行比较。
AI.result: 引导式LLLM组表现出更清晰的学习导向互动模式，尤其在优先推理而非最终答案、寻求逐步支持方面。引导组在干预阶段的无辅助测验中表现更强；无限访问组似乎对辅助练习完成更有用，但并未持续提升独立表现。互动时长数据不支持简单的"用时解释"，自我评估校准显示引导组感知理解与实际理解的一致性更好。
AI.conclusion: 仅提供LLM访问是一项不完整的教育干预。AIED领域的核心设计挑战在于搭建学生使用LLM的支架，使这些系统作为推理伙伴而非答题工具发挥功能。引导式使用是实现LLM教育价值的关键。

title: Efficient Exploration for Iterative Nash Preference Optimization
summary: Preference alignment is central to improving large language models, but standard reward-based formulations can be restrictive when human preferences are cyclic, non-transitive, or otherwise not representable by a scalar reward. Nash Learning from Human Feedback (NLHF) addresses this limitation by modeling alignment as a preference game and targeting a Nash equilibrium rather than a reward maximizer. However, the learning-theoretic foundations of scalable NLHF remain limited. Existing regret guarantees rely on oracle-based methods that estimate a general preference model and solve KL-regularized minimax problems, while iterative NLHF methods directly optimize policy-level preference losses and are easier to implement but lack regret guarantees. We study online iterative NLHF under general preference models and identify exploration as the key obstacle. First, we show that standard iterative NLHF can suffer an exponential dependence on the KL-regularization parameter, revealing that implicit exploration through policy updates is insufficient for controlling regret. Second, we propose an explicitly exploratory iterative NLHF algorithm that combines SFT-based regularization with adversarial policy exploration. The resulting method retains the direct policy optimization structure of iterative NLHF, avoids explicit preference model estimation, and achieves an $O(\sqrt{T})$ regret bound without an exponential dependence on the KL-regularization parameter. We show that the regret can be improved to $O(\log(T))$ with access to a minimax oracle, clarifying the computational-statistical tradeoff in learning general preference games. Finally, we instantiate our method for LLM fine-tuning and evaluate it on \texttt{Llama-3-8B-Instruct} across multiple benchmarks, where explicit exploration yields consistent improvements over existing NLHF baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线迭代式 Nash Learning from Human Feedback (NLHF) 在一般偏好模型下的学习理论基础，指出标准方法的探索不足会导致对 KL 正则化参数的指数级依赖，并提出一种显式探索的算法以实现 O(√T) 的遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 标准基于标量奖励的偏好对齐方法难以处理循环、非传递的人类偏好。NLHF 将对齐建模为偏好博弈并瞄准 Nash 均衡，但现有方法在可扩展性和遗憾保证方面存在空白：基于 oracle 的方法依赖偏好模型估计与 KL 正则化 minimax 求解，而直接优化策略级偏好损失的迭代方法虽然实现简单但缺乏遗憾保证。学习理论基础（特别是迭代式 NLHF 在一般偏好模型下的 regret 分析）尚未建立。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：证明标准迭代式 NLHF 在一般偏好模型下的遗憾对 KL 正则化参数存在指数级依赖，揭示仅通过策略更新的隐式探索不足以控制 regret。2) 算法设计：提出显式探索的迭代式 NLHF 算法，结合 SFT 正则化（SFT-based regularization）与对抗式策略探索（adversarial policy exploration），保留直接策略优化结构，无需显式估计偏好模型。3) 计算-统计权衡：分析在 minimax oracle 可用时 regret 可降至 O(log(T))。4) LLM 微调实例化：在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 1) 理论结果：所提算法在一般偏好模型下实现 O(√T) 的遗憾界，且无对 KL 正则化参数的指数依赖；若进一步获得 minimax oracle，则遗憾可改进为 O(log(T))。2) 实验结果：在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 的多个基准测试上，显式探索机制相较现有 NLHF 基线取得持续一致的提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文明确了探索（exploration）是迭代式 NLHF 在一般偏好博弈中实现低 regret 的关键瓶颈，证明了标准方法因隐式探索不足而存在指数级依赖。所提出的显式探索算法兼具直接策略优化的简洁性与严格的 regret 保证，澄清了计算-统计权衡，并为 LLM 的偏好对齐提供了一种理论与实践兼备的方案。

title: Bridging Requirements and Architecture: Multi-Agent Orchestration with External Knowledge and Hierarchical Memory
comment: 39 pages, 7 images, 5 tables, Manuscript submitted to a Journal (2026)
summary: Software architecture design is a critical yet inherently complex and knowledge-intensive phase that requires balancing competing quality attributes and adapting to evolving requirements. Traditionally, this process has been time-consuming, labor-intensive, and heavily reliant on architects, often resulting in limited exploration of alternative architectural decompositions and styles, especially under the pressures of agile development. While LLM-based agents have shown promising performance across various software engineering tasks, their application to architecture design remains relatively scarce and requires systematic exploration. To address these challenges, we proposed MAAD (Multi-Agent Architecture Design), a knowledge-driven framework that orchestrates four specialized agents (i.e., Analyst, Modeler, Designer and Evaluator) to autonomously and collaboratively transform requirements specifications into comprehensive, multi-view architectural blueprints with quality attribute assessments. MAAD incorporates RAG to inject recognized architectural standards and patterns into the workflow and leverages a hierarchical memory mechanism that captures design history for iterative refinement. We evaluated MAAD through comparative experiments against MetaGPT, using quantitative architecture-level metrics across 10 case studies and qualitative feedback from industry architects on 10 real-world specifications. Results show that MAAD generates more complete, modular, and traceable architectures than the baseline, and its dedicated Evaluator agent autonomously produces structured quality evaluation reports that significantly reduce manual validation efforts. Furthermore, we found that the quality of the generated architecture heavily depends on the underlying LLM's reasoning capacity, with GPT-5.2 and Qwen3.5 outperforming other models across most evaluation settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MAAD（Multi-Agent Architecture Design）框架，一个知识驱动的多智能体架构设计系统，通过四个专业化智能体（Analyst、Modeler、Designer、Evaluator）协同工作，结合 RAG 注入架构标准与模式以及分层记忆机制（working、episodic、semantic memory），将软件需求规约自动转化为包含"4+1"视图模型、详细架构文档与质量评估报告的完整架构设计产物。
AI.motivation: 软件架构设计是一个知识密集型、依赖专家经验的复杂过程，传统方式耗时且在敏捷开发压力下对替代架构方案的探索有限。虽然基于 LLM 的智能体在其他软件工程任务中表现良好，但在架构设计领域的应用仍稀缺且缺乏系统探索。现有单智能体方法易产生跨视图不一致和需求覆盖不完整问题，而现有 MAS（如 MetaGPT）主要面向代码生成，缺乏架构特定的工作流、领域知识整合与系统化质量评估机制。
AI.method: 1. **四智能体协作架构**：Analyst 解析 SRS 生成 FR/NFR/ASR 结构化需求；Modeler 基于"4+1"视图模型（场景、逻辑、过程、开发、物理视图）生成 11 个 PlantUML UML 图；Designer 综合生成包含接口定义、部署配置、数据模式的架构文档；Evaluator 在每阶段进行评估并生成 ATAM 评估报告与失配分析报告。2. **RAG 知识注入**：基于 ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010/42020 标准及 Bass、Martin、Richards 等权威教材构建向量库，为 Modeler 和 Designer 提供 top-3 相关知识片段。3. **分层记忆机制**：working memory 存储当前迭代上下文；episodic memory 记录任务级设计经验与反思；semantic memory 蒸馏可复用的架构原则与设计模式。4. **迭代优化机制**：通过结构化提示和 patch-based 编辑策略，仅修改 Evaluator 反馈涉及的内容，保持已验证产物不变。5. **实验设计**：以 10 个信息物理系统 SRS（C2C、CCS、GCS、SFS 等）作为数据集，以 MetaGPT 为基线，采用 7 个架构级量化指标（CD、Coh、IC、SC、StC、CCD、SMCC），并结合 6 位资深架构师的半结构化访谈进行定性评估，比较 GPT-5.2、Qwen3.5、DeepSeek-R1、Llama3.3 四种底层 LLM。
AI.result: **RQ1（有效性）**：MAAD 在 10 个案例上的平均指标全面优于 MetaGPT——CD（1.77 vs 1.87）、Coh（0.69 vs 0.36）、IC（2.08 vs 0.00，MetaGPT 几乎未定义接口）、SC（0.03 vs 0.17）。MAAD 生成的类图粒度更细、领域实体更具体（如 PhysicsEngine、AuditLogger），并嵌入 ASR/NFR 追溯标注。访谈显示架构师认为产物结构化、符合行业标准早期交付水平。**RQ2（知识注入）**：RAG 显著提升架构抽象层次与标准合规性（引入 UML 构造型、中介层如 GameplayEngine），但对量化指标影响混合：CCD 在 6/10 项目降低、Coh 在 8/10 项目降低（因职责更细粒度分解）、IC 与 StC 呈项目特异性的双向变化。**RQ3（LLM 影响）**：GPT-5.2 与 Qwen3.5 生成更完整、模块化、需求可追溯的架构（含丰富接口与状态建模，StC 分别为 78.8 与 65.0）；DeepSeek-R1 抽象度不足；Llama3.3 仅生成 4 个泛化类（User/Admin/Game/Question），SC 高达 0.17，表现出"低复杂度等于高质量"的悖论。
AI.conclusion: MAAD 验证了知识驱动多智能体编排可显著提升软件架构设计自动化水平，在架构完整性、模块化与可追溯性上持续优于通用 MAS 基线，并能产出可操作的质量评估报告降低人工验证成本。框架效能本质上受限于底层 LLM 的推理能力——多智能体协作充当"能力放大器"而非"纠错器"，强模型表现更优，弱模型缺陷更显。RAG 能提升设计抽象与标准合规，但需自适应校准以避免过度碎片化。架构师仍需作为把关人进行验证与决策，特别是在安全关键系统中。论文最后提出四个未来方向：自适应知识检索与路由机制、领域特定微调与混合 LLM 编排、动态质量属性仿真工具集成、交互式协同设计与实现期快速验证代理。

title: Dr. DocBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Expert-Level and Difficult Document Parsing
summary: Document parsing and recognition are fundamental capabilities for vision-language models (VLMs) and document processing systems.
