AI.method: TS-OPSD 以一个熵坍缩的 RL checkpoint 为起点，将同一模型自身的 logits 通过高温（T=1.2）softmax 构造"自教师"分布（停止梯度），再用 on-policy rollout 采样，全词表 KL 散度（FKL 或 RKL）将该更平滑的分布蒸馏回学生参数。流程为：θ_RL-collapse → 高温 OPSD → θ_reheat → 继续 RL。FKL 梯度形式为 q(v)−p_T(v)，实现"结构化平滑"（保序重新加权）；RKL 在自温度耦合下可简化为 ∝ −(1−1/T)∇H(q)，即局部等价于最大化熵，温度仅作为梯度幅度的缩放因子。训练以熵恢复至 0.12 nats 以上为停止条件。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B-Base 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 上、基于 DAPO 训练与 DAPO-Math-17K 数据，跨 MATH-500、AIME24/25/26、OlymMATH 评测：DAPO w/ PR-FKL 取得最佳平均成绩（4B: Avg avg@8=31.46, pass@8=46.05；8B: 36.60/54.74），稳定优于 DAPO 基线及 Rollout Reheating（仅在 rollout 阶段升 T=1.2）。分析显示：中间层表征 CKA 接近 1、Top-10 token 集合几乎完全保留、MATH-500/GPQA 推理能力在 OPSD 过程中不退化；KL 集中在 0.002 nats 附近，呈"支持集保持型概率重分配"。观察到两阶段熵增长动态：缓慢平滑期 → 跳变（因低概率推理路径进入 on-policy 分布），且跳变后 fork position 提前、log-prob 与 edit distance 同步变化，符合自回归因果依赖假说。在 2048 提示的稀缺数据设定下，policy reheating 还能稳定训练、抑制梯度尖峰和奖励退化。计算开销约为完整 RL 训练的 15–17%。
AI.conclusion: TS-OPSD 将温度的探索效应从临时解码控制内化为策略参数化属性，作为"坍缩后"的轻量级模块化干预，可在不牺牲中间表征、候选支持集和已有推理能力的前提下恢复熵与 rollout 多样性。实验证明它能为继续 RL 提供比标准继续训练和 rollout 升温都更强的初始化，并能在数据稀缺场景中提供稳定化收益。这启发将"利用"与"探索恢复"解耦为独立阶段的 RL 训练流水线，以突破熵坍缩瓶颈、延长面向推理的 RL 训练。

title: Towards Lightweight Reliability: Using Soft Prompts for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Language Models
comment: 20 pages, 5 tables, 2 figures. Accepted for publication in DBSec 2026. The final publication will be available at Springer
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have seen widespread adoption across various domains, yet their reliability is frequently undermined by hallucinations - responses that are plausible-sounding but factually incorrect. In high-stakes domains, these errors can reduce trust and introduce real-world risk. To address this challenge, we present a parameter-efficient approach that uses soft prompts to mitigate hallucinated content and promote responsible abstention in generative question-answering (QA) tasks. Our method, called Responsible Contrastive Soft Prompting (RCSP), uses a composite loss to train soft prompts that balance three goals: suppressing hallucinatory content, encouraging abstention under uncertainty, and preserving or improving factual recall. To achieve these goals, we incorporate contrastive loss, curriculum learning, and KL regularization into our training mechanism. We evaluate our approach on five diverse generative QA datasets using an LLM-as-a-Judge framework. Experimental results on the Gemma 3 (12B) and Llama 3.1 (8B) backbones demonstrate that RCSP effectively balances factual recall with hallucination suppression and abstention, yielding a generally superior F-score over standard reasoning and instruction-based prompting baselines. Notably, these improvements are achieved by training only a fraction of the parameters required by other tuning techniques. Our results demonstrate that soft prompts provide a modular and computationally efficient path toward improving LLM reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"负责任对比软提示（RCSP）"的参数高效方法，通过在冻结的大语言模型上附加可学习的软提示来缓解生成式问答中的幻觉问题，并鼓励模型在不确定时负责任地弃答。该方法在Gemma 3 (12B)和Llama 3.1 (8B)上仅训练约0.009%的参数即可在多个QA基准上取得最优F-score。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在安全敏感领域广泛应用，但其生成的"幻觉"内容（看似合理但事实错误）会降低系统可靠性并带来实际风险。现有方法面临三重困境：抑制幻觉往往会损害事实回忆能力；鼓励弃答又会使模型过度保守；标准QA基准对弃答和错误回答一视同仁，反而激励模型猜测。此外，全参数微调方法计算成本高且可能引发灾难性遗忘，限制了其在实际部署中的可用性。
AI.method: RCSP采用两阶段框架：第一阶段离线训练软提示，第二阶段部署时将选定的软提示与用户问题拼接后送入冻结的LLM生成回答。核心是复合损失函数，由对比损失和效用损失两部分组成：(1) 对比损失L_contrast在(q, h, f)三元组上训练，通过负交叉熵惩罚幻觉回答h，同时结合课程学习（μ参数从μ_start线性增长到μ_end）使训练从弃答监督逐步转向事实回答监督，并通过KL正则化约束模型分布不过度偏离基线模型；(2) 效用损失L_utility在(q, f)对上通过交叉熵和KL正则化保持模型的事实问答能力。整个框架仅在输入层训练少量软提示token（如40个），无需修改backbone参数。
AI.result: 在HaluEval、TruthfulQA、SimpleQA、MedHallu和WebQuestions五个生成式QA数据集上，使用LLM-as-a-Judge（GPT-4.1）评估，RCSP在Gemma 3 (12B)和Llama 3.1 (8B)两个backbone的大多数数据集上均取得最高F-score。例如在Gemma 3上，HaluEval的F-score从基线的38.77提升到40.21，TruthfulQA从31.09提升到31.77，SimpleQA从9.17提升到10.51。在效率方面，RCSP仅训练约115万参数（约0.009%），远少于QLoRA的1.202%和全参数微调的100%。消融实验表明课程学习和KL正则化贡献最大，移除课程学习使TruthfulQA上的幻觉率从65.90%升至71.43%。敏感性分析显示最佳配置为40个软提示token和128的隐藏维度。唯一未取得最佳的场景是Llama 3.1在MedHallu上的表现，表明方法在专业领域可能受模型架构影响。
AI.conclusion: RCSP为研究问题RQ1–RQ3提供了肯定回答：能够在不修改backbone参数的前提下促进负责任弃答并降低幻觉率；在抑制幻觉的同时基本不损害事实回忆能力；并且以极少的可训练参数提供了一种模块化、计算高效的幻觉缓解方案。未来工作可探索提示路由（根据部署需求动态选择不同软提示）、与推理时干预方法的结合，以及超越生成式QA的更广泛评估场景。

title: Unlocking the Black Box of Latent Reasoning: An Interpretability-Guided Approach to Intervention
summary: Latent reasoning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform multi-step inference within continuous hidden states, offering efficiency gains over explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, the opacity of these continuous thought vectors hinders their reliability and controllability. This paper bridges the gap between mechanistic interpretability and actionable control. We first present a systematic analysis using structural, causal, and geometric probes, revealing that latent vectors encode compressed, faithful representations of reasoning steps, with early vectors acting as critical causal hubs. Building on this, we operationalize these interpretability insights into a suite of training-free, decode-time interventions that refine the latent reasoning process by imposing the identified geometric and semantic priors. Extensive experiments across multiple model scales and diverse task domains demonstrate that our approaches consistently improve reasoning accuracy. Our interpretability-guided interventions consistently unlock latent capabilities and improve reasoning accuracy without any parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套统一的"可解释性引导的潜在推理干预"框架,通过对连续思维(continuous thought)向量进行结构化、因果和几何层面的机制可解释性分析,发现潜向量是压缩且忠实的推理步骤表征,早期潜向量是关键因果枢纽;基于这些洞察,设计了一系列无需训练、解码时即可施加几何与语义先验的干预方法,在多种模型规模(3B/8B)和任务(GSM8K、GSM-Hard、SVAMP、StrategyQA)上稳定提升推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 显式思维链(CoT)虽然有效,但存在生成冗长、延迟高、易累积错误等局限。潜在推理(在连续隐状态中完成多步推理)虽有潜力,但其"连续思维向量"的可解释性与可控性严重不足,尤其是在大模型上的可扩展性未被充分验证。核心动机在于:回答"潜向量是否真正编码了推理步骤"这一基础问题,并将可解释性洞察转化为实际可用的解码时控制手段。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了潜在推理"可解释性—可干预性"的统一框架,证明连续思维向量并非训练目标的人为产物,而是受明确几何与因果先验约束的结构化语义轨迹;基于此设计的训练免费解码时干预,在数学(OOD)与常识推理、3B至8B模型规模上均获得稳定且可迁移的准确率提升,实现了"可解释性即能力提升"。局限在于:解码时干预引入额外梯度与投影计算开销,带来一定的推理延迟;未来工作将这些可解释性先验直接纳入训练监督信号,有望在消除延迟的同时进一步提升潜推理性能。

title: Don't Read Everything: A Curvature-Conditioned Query for Linear Attention
summary: Linear attention reduces the quadratic cost of softmax attention by maintaining a recurrent fast-weight state, but it consistently lags on in-context retrieval and long-context tasks. Existing remedies act on the write side of memory through gating, delta updates, or kernel feature maps, but the read step is left unchanged: every past key contributes additively to the output, so useful targets are diluted by the bulk of stored vectors. We borrow one specific piece of softmax's geometry to construct a cheap read-time contraction of the query. A second-order Taylor expansion of the softmax log-partition at the isotropic-attention point gives a local quadratic model whose curvature coincides with the running key covariance, a quantity that can be maintained with the same recurrent/chunkwise mechanism as the linear-attention state. The associated linear operator contracts the query along the high-density directions of memory before it reads the state. We call this mechanism Curvature-Conditioned Query (CCQ). CCQ modifies only the read step and is composable with any linear-attention backbone. Attached to GLA and Gated DeltaNet, it improves perplexity, zero-shot downstream accuracy, S-NIAH retrieval at and beyond the training context, length-extrapolation perplexity from 4K to 20K, and LongBench accuracy, at small extra cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出曲率条件查询（CCQ），一种针对线性注意力的读取侧校正机制。它通过对softmax对数配分函数在各项同性注意力点进行二阶泰勒展开，利用运行键协方差构建线性收缩算子，在查询读取状态前沿记忆高密度方向对其进行收缩。该方法可即插即用地附加到任意线性注意力骨干（如GLA和Gated DeltaNet），在语言建模、检索、外推和长上下文理解任务上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力通过维护循环快速权重状态将softmax注意力的二次成本降为线性，但在上下文检索和长上下文任务上持续落后于softmax注意力。现有改进方法（门控、delta更新、核特征映射）均作用于写入侧，读取步骤保持不变：每个历史键对输出贡献固定加性分量，导致有用目标被大量存储向量稀释。softmax注意力中的归一化项（log-sum-exp）通过让竞争性的键相互竞争来抑制拥挤方向的匹配，而线性注意力丢失了这一归一化项。本文从softmax几何结构出发，构建一种轻量级的读取时查询修正，以弥合softmax与线性注意力之间的差距。
AI.method: 核心方法是曲率条件查询（CCQ）。具体地：1）对softmax对数配分函数A_t(q)在q=0（各项同性注意力点）处进行二阶泰勒展开，得到局部二次模型，其Hessian恰好等于运行键的样本协方差Σ_t = C̄_t - μ_tμ_t⊤。2）利用该Hessian构建清洗算子I - λ_t Σ_t作用于查询q_t，得到清洗后的查询q_t^clean。3）标量门控λ_t = σ(W_λ q_t + b_λ) ∈ (0,1)由查询条件化生成，控制收缩强度。4）运行协方差可通过与线性注意力状态相同的循环/分块机制维护，仅需额外的d_k×d_k矩阵和d_k向量。5）该清洗算子沿Σ_t特征基中具有大特征值的方向（即记忆高密度方向）收缩查询，而对正交于记忆的方向保持不变。6）CCQ仅修改读取步骤，与任意线性注意力骨干的写入规则可组合使用，无需修改状态更新函数。
AI.result: 在500M和1.3B参数规模上系统评估：1）语言建模：CCQ-Gated DeltaNet在500M上取得最佳WikiText PPL（25.59）和7任务平均准确率（49.87%），CCQ-GLA在1.3B上取得最佳WikiText PPL（16.92）、LAMBADA准确率（47.82）和HellaSwag（59.14）。2）合成检索（S-NIAH）：CCQ在4K和8K（训练上下文之外）大幅恢复或超越骨干网络性能；CCQ-GLA在1.3B的S-NIAH-1 4K上提升+49.0，S-NIAH-2 8K上提升+29.4，S-NIAH-3 4K上提升+35.6。3）长度外推（4K→20K）：CCQ变体在六个长上下文语料库上的PPL均优于其骨干网络1-2.5点。4）LongBench（14任务零样本）：CCQ-GLA取得最佳14任务平均准确率15.77（+1.70于GLA骨干）。5）计算开销：CCQ增加平坦的约1-2毫秒/步开销（不随上下文增长），在H200上测得。6）经验验证：在Qwen3-4B和Gated DeltaNet 500M上验证，检索相关键确实位于记忆高方差子空间之外，几何前提成立。
AI.conclusion: CCQ是一种作用于读取侧的修正机制，通过沿记忆高密度方向收缩查询来弥补线性注意力缺失的softmax竞争机制。它由softmax对数配分函数在各项同性点的二阶泰勒展开推导而来，运行协方差可由与骨干状态相同的循环/分块机制维护。CCQ与任意线性注意力写入规则可组合，在GLA和Gated DeltaNet上以较小额外成本在语言建模、检索、长度外推和长上下文理解方面均带来一致改进。该工作识别出读取步骤是缩小softmax-线性差距的独立杠杆，与写入侧的正交方法互补。局限：仅在500M和1.3B规模、两个分块式线性注意力骨干、四类评估上验证；未在7B+规模、选择性状态空间层或智能体/多轮基准上测试。

title: Towards Optimal Robustness in Learning-Augmented Paging
summary: Learning-augmented paging has been extensively studied in recent years. A key advantage over naive ML-based approaches is \emph{bounded robustness}, which guarantees worst-case performance even when predictions are inaccurate, making these algorithms valuable for real-world systems. Prior work achieves robustness bounds of $2H_k + O(1)$ in the randomized setting, leaving a gap to the optimal competitive ratio $H_k$. In this paper, we study how to close this gap. We begin by reviewing online optimality and proving a new property of the latest $H_k$-competitive algorithm, which facilitates our analysis in the learning-augmented setting. Then, we review existing learning-augmented paging algorithms and introduce a unifying primitive, the \emph{relative prediction budget}, which captures the essence of establishing robustness and reveals that prior algorithms either overuse or underutilize predictions. Guided by the above analysis, we develop a new framework that achieves the best-possible robustness up to an additive constant for learning-augmented paging: $H_k + O(1)$. Experiments further demonstrate strong practical performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对学习增强分页（learning-augmented paging）问题，提出了一种新的算法框架 RPB-OnOPT（及其具体实现 RPB-OM），在保持完美预测下 1-一致性（1-consistency）的同时，将鲁棒性（robustness）从先前最优的 2H_k + O(1) 提升至接近理论最优的 H_k + O(1)，首次将加性常数差距缩小到该问题长期未决的界，并通过 SPEC CPU 2006 真实负载实验验证了优异性能。
AI.motivation: 在线分页是系统与算法领域的经典问题，其随机最优竞争比为 H_k（调和数）。近年来，融合 ML 预测的"学习增强"算法成为研究热点，但现有方法在面对任意对抗性预测时，最优鲁棒性仅能达到 2H_k + O(1)（例如 PredictiveMarker 的 4H_k、LMarker 的 2H_k+4），与离线最优 H_k 之间存在不可忽略的乘法因子差距。此外，已有工作缺乏对"有界鲁棒性"本质机制的统一理解，无法同时兼顾一致性、鲁棒性与实用性。因此，亟需新的理论工具来弥合这一差距，并揭示已有算法过度使用或未充分利用预测的根本原因。
AI.method: 1. **在线最优性的新分析**：通过分层（layer partition）与工作函数（work function）刻画有效配置集 V 的不确定性，揭示 L_0 请求引入最大不确定性的结构特征，并基于此给出 OM（OnlineMin）算法 H_k-竞争性的新证明及新性质（势函数在惰性对手请求下的负变化下界 Lemma 5.6）。2. **统一原语"相对预测预算"（RPB）**：将现有学习增强分页算法抽象为相对于鲁棒基线（Marker/LRU/OM）赚取与消耗预测预算的机制，指出 PredictiveMarker 的固定阈值 H_k 导致过度使用预测，而 LMarker 的阈值 1 则浪费较准确的预测。3. **新框架 RPB-OnOPT**：将 RPB 集成到 OnOPT 框架中，在 L_0 未命中时强制使用预测（L_0-miss 必启用预测以保证 1-一致性），在惰性请求时基于有效性指标 U(ω) ≤ (Y+2)/e − 2 的细粒度判断赚取预算，并按需消耗预算进行预测驱动的逐出。4. **势函数分析**：构造新势函数 Φ(ω) = ϕ(ω) + D(ω) + B(ω)，通过 Gate-fail 与 Gate-pass 分情形证明 RPB-OM 满足 H_k + O(1) 竞争比。5. **平滑性分析**：通过"活跃残差势"证明 O(1 + log(η₁/cost(OPT))) 的平滑性。
AI.result: 1. 理论方面：RPB-OM 实现了 **1-一致性**（完美预测下达到离线最优）和 **(H_k + O(1))-鲁棒性**（在任意对抗性预测下），后者是直至加性常数的最优界——达到 H_k 鲁棒性需完全不使用预测，与学习增强设定矛盾。2. 算法计算开销为 O(log k) 每请求，与 OnOPT/OM 同阶。3. 在 SPEC CPU 2006 benchmark 上（缓存 2MB/16 路），使用 PLECO 与 POPU 两种真实预测器时，RPB-OM 取得最佳平均命中率（PLECO 22.4–22.7%，POPU 23.8–24.5%），优于 LMarker、PredictiveMarker、F&R、BlindOracle&LRU、OnOPT-OM 等所有基线。4. 在 bzip、mcf、omnetpp、xalanc 等 BlindOracle 表现劣于经典启发式（即预测误差较大）的负载上仍保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过引入"相对预测预算"这一统一原语，揭示了学习增强分页算法建立有界鲁棒性的核心机制，并基于对在线最优性结构（工作函数分层、惰性对手策略）的深入分析，提出 RPB-OnOPT 框架，将该问题的鲁棒性界限从长期存在的 2H_k + O(1) 推进到接近最优的 H_k + O(1)，同时保持 1-一致性和良好的平滑性。理论与实验均表明，新算法在充分利用较准确预测与防御任意对抗性预测之间取得最佳平衡。未来工作方向包括将 RPB 设计推广到其他可能存在"过度/不足使用预测"问题的学习增强算法中。

title: Semantic Retrieval for Product Search in E-Commerce
summary: Semantic retrieval in e-commerce must handle short, noisy, and colloquial queries over large product catalogs with fine-grained attribute distinctions. We present a Siamese LLM dual-encoder trained through a two-stage pipeline: contrastive learning with a false-negative margin mask to prevent penalization of near-duplicate products, followed by Relative Odds Alignment for Retrieval (ROAR), a preference optimization objective that extends Bradley-Terry to variable-sized graded relevance groups via consecutive odds-ratio margins. The training corpus mirrors this progression - substitute query-product pairs provide coarse semantic supervision in Stage 1 and graded relevance annotations drive fine-grained ranking in Stage 2. The resulting system accurately retrieves exact matches while correctly ordering substitutes and complementary products, with gains confirmed across query-frequency strata and business verticals, and statistical significance validated through live A/B deployment at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Siamese LLM双编码器的两阶段电商语义检索系统，使用Qwen3-Embedding-4B作为骨干网络，通过对比学习（带假阴性边际掩码）和新提出的ROAR偏好对齐目标，在Flipkart平台实现了显著的效果提升。
AI.motivation: 电商搜索中用户查询短小、嘈杂且口语化，需要在庞大商品目录中识别细粒度属性差异。传统的基于词法匹配或小型BERT双编码器的检索方法在精确意图匹配和同义/互补产品排序方面存在不足，亟需一种兼顾效率和精度的语义检索方案。
AI.method: 两阶段训练流水线：(1) 阶段一采用InfoNCE风格的对比学习，使用假阴性边际掩码（δ=0.1）避免惩罚近重复产品；(2) 阶段二提出ROAR（Relative Odds Alignment for Retrieval）目标，将Bradley-Terry框架扩展到可变大小的分级相关性组，通过连续对的odds-ratio边际优化排序。模型基于Qwen3-Embedding-4B，使用LoRA（r=32, α=64）微调，Matryoshka表示学习支持256维部署。训练数据来自搜索日志、人类标注、推荐系统同义词、会话查询重构和LLM数据增强。
AI.result: 离线评估（~25K查询）：MAP@8提升+5.57，NDCG@8提升+3.56，AUC提升+13.13（256维部署）。长尾/一次性查询提升最大（MAP@8 +8.54），各业务线均有一致提升（其中Mobiles +14.41）。在线A/B测试（三周）：CTR +2.39%，ATC +4.58%，订单数 +2.62%。在1g.18GB H200 MIG分区上，峰值680 QPS时P50延迟80ms，P99延迟236ms。
AI.conclusion: 大规模LLM嵌入模型经过领域适配和优化后可显著提升生产级电商搜索的相关性。消融实验证明每个组件均有贡献，其中ROAR带来最大单点算法增益（无索引成本），骨干网络从0.6B扩展到4B和数据增强对长尾查询尤为重要。该工作为电商领域大规模语义检索的端到端部署提供了完整方案。

title: Multi-Agent Computer Use
summary: Computer use agents (CUAs) today are primarily deployed as single serial agents. This setup is suboptimal for complex long-horizon tasks that benefit from task decomposition, parallel execution, and consistent re-planning based on new information. In this paper, we argue that we should instead move towards evaluating and building multi-agent computer use (MACU) systems. These systems, which emphasize planning and parallel execution, alleviate many of the shortcomings of single-agent CUAs. We propose a general multi-agent setup in which a manager model decomposes computer use tasks as a directed acyclic graph (DAG), encoding relevant dependencies and goals for subagents. At each iteration, the manager dispatches parallel CUA subagents to carry out nodes on the ready frontier of the DAG, and continuously revises the DAG (adding, canceling, or rewriting nodes) as new findings arrive from subagents. This design treats the partially observable environment of computer use as a first class challenge: information that downstream agents may not be able to re-observe are retained and passed forward through the manager and DAG structure. We demonstrate that MACU consistently improves over strong single-agent baselines by $3.4-25.5\%$ on desktop (OSWorld) and web navigation (Online-Mind2Web, WebTailBench, Odysseys) benchmarks, exhibits more favorable test-time scaling, and solves complex long-horizon tasks where single-agent CUAs get stuck. On Odysseys, a long-horizon web navigation benchmark, MACU improves average task completion wall-clock time by ${\sim} 1.5 \times$, demonstrating its efficacy in speeding up traditionally slow CUA pipelines. Our findings highlight that multi-agent coordination is a promising axis for scaling computer use agents to work productively for longer and more effectively. We release all code and interactive visualizations at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出多智能体计算机使用（MACU）系统，通过管理器模型将任务分解为有向无环图（DAG）并并行调度子智能体执行，在多个基准测试中相比单智能体基线取得3.4-25.5%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 当前计算机使用智能体（CUAs）主要以单智能体串行方式部署，在处理复杂长视野任务时存在不足：缺乏任务分解、并行执行和基于新信息的重新规划能力。论文主张应转向构建和评估多智能体计算机使用系统。
AI.method: 提出一种通用多智能体框架：管理器模型将计算机使用任务分解为有向无环图（DAG），编码子智能体间的依赖关系和目标；在每次迭代中，管理器并行调度CUA子智能体执行DAG就绪前沿的节点，并根据子智能体反馈持续修订DAG（添加、取消或重写节点）。该设计将计算机使用部分可观察环境作为核心挑战，由管理器通过DAG结构保留并传递下游智能体可能无法重新观察的信息。
AI.result: 在桌面（OSWorld）和网页导航（Online-Mind2Web、WebTailBench、Odysseys）等基准测试中，MACU相比强单智能体基线持续提升3.4-25.5%；具有更优的测试时扩展性；能解决单智能体CUA陷入困境的复杂长视野任务；在Odysseys上将平均任务完成墙钟时间提升约1.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现多智能体协调是扩展计算机使用智能体以更长时间、更高效率工作的一个有前景的方向。论文开源了所有代码和交互式可视化工具。

title: Resonant Context Anchoring: Decoupling Attention Routing and Signal Gain at Inference Time
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently exhibit "contextual disregard" when faced with input evidence that conflicts with their internal parametric memory, leading to persistent factual hallucinations. Existing mitigation strategies primarily rely on suppressing specific neuron activations or employing computationally expensive contrastive decoding mechanisms, which often result in increased perplexity or significantly elevated inference latency. To address these limitations, we propose Resonant Context Anchoring (RCA), a lightweight inference-time intervention method grounded in the perspective of residual stream signal dynamics. RCA aims to resolve the signal attenuation of external evidence during its propagation through deep networks. The core mechanism involves the orthogonal decoupling of routing logic and information magnitude within the self-attention module. By utilizing raw pre-softmax attention scores as an instantaneous metric of semantic alignment, we construct a dynamic gain field via non-linear rectification to selectively amplify the norms of value vectors corresponding to context tokens, without altering the attention probability distribution. This mechanism effectively elevates the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of input evidence within the residual stream mixture, thereby robustly anchoring the generation trajectory to the truthful context during inference. Extensive experiments on the Llama-3 model series demonstrate that RCA significantly improves contextual faithfulness across multiple factual consistency and strong knowledge-conflict tasks, effectively suppressing parametric hallucinations. Furthermore, results confirm that as a training-free and computationally negligible plug-and-play module, RCA achieves a Pareto improvement in faithfulness and fluency while maintaining the model's general language understanding capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Resonant Context Anchoring (RCA),一种面向大语言模型推理时的轻量级干预方法。其核心思想是将自注意力机制中的"路由决策"（注意力概率分布）与"信息增益"（value 向量幅度）正交解耦,利用原始 pre-softmax 分数经 Softplus 整流后构建动态增益场,选择性放大与 query 语义对齐的上下文 token 的 value 向量模长,从而提升残差流中上下文信号的信噪比(SNR),在不改变注意力分布的前提下抑制参数化幻觉。方法在 Llama-3-8B/70B 上的多任务实验中实现忠实度与流畅度的 Pareto 改善,且无需训练、计算开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: LLM 在面对与内部参数化记忆冲突的外部证据时,常出现"contextual disregard"现象——优先依赖预训练先验而忽略输入上下文,导致事实性幻觉。现有缓解方法(如对比解码 CD/CAD)需多次前向传播,推理延迟翻倍;激活工程类方法(如抑制特定 attention head 或神经元)则会破坏句法/语义结构,提升 perplexity 并降低流畅度。作者认为根本问题不在于模型无法识别相关上下文(路由错误),而在于深层网络中上下文信号的"能量不足",被 FFN 注入的参数化"噪声"所淹没——即信号增益赤字。
AI.method: 1. **子空间分解视角**:将 Transformer 第 l 层隐藏状态 h_t 视为上下文子空间 𝒫_ctx 与参数化子空间 𝒫_param 的线性叠加;当 ‖𝒫_param(h_t)‖ ≫ ‖𝒫_ctx(h_t)‖ 时,生成轨迹坍缩到内部先验流形。2. **正交解耦机制**:不改变 softmax 概率分布,仅在 value 投影阶段施加调制。对第 h 个注意力头,计算原始对齐谱 s_{t,i} = q_t^T k_i / √d_k,经 Softplus 整流得到 token 级增益 λ_{t,i} = 1 + γ·ln(1+exp(s_{t,i}))(γ 为共振灵敏度系数);再以 Hadamard 积 ṽ_i = λ_{t,i}·v_i 调制 value 矩阵。3. **渐近 SNR 分析**:证明在相关上下文集合中,λ>1 提升有效信号能量,而对不相关 token 因 s<0 使 λ≈1,从而保证 SNR_RCA = (1+γψ̄)·SNR_base > SNR_base,单调改善外部证据敏感度。4. **理论性质**:Softplus 整流确保 s→-∞ 时 λ→1(对噪声零干扰),s>0 时近似线性单调增长,且整体保持流形平滑。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 与 Llama-3-70B-Instruct 上评估:① **XSum 摘要忠实度**:8B 模型 FactKB 47.61→50.14、AlignScore 58.20→59.45,ROUGE-L 维持 19.90→20.03(兼顾信息量);70B 模型 FactKB 61.32→61.72。② **强知识冲突**:NQ-Swap 上 8B EM 60.62→64.54(+3.92),70B EM 76.11→77.46;MemoTrap 上 70B Micro Acc 66.52→77.35(+10.83),证明对参数化吸引子的强健脱离。③ **超参敏感度**:γ 在 [0.04, 0.05] 区间达到"甜点",70B 因嵌入范数更大而 γ=0.05 略优;γ>0.08 后性能迅速退化,γ=0.12 时 8B 跌至 52.10,确定 0.08 为安全硬阈值。④ **安全性/通用能力**:在 TruthfulQA、TriviaQA、PopQA 等无相关上下文任务上偏差<0.1%,验证共振机制在低/负对齐时自动休眠,可作为常驻解码策略。
AI.conclusion: RCA 提供了一种高效、免训练、可解释的推理时干预范式,从信号处理视角揭示 LLM 幻觉的本质是上下文信号在残差流中的能量衰减而非路由失败。理论上正交解耦路由与增益,实践中通过 Softplus 动态注入能量,既避免了对比解码的高延迟,也规避了粗粒度激活抑制对语言流畅度的损害。实验证明其在 Llama-3 系列上实现忠实度与流畅度的 Pareto 改善,并具备架构无关性(作用于通用 QKV 交互逻辑)。该工作不仅为高可靠性生成系统提供了工业级方案,也为从信号动力学角度理解 Transformer 内部机制开辟了新路径。

title: Machine Learning for Coding Retail Product Names to Consumer-Price Categories: A Rule-plus-Bag-of-Words Pipeline with Reliability-Weighted Human-in-the-Loop Labeling
comment: 11 pages, 3 tables. Methodology paper; illustrative experiments only, no proprietary data
summary: Consumer-price measurement increasingly draws on alternative data sources -- scanner, web-scraped, and transaction/receipt data. A recurring obstacle is that product descriptions in such sources are short, noisy, and abbreviated, with no standard product code, so each item must first be mapped to a consumption classification (e.g., the UN COICOP scheme) before prices can be compared. This paper studies that mapping as a general, reproducible method. The pipeline is: (i) text normalization and tokenization of noisy item names; (ii) a prefix-tree (trie) rule-based pre-classifier driven by per-category key-phrases and stop-phrases; and (iii) a per-category binary confirmation model deciding whether an item belongs to a tentatively assigned category. For labels at scale we use a human-in-the-loop protocol in which annotators give a binary valid/reject judgment, aggregated by a dynamically updated reliability weight; the model joins the same rule, enabling continual fine-tuning. Our empirical finding is deflationary: in a controlled, leakage-free study (one category, real positives vs. hard negatives, five seeds), bag-of-words models essentially saturate the task (F1 about 0.99) -- a linear classifier matches a multilayer perceptron, explicit word-order (n-gram) features add nothing, and about 67 labeled examples already suffice. A Monte-Carlo study of the labeling protocol shows the reliability-weighted vote barely beats plain majority (its additive weights saturate) while Dawid-Skene recovers labels markedly better. We also discuss price-level quality control and design lessons for statistical offices considering transaction data. All figures are illustrative; no confidential data, code, or documentation is reproduced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于将嘈杂的零售交易/收据产品名称映射到消费分类（如UN COICOP）的可复现混合方法。该方法结合了基于前缀树（trie）的规则预分类器、每类别二元确认模型（词袋表示），以及带可靠性权重更新的人工参与标注协议。核心经验发现是"通货紧缩式"的：词袋模型在该任务上基本饱和（F₁≈0.99），显式词序特征无附加价值，约67个标注样本即已足够；而可靠性加权投票仅略优于简单多数票，Dawid-Skene方法在标注恢复上显著更优。
AI.motivation: 消费者价格指数（CPI）测量越来越多地依赖扫描数据、网络抓取数据和交易/收据数据等替代数据源，但这些来源中的产品描述短小、嘈杂且缺乏标准产品代码，必须先映射到消费分类才能进行价格比较。本文旨在研究这种映射作为一个通用、可复现的方法。
AI.method: 方法采用三级流水线：(1) 领域特定的文本规范化与分词；(2) 基于前缀树（trie）的规则预分类器，由每类别的关键短语和停止短语驱动；(3) 每类别的二元确认模型（词袋表示的线性分类器或浅层MLP），决定项目是否属于暂定分配的类别。标注采用人工参与协议：多名标注者给出二元有效/拒绝判断，通过动态更新的可靠性权重进行聚合，模型本身也作为投票者参与同一规则，从而支持持续微调。
AI.result: 在受控、无泄漏的实验（单类别——砂糖，711个正例与978个硬负例，5个随机种子）中：词袋模型基本饱和任务（线性分类器F₁=0.999，MLP F₁=0.988）；词1-2-gram和1-3-gram特征未带来提升（F₁仍为0.999）；字符n-gram略差（F₁=0.972）；约67个标注样本即达F₁≈0.986。蒙特卡洛模拟标注协议（1500项，12名标注者，60次运行）显示：可靠性加权投票仅略优于多数票（k=3时相同，k≥5时仅+1至+3点），而Dawid-Skene在所有k值下均显著领先（+6至+8点）。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出核心结论：在产品名称确认任务上，轻量级规则加词袋模型的流水线已足够，深度词序敏感模型并非必需。但作者也指出研究的局限性——仅测试了一个类别，缺乏CNN/LSTM的匹配比较，未量化覆盖率或与实地采集价格的吻合度。论文还自我批评地指出可靠性加权规则因加性更新饱和而效果有限，建议未来用Dawid-Skene等潜在能力模型替代以提高标注准确性，同时为考虑采用交易数据的统计机构提供了设计经验。

title: Unveiling the Entropy Dynamics of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: This paper investigates the entropy dynamics of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and uncovers a consistent two-phase structure: an Uncertainty Region of exploration transitioning sharply to a Confidence Region of convergence. We demonstrate that the Confidence Region possesses two critical properties: 1) High Reliability -- answers in the confidence region become highly accurate and stable, and 2) High Redundancy -- models generate unnecessary tokens long after reaching the correct answer. These properties unlock more efficient and reliable inference strategies: 1) Early Exit leverages reliability and redundancy to terminate computation safely when returns diminish, and 2)Test-Time Scaling uses the Confidence Region signal to prioritize converged trajectories. To operationalize these insights, we formulate Confidence Region detection as a sequential change-point detection problem, being the first to apply classical change-point methods to monitor CoT reasoning. Using the Cumulative Sum (CUSUM) algorithm, a statistically optimal change-point detector, we develop a training-free framework for real-time inference control. Experiments show our approach establishes a superior Pareto-frontier for early exit. CUSUM achieves 63.06% accuracy with 11.1% token reduction, outperforming DEER and Dynasor by 3.28% and 4.36% in accuracy respectively. For test-time scaling, CUSUM-weighted voting consistently outperforms self-consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地分析了思维链（CoT）推理过程中的预测熵动态，揭示了CoT推理遵循"不确定性区域→置信区域"的两阶段结构，并首次将经典的序贯变点检测方法（CUSUM算法）应用于CoT推理监控，实现了无需训练的实时早停和测试时缩放策略，在准确率和token节省方面均优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于CoT推理的局部机制（如单步、层间或局部状态转移），而对其全局动态——推理如何从探索过渡到收敛——缺乏系统性理解。这一全局视角对于回答"推理是渐进式精炼还是突然的顿悟时刻"这一根本问题至关重要。同时，准确识别推理收敛时刻是实现高效推理（早停）和高质量答案聚合（测试时缩放）的关键前提。
AI.method: 1. **熵动态建模**：在每个推理步骤后插入答案诱导提示（如"</think> The answer is \boxed"），提取中间答案，计算答案token的预测熵序列。2. **两阶段结构发现**：通过在Bespoke-Stratos-17k数据集的100个实例上对齐轨迹并归一化，可视化发现熵从高熵探索区域突然转变到低熵收敛区域。3. **变点检测形式化**：将置信区域检测建模为序贯变点检测问题，采用CUSUM（累积和）算法递归聚合对数似然比，统计最优地检测从不确定性区域到置信区域的转移。4. **应用框架**：(a) 早停——实时监控CUSUM统计量S_i，超过阈值h即终止生成；(b) 测试时缩放——用最终CUSUM统计量S_final作为轨迹质量指标进行加权投票。
AI.result: 1. **两阶段结构具有普适性**：在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B、Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507和Qwen3-14B三个模型上均观察到一致的"不确定性→置信"突变。2. **置信区域两大特性**：高可靠性（准确率从<20%跃升至>60%）和高冗余性（正确答案出现后仍生成30%以上冗余token）。3. **转移点分析**：简单问题在前1/3轨迹即进入置信区域（30-34%），困难问题延迟到中后段（52-56%）；强模型收敛更早；早收敛与正确性负相关（蒸馏模型r=-0.45最显著）。4. **早停性能**：CUSUM在AIME24/25和GPQA-Diamond基准上达到63.06%准确率与11.1% token削减的Pareto前沿，超越DEER（59.78%）和Dynasor（58.70%）3.28%和4.36%。5. **测试时缩放**：CUSUM加权投票一致优于自一致性方法，且随采样轨迹增多优势扩大。
AI.conclusion: CoT推理的全局动态遵循从高熵探索到低熵收敛的突变式两阶段结构，置信区域同时具备高可靠性和高冗余性两大关键特性。基于此，将置信区域检测建模为经典的序贯变点检测问题并采用CUSUM算法，提供了一种无需训练、统计最优的实时推理控制框架。该方法在早停和测试时缩放两个应用上均建立了新的性能Pareto前沿，为大语言模型的高效可靠推理提供了新范式。核心贡献在于：首次系统分析CoT熵动态、首次将经典变点检测引入CoT监控、提出的训练免费框架在多个模型和基准上具有一致优越性。

title: Investigating and Alleviating Harm Amplification in LLM Interactions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can serve as helpful assistants, yet they can equally function as harm amplifiers that enable malicious users to achieve harmful outcomes beyond their capabilities through extended interactions. This risk manifests along two axes, i.e., democratizing domain expertise that allows novices to produce specialized harmful content, and scaling harmful operations at volumes that manual effort cannot match. Existing works, however, often overlook how LLMs compound harm across multi-turn conversations. We introduce HarmAmp, a new benchmark for multi-turn harm amplification scenarios spanning twelve risk categories. Each scenario is grounded in real-world threats and satisfies rigorous criteria, i.e., substantive amplification, operational specificity, and multi-turn necessity. We further propose TrajSafe, a proactive monitor that anticipates harmful trajectories and intervenes through actions such as probing users' genuine intents and steering the models towards safer completion. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that TrajSafe significantly reduces the harmfulness incurred in multi-turn interactions while preserving a low over-refusal rate and the target model's general capabilities. Our work offers a promising paradigm to alleviate the nuanced safety risks in LLM interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HarmAmp 多轮危害放大基准和 TrajSafe 主动监控方法,用于研究和缓解 LLM 在多轮对话中放大危害的问题。HarmAmp 涵盖 12 个风险类别,通过实质性放大、操作具体性和多轮必要性三项筛选标准构建;TrajSafe 作为外部监控器,采用基于树的强化学习训练,可主动预测有害轨迹并进行分级干预(从被动参与到硬拒绝),在显著降低危害的同时保持低过度拒绝率和模型通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 安全研究主要关注单轮有害请求的拒答,忽视了 LLM 在多轮交互中作为"危害放大器"的风险:恶意用户可通过多轮对话逐步突破安全边界,获取超出其能力的有害产出(专业知识民主化、规模化有害操作)。同时现有安全防御存在过度拒绝与效用下降的权衡困境,缺乏针对多轮危害放大的系统性基准与主动防御方法。
AI.method: 1) HarmAmp 基准:从 HarmBench/Hex-Phi 收集种子,经三项标准(实质性放大、操作具体性、多轮必要性)筛选,通过 Claude-Sonnet-4.5 扩展为多步工作流计划(含用户画像、终端产物、放大模式三标注),由用户模拟器实例化为多轮对话;2) TrajSafe 方法:形式化为三方对话(用户、目标 LLM、监控器),监控器以结构化(思考、反馈、解释)三元组输出干预,采用五类共十二种动作(Engage/Probe/Shape/Divert/Hard Refuse);训练分两阶段——SFT 初始化动作分布平衡,然后基于树的强化学习(树状分支展开+GRPO 目标)优化,奖励函数综合考虑危害抑制与干预校准。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-4B、GPT-5-mini 三种目标模型上:1) 多轮设置下危害得分从单轮的 0–9.85% 跃升至 14.39–86.36%,验证多轮放大的严重性;2) TrajSafe 将危害得分分别降至 9.85%、0.76%、0.76%,显著优于所有基线防护;3) 过度拒绝率仅 11.64–15.07%,远低于最强防护基线(53–55%);4) 干预轮次率仅 26.69–40.35%(恶意)、5–5.83%(良性),干预效率高;5) MMLU/MultiChallenge 通用能力基本保持,TruthfulQA 因减少刻板印象而略升,而 Qwen3-4B-SafeRL 在 MMLU 下降 9%、MultiChallenge 下降 10.6 点。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了 LLM 安全中此前被忽视的多轮危害放大现象,提出对应的基准 HarmAmp 与主动监控防御范式 TrajSafe。TrajSafe 通过结构化动作空间与基于树的强化学习,在显著降低多轮危害的同时解决了过度拒绝与效用保留的权衡难题,证明外部主动监控是一种比直接权重对齐更优的安全增强路径,为多轮 LLM 安全研究提供了新范式。

title: State Machine Guided Multi-Relational Synthetic Data from Logs for Anomaly Detection
summary: Software systems generate massive unstructured logs that record execution behavior, failures, and interactions across components, yet existing log anomaly detection methods treat these logs primarily as flat sequences of templates, overlooking the relational execution structure that governs how events co-occur and evolve over time. We propose a framework that discovers this hidden structure by recovering an execution state machine directly from logs and inducing a corresponding multi-table relational schema connecting traces, events, states, transitions, and parameters. This discovered state machine serves as a generative prior to produce realistic multi-relational synthetic data that preserves structural, temporal, and process constraints while amplifying rare but valid execution behaviors. We assess the fidelity of the generated data through constraint validation, distributional similarity, and process-level metrics, and demonstrate its usefulness by showing that augmenting real logs with the synthetic relational data significantly improves anomaly and bug detection on held-out real datasets compared to sequence-based baselines and naive oversampling. Our results show that execution logs implicitly encode a relational database governed by a latent state machine, and that recovering this structure enables principled synthetic data generation for robust and interpretable anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LogSynthFSM 框架，从无结构系统日志中自动恢复潜在执行有限状态机（FSM）并诱导多表关系模式，在该结构先验引导下生成保结构、保过程的多关系合成数据，用于增强异常检测。
AI.motivation: 现有日志异常检测方法大多将日志视为扁平的事件/模板序列，忽略了事件共现与演化的关系执行结构（状态、转移、参数依赖），导致：① 检测准确率与可解释性受限；② 现有合成数据方法在模板/序列层面操作，无法保证执行语义合法性；③ 真实系统中的执行结构是潜在、演化且需从原始日志推断的，而非先验已知；④ 类别不平衡使稀有故障行为训练数据严重不足。
AI.method: LogSynthFSM 采用多智能体 LLM 闭环框架，五个专业化智能体协同工作：① Execution Parsing Agent：从原始日志提取模板、参数、时间戳等结构化事件；② State Discovery Agent：通过迭代 LLM 引导聚类推断满足近 Markov 性的潜在执行状态与转移，恢复 FSM；③ Schema Induction Agent：基于 FSM 诱导包含 Traces/Events/States/Transitions/StateTemplateMap/EventParams 等的多表关系模式，保证结构忠实性与生成充分性；④ Relational Synthesis Agent：以 FSM 为生成先验，采样合法状态路径，按状态条件分布生成事件与参数，并轻微上采样稀有但合法的转移；⑤ Consistency Evaluation Agent：从结构一致性（主外键、时序）、过程一致性（FSM 合法路径）、分布一致性（状态条件属性分布）三维评估，反馈驱动迭代精炼。下游采用 2 层 GraphSAGE + MLP 在执行图上做异常检测，理论证明 FSM 引导的合成在有界总变差误差下可控地提升对真实数据的风险。
AI.result: 在 BGL、Thunderbird、Hadoop、OpenStack 四个 LogHub 数据集上：LogSynthFSM 的 PR-AUC=0.742（vs 最强基线 GraphMaster 0.701），FPR@95%R=0.087，Rare PR-AUC=0.511（vs 0.438），TVR=0.985，k-gram JS=0.091，C2ST AUC=0.503（接近理想 0.5），均显著优于 17 个基线（GAugO、GraphSMOTE、GraphMaster、GAG、LLM4NG 等）。消融实验验证了各组件的必要性：去掉 State Discovery Agent 使 TVR 从 0.985 降至 0.714，Rare PR-AUC 从 0.511 降至 0.341；去掉 Consistency Evaluation Agent 使 PR-AUC 从 0.742 降至 0.703。频谱特征与转移矩阵可视化证实合成数据保持全局图结构与局部执行语义。模型在 5 个开源 7B-9B LLM 与 GPT-4.1 系列上均稳定工作，单卡 RTX 4080 SUPER 上 42-52 分钟可完成。
AI.conclusion: 执行日志本质上编码了由潜在状态机支配的隐式关系数据库；LogSynthFSM 通过多智能体协同发现该 FSM 及其多表模式，可生成保结构、保过程、增广稀有行为的高质量多关系合成数据，在消费者级硬件上即可显著提升下游异常与缺陷检测的性能与可解释性，并为执行感知的基础系统模型（如层次/半 Markov 抽象、差分隐私、与源代码控制流对齐）开辟了方向。

title: FinCom: A Financial Multi-Agent Demo with Disagree-or-Commit Deliberation
summary: Multi-agent systems powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for financial analysis and decision support. However, existing coordination schemes, especially those emphasizing consensus or debate, are vulnerable to sycophancy: agents conform to peer reasoning instead of evidence, leading to premature agreement and degraded outcomes. We introduce FinCom (Financial Committee), a governed multi-agent framework and interactive system that operationalizes the Disagree-or-Commit (DoC) protocol to embed structured dissent into financial AI committees. A central Supervisor orchestrates three ReAct-enabled specialist agents: Research, Quantitative, and Risk. Each agent is equipped with role-specific tools for retrieval, computation, and stress testing. During deliberation, agents must either explicitly critique or commit to their peers' reasoning before converging on a unified recommendation. This demonstration showcases how FinCom supports committee-style financial analysis through coordinated multi-agent interaction, including structured report generation and interactive decision support. Evaluated across the most recent financial agent benchmark, in addition to 90 internal handcrafted financial tasks using an LLM-as-a-Judge protocol, DoC improves reasoning accuracy and risk awareness significantly over a consensus-seeking baseline on both an in-house and external evaluation set. By reframing disagreement as a governance primitive rather than noise, FinCom offers a lightweight, prompt-only recipe for improving accountability, transparency, and epistemic robustness in agentic financial systems.

AI.tldr: FinCom 是一个面向金融分析的多智能体系统，通过 Supervisor 协调 Research、Quant、Risk 三个 ReAct 智能体，并采用"Disagree-or-Commit (DoC)"协议强制每个智能体在委员会审议中对前序推理进行明确批判或承诺，从而缓解 LLM 多智能体系统中常见的"谄媚性共识"问题。
AI.motivation: 现有面向金融的 LLM 多智能体系统多采用共识或辩论式协调机制，容易产生从众偏差（sycophancy / conformity bias）：智能体倾向于附和先前的推理而非独立验证证据，导致表面连贯但缺乏充分事实支撑的输出，损害金融决策的可问责性和认知鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1. 架构：基于 LangGraph 构建的 Supervisor + 三专家智能体（Research 负责基本面/财报/新闻检索；Quant 负责技术指标、回测、跨资产分析；Risk 负责波动率、VaR、压力测试与定性风险审查），所有智能体采用 ReAct 推理循环并配备角色专用工具（如 DefeatBeta、Finnhub、SEC、Polygon、Tavily）。\n2. 执行模式：支持单智能体直接调用和委员会顺序审议两种模式。\n3. 核心协议——Disagree-or-Commit (DoC)：在委员会模式下，每个智能体在产出回复前必须二选一：(a) Disagree——明确指出前序推理中的错误、矛盾、缺乏证据之处并提供修正；(b) Commit——明确认可前序推理并补充至少一项新的支持事实或扩展。该机制仅通过 prompt 层实现，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在最新的金融智能体基准测试以及 90 个内部手写金融任务上，采用 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估协议，DoC 协议在推理准确性和风险意识方面均显著优于纯共识基线，在内部和外部评估集上均取得明显提升。
AI.conclusion: FinCom 将"异议"重新定义为金融 AI 委员会中的治理原语而非噪声，提供了一种轻量级、纯 prompt 级的方案来增强多智能体金融系统的可问责性、透明性和认知鲁棒性，且易于集成到现有基于 Supervisor 的架构中。

title: Coordinating Task Switching in a Robotics Multi-Agent System Using Behavior Trees
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures. Preprint of a manuscript submitted to the XXVI Congresso Brasileiro de Automática (CBA 2026)
summary: The application of multi-agent systems in robotics is a very challenging field. Several competitions involving such systems are proposed to foster research and development of strategies and mechanisms using games as the underlying domain. Among them are the ones from the \textit{IEEE Very Small Soccer (VSSS)} category, which is the case study described in this paper. In VSSS, two teams of three robots each compete in a very dynamic environment of a soccer game. Thus, coordination of robots' behavior during the game is crucial to win it. In this paper, we present a Behavior-Tree-based approach to support multi-robot coordination within the VSSS team of the ThundeRatz robotics team from the Universidade de S$\tilde{a}$o Paulo. Moreover, a comparison between the proposed approach and the previous one, which was based on a Finite State Machine (FSM), was conducted using the FIRASim simulator. Besides that, the performance of this new strategy was further evaluated in an academic robotics competition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于行为树(BT)的多机器人协调方法,用于VSSS足球竞赛中三机器人的动态角色分配与切换,取代了原有难以维护的FSM方案。BT方案在仿真和真实竞赛中均显著优于FSM方案。
AI.motivation: ThundeRatz团队的ThunderVolt项目此前使用有限状态机(FSM)实现多机器人协调,但随着系统复杂度提升,FSM在可扩展性、可维护性和可理解性方面表现不佳,难以进一步改进和添加新功能(尤其当角色数量多于机器人数量时),因此亟需一种更模块化、灵活的控制架构来管理7种角色在3个机器人之间的动态分配。
AI.conclusion: 行为树是协调多智能体系统中动态角色分配与切换的有效方案,具备模块化、灵活、易于维护和扩展等优势,作为FSM的替代方案特别适用于定义复杂行为;BT方案不仅在系统结构层面带来改进,还带来了统计显著的性能提升(归因于对策略反应性及角色切换优先级的更优控制),为多机器人协调领域提供有价值的案例研究。

title: Agent System Operations: Categorization, Challenges, and Future Directions
summary: As the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to advance, LLM-based agent systems offer advantages in flexibility and interpretability over traditional systems, garnering increasing attention. However, despite the widespread research interest and industrial application of agent systems, these systems, like their traditional counterparts, frequently encounter anomalies. These anomalies lead to instability and insecurity, hindering their further development. Therefore, a comprehensive and systematic approach to the operation and maintenance of agent systems is urgently needed. Unfortunately, current research on the operations of agent systems is sparse. To address this gap, we have undertaken a survey on agent system operations with the aim of establishing a clear framework for the field, defining the challenges, and facilitating further development. Specifically, this paper begins by systematically defining anomalies within agent systems, categorizing them into intra-agent anomalies and inter-agent anomalies. Next, we introduce a novel and comprehensive operational framework for agent systems, dubbed Agent System Operations (AgentOps). We provide detailed definitions and explanations of its four key stages: monitoring, anomaly detection, root cause localization, and resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地提出了"Agent系统运维（AgentOps）"的概念与框架，对LLM智能体系统中的异常进行了全面分类（智能体内异常与智能体间异常），并定义了四个关键运维阶段（监控、异常检测、根因定位、解决），旨在为智能体系统的稳定可靠运行建立系统性方法论。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM推理能力提升，基于LLM的智能体系统（特别是多智能体系统）被广泛应用，但其频繁的异常（如幻觉、任务失败率高达40%以下）导致系统不稳定和不安全。传统运维技术（DevOps、AIOps）因智能体系统的概率性、动态工具调用、多步推理等特性而难以直接适用，亟需专门面向智能体系统的运维框架。
AI.method: 1）系统定义智能体系统异常：从"何时发生"（执行前/执行中/执行后）和"在哪里发生"（智能体内/智能体间）两个正交维度进行分类；2）提出AgentOps四阶段框架：监控、异常检测、根因定位（也称故障归因）、解决；3）梳理现有方法并对比传统运维差异；4）分类总结各阶段的方法、数据集与基准测试；5）探讨未来研究方向。
AI.result: 1）建立了智能体系统异常的完整分类体系：智能体内异常包括推理异常、动作异常、记忆异常、安全异常；智能体间异常包括任务规范异常、编排异常、通信异常、终止异常。2）明确定义AgentOps为面向智能体系统的运维技术（区别于用智能体运维其他系统的AgenticOps）。3）详细对比了AgentOps与DevOps在四个阶段的任务差异：监控需关注LLM内部状态、检查点；异常检测需审视生成过程而非仅结果；根因定位沿执行轨迹定位单个动作；解决需迭代优化与回滚。4）总结了各阶段代表方法（如SAPLMA、OPERA、FAMAS、Reflexion、Self-Refine等）和数据集（Who&When、AgentFail、Aegis等）。5）识别了未来方向：可观察数据扩展（模型数据、检查点数据）、统一检测框架、跨层级检测、在线长周期任务检测、两阶段归因框架、统一解决框架、从失败中学习等。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了智能体系统运维研究的空白，提出的AgentOps框架为该领域奠定了系统性基础，涵盖异常分类、运维阶段划分、现有方法总结与未来方向指引，有望推动智能体系统从"能跑"向"稳定可靠运行"演进，促进其在工业界的更广泛部署。

title: MetaForge: A Self-Evolving Multimodal Agent that Retrieves, Adapts, and Forges Tools On Demand
summary: Multimodal agents have achieved notable progress on complex reasoning tasks through tool use, yet remain limited by two issues: statically predefined tool inventories fail to generalize to unseen scenarios, and indiscriminate tool invocation incurs redundant cost and noise-induced errors. We propose MetaForge, a multimodal agent framework that learns when to invoke tools and how to evolve its toolset on demand. MetaForge factorizes agentic behavior into four coupled stages: Decide (judging whether tool use is warranted), Retrieve (selecting suitable tools), Adapt (grounding tool parameters in task context), and Forge (synthesizing new skills online and recycling them into the tool library for reuse), forming a closed judge-retrieve-adapt-forge-recycle loop. A unified orchestration policy enables the agent to choose among answering directly, reusing existing tools, or forging new ones. We jointly optimize invocation necessity, retrieval accuracy, execution effectiveness, and forged-skill reusability via reinforcement learning, with an explicit invocation-cost penalty discouraging redundant calls. Across 12 benchmarks, MetaForge consistently surpasses 16 baselines in accuracy, efficiency, and generalization, validating a paradigm shift from static tool inventories to on-demand self-evolution.

AI.tldr: MetaForge提出了一种多模态智能体框架,通过"判断-检索-适配-锻造-回收"的闭环循环,使智能体能够按需动态学习何时调用工具以及如何扩展工具集,实现了从静态工具库存到按需自演化的范式转变。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态智能体在复杂推理任务中通过工具使用取得进展,但仍存在两个核心局限:(1)静态预定义的工具库难以泛化到未见场景;(2)不加区分的工具调用产生冗余成本和噪声错误。这两个问题限制了智能体的可扩展性和效率。
AI.method: MetaForge将智能体行为分解为四个耦合阶段:(1) Decide(判断是否需要使用工具);(2) Retrieve(选择合适的工具);(3) Adapt(将工具参数与任务上下文对接);(4) Forge(在线合成新技能并回收至工具库以供复用),形成judge-retrieve-adapt-forge-recycle的闭环。统一的编排策略使智能体可在"直接回答"、"复用现有工具"、"锻造新工具"三种模式间选择。通过强化学习联合优化调用必要性、检索准确性、执行有效性和锻造技能的可复用性,并显式引入调用成本惩罚以抑制冗余调用。
AI.result: 在12个基准测试上,MetaForge在准确性、效率和泛化性三个维度上均持续超越16个基线方法,验证了从静态工具库存到按需自演化范式转变的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MetaForge验证了多模态智能体从"静态工具依赖"向"动态自演化工具能力"范式转变的可行性与优势,为构建可扩展、自适应的智能体系统提供了新方向。

title: From Global Policies to Local Strategies: Multi-Objective Optimization of Resource-Specific Handover Policies
summary: Efficient resource allocation is a key challenge in business process management, with direct implications for cost, throughput time, and utilization. While recent Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches have shown promise in deriving adaptive allocation policies, they typically neglect inter-resource collaboration patterns that can strongly influence real-world task handovers. Recognizing this, this paper introduces the first approach for multi-objective optimization of resource-level decision-making, enabling the recommendation of person-specific handover policies. To achieve this, our work combines an existing Multi-Agent System-based process simulator with a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm. The resulting approach produces Pareto-optimal, resource-specific policies that optimize the process across multiple objectives. Experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets show that our approach reduces costs by an average of 37% and waiting time by 58%, consistently outperforming heuristic baselines and demonstrating the potential of leveraging collaboration-aware optimization to improve process performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个基于多智能体系统(MAS)仿真模型与NSGA-II多目标进化算法相结合的方法，用于优化业务流程中资源(人员)特定的交接策略(handover policies)。该方法能够生成Pareto最优的资源交接策略，同时优化成本与等待时间等多个目标。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习(RL)的业务流程资源分配方法存在关键缺陷：它们学习的是全局分配策略，将资源视为被动接受任务分配的实体，忽略了真实组织中资源间的协作模式(handover patterns)。这种以"控制流优先"为视角的方法无法捕捉和优化资源间的协作结构，错失了通过协作结构改进流程性能的机会。因此需要一种能够以"资源优先"视角进行多目标优化的方法，生成person-specific的交接策略。
AI.method:
1. **输入**: 基于AgentSimulator[9]从事件日志自动发现的多智能体仿真模型M=(A, S, π₀, β)，以及一组目标函数K = {f₁, ..., fₖ}。
2. **搜索空间剪枝**: 将决策点分为Fixed(固定)和Variable(可变)两类，仅对Variable决策点进行优化。
3. **遗传优化器(NSGA-II)**:
   - 初始种群: 50%随机策略+50%由as-is策略π₀变异而来+1个as-is副本，平衡探索与利用。
   - 适应度评估: 合并固定与可变策略 → 多次仿真(T=3) → 计算平均成本向量。
   - 遗传算子: 选择(非支配排序+拥挤距离) → 交叉(以决策点为单位整体交换概率分布，p_c=70%) → 变异(p_m=30%)。
4. **四种变异策略**:
   - Random: 完全重新初始化概率分布(强探索)。
   - Greedy: 将最差后继者的全部概率转移给最佳后继者(强利用)。
   - Guided: 仅将最差后继者10%-50%的概率转移给最佳后继者(细粒度调整)。
   - Hybrid: 60% Guided + 20% Greedy + 20% Random。
5. **输出**: 经过G=100代进化后的Pareto前沿P* = {π₁, π₂, ..., π_M}。
6. **评价指标**: 成本(小时费率×执行时长)、等待时间(WT)、Hyperarea Ratio、Purity、Averaged Hausdorff Distance、Delta Spread。
AI.result:
1. **内部有效性**(Loan Application 5个变体): 相比As-Is基线，在所有5个场景中均同时降低成本与等待时间。例如Loan_SCDT场景中，成本从$254k降至$179k，WT从2.78小时降至0.60小时。在所有5个场景中均获得最低成本。
2. **外部有效性**(7个公开事件日志): 在所有数据集上均同时改善了成本和等待时间，WT方面表现尤其稳健。平均降低成本37%，降低等待时间58%。
3. **变异策略对比**: Guided变异策略在所有数据集上平均改进最大(成本36.88%, WT 57.71%)；Pareto前沿质量方面，Guided和Hybrid表现突出，而Random和Greedy倾向于产生较少支配解。
4. **计算开销**: 方法比基线慢约35倍(平均103.85分钟 vs 2.96分钟)，随事件和代理数量增加而增加。
5. **定性发现**: LC(始终选择最便宜资源)策略导致严重排队问题(过多空白单元格)；本文方法学习到平衡的策略，如将任务交接给虽贵6倍但速度也快6倍的高级资源，整体更优。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次实现了对资源特定交接策略的多目标优化，填补了现有"控制流优先"RL方法在协作结构建模上的空白。该方法具有三大优势：(1)可从事件日志数据驱动发现；(2)对目标函数集合通用，可输出Pareto前沿供决策者选择权衡方案；(3)在内部和外部实验中均一致优于As-Is及多种启发式基线(LC、SPT、Avail、Random)。有效性威胁包括仿真保真度、过度拟合仿真动态、事件日志缺少成本信息等。未来工作方向包括：降低计算开销、扩展到更丰富的协作策略(如动态并行化、自适应路由)、以及将仿真器保真度敏感性纳入分析。

title: QoEReasoner: An Agentic Reasoning Framework for Automated and Explainable QoE Diagnosis in RANs
summary: Diagnosing Quality-of-Experience (QoE) degradations in operational Radio Access Networks (RANs) is a critical but notoriously complex task, traditionally requiring labor-intensive expert analysis over high-dimensional, cross-layer telemetry. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer unprecedented reasoning capabilities, they are fundamentally unsuited for raw RANs troubleshooting: they fail at numeric time-series analysis, hallucinate protocol-violating causal links, and lack the stateful rigor required for multi-step fault localization. To bridge this gap, we present QoEReasoner, an end-to-end, LLM-driven agentic system designed for automated and explainable QoE diagnosis. QoEReasoner tames the inherent unpredictability of LLMs by grounding their reasoning in the physical realities of the network. It employs deterministic tools to reliably translate raw numeric KPIs into structured evidence, enforces protocol-consistent fault propagation through a domain-specific Knowledge Base, and leverages a Historical Bank of expert-validated cases to guide hypothesis generation. A stateful central planner orchestrates this closed-loop process across anomaly detection, causal tracing, and root-cause localization. Evaluations on real-world operational RANs datasets demonstrate that QoEReasoner outperforms strong baselines by 18\%-40\% in accuracy across multiple diagnostic tasks. Furthermore, it reduces diagnostic time from approximately 30 minutes of manual expert analysis to just 3 minutes per session, delivering highly interpretable, expert-grade reports while remaining robust across diverse LLM backbones.

AI.tldr: QoEReasoner是首个面向RANs（无线接入网）中QoE（用户体验质量）诊断的端到端LLM智能体框架，通过确定性工具、领域知识库（KB）、历史案例库（HB）和有状态规划器的协同，解决LLM在数值时序分析、跨层因果推理和多任务一致性方面的固有缺陷，实现自动化、可解释的异常检测、故障因果链推理和根因定位。
AI.motivation: 运维级RANs中的QoE降级诊断高度依赖专家对高维、跨层KPI遥测数据的手工分析，效率低且成本高。现有三大范式（启发式规则、深度学习、纯LLM）均无法同时满足三项关键需求：(R1)可靠的数值感知、(R2)协议一致的跨层因果解释、(R3)跨任务逻辑一致性。规则方法缺乏因果推理能力，DL方法为黑箱且任务间割裂，LLM在数值理解、因果幻觉和提示敏感性上存在固有缺陷。因此亟需一个统一的智能体框架来融合三者优势。
AI.method: QoEReasoner采用模块化架构，包含四大核心诊断模块和三大支撑组件：1) **Planner（规划器）**——基于LLM的有状态控制器，维护共享诊断状态并迭代选择下一步动作；2) **KPI Perception**——调用确定性工具将原始KPI时序转化为结构化证据；3) **Fault Causal Chain Reasoning (FCR)**——通过"检索-验证-调整"三阶段实现证据驱动的故障链推理，结合语义先验与嵌入相似度检索HB中的候选链，再由KB约束进行边级因果验证，最后融合打分排序；4) **Reporter**——汇总诊断证据生成可读报告。支撑组件包括：(a) **Tool Pool**（功能工具+预训练模型）；(b) **Knowledge Base**（三层故障原子层次结构、全局因果图、边级约束、专家规则）；(c) **Historical Bank**（专家验证的历史故障案例）。系统基于LangGraph以ReAct风格控制循环实现。
AI.result: 在真实运维RANs数据集（300个会话、6类根因、21个专家验证故障链模板）上，QoEReasoner全面优于规则、DL（TS-TCC/CA-TCC）、纯LLM和RCA-Agent基线：1) **异常检测**：F1达0.85，误报率（FAR）从LLM基线的≈1.0降至0.15；2) **故障链推理**：edge_p从纯LLM的0.005–0.048提升至0.31–0.43，chain_em从0提升至0.29–0.40；3) **根因分类**：top1_acc从DL的≈0.31提升至0.57–0.67。诊断时间从人工30分钟缩短至约3分钟，单次API成本约$0.02。消融实验证明KB与HB具有互补性：KB保障结构有效性，HB提供数据驱动先验。FCR三阶段逐步提升GT链排名（MRR从0.60→0.62，R@1从0.34→0.40）。专家用户研究四个维度评分均超4/5。框架在DeepSeek-V3.2、GPT-5.2、Qwen3-14B等不同LLM骨干上均表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: QoEReasoner通过将确定性工具、领域结构化知识（KB）和历史案例先验（HB）嵌入LLM驱动的有状态智能体循环，成功统一了QoE诊断中的数值感知、因果推理和跨任务协调三大需求，在多个诊断任务上以18%–40%的优势超越强基线，显著提升诊断效率并保持跨LLM骨干的鲁棒性。其模块化设计支持未来扩展至多链诊断、自适应规划和端到端"检测-诊断-优化"工作流，为AI原生RANs运维提供了实用路径。

title: A Simple Hierarchical Causality Primer
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure; short technical primer with a toy example in an appendix
summary: We provide a brief primer for the idea behind formalising hierarchical causality in the context of complex systems. Here actors are not simply agents. Actors instantiate causation classes. Agents implement local dynamics in given levels or organisation in a given system. Hierarchical causality then describes how actor-level roles constrain, select, and organise agent-level behaviour across levels. The system then necessarily requires three additional structures. First, causation classes to abstract a given form of causal influence that an actor instantiates. Second, aggregation operators to move across the levels. Third, discrete event-time maps are required because the system comprises events, and the relation between local event counts and any global clock must be specified. Our formulation here is purposefully simple and discrete.

AI.tldr: 本文为复杂系统中的层次因果性（hierarchical causality）提供了一个简洁的离散形式化框架。其核心思想是将"行动者（actor）"与"主体（agent）"区分开来：主体是各层级的局部交互单元，而行动者则通过"接口"对低层级可容许的转移核施加约束。整体形式化方案为四元组 Ψ = (H, D, C, U)，分别承载层级结构、动力学、约束结构以及离散事件时间映射。论文通过定义聚合等价与因果等价的差异，定位自上而下因果性的发生位置——即行动者实例对低层级可容许核的限制。
AI.motivation: 复杂系统普遍存在多层级组织，主流的复杂性研究多以自下而上的还原论视角展开，难以充分解释为何相同的主体在不同语境中会表现出不同行为。本文旨在形式化Ellis学派的自上而下因果性（top-down causation）思想，弥补现有结构性因果模型（Pearl）、因果抽象（causal abstraction）、因果涌现（Hoel）以及受约束MDP等框架在显式分离聚合、层级内动力学与跨层级约束三方面时的不足。论文目标是提出一个简单、离散、可操作的形式语法，用以刻画规则、制度、协议或自适应角色如何限制低层级动力学。
AI.method:
论文采用离散形式化方法，定义"层次因果系统"为四元组 Ψ = (H, D, C, U)：
(1) 层级结构 H：包含各层级 ℓ 的配置空间 X_ℓ、主体索引集 I_ℓ、状态空间 S_ℓ，以及聚合算子 Π_ℓ: X_ℓ → X_{ℓ+1}。
(2) 动力学结构 D：各层级 ℓ 的可容许转移核类 𝒦_ℓ 中的已实现核 K_{ℓ,n_ℓ}，对应条件概率 K_{ℓ,n_ℓ}(x'_ℓ | x_ℓ)。
(3) 约束结构 C：行动者实例 α = (a, r, c, ℓ, B_ℓ, η) 诱导集合值对应 D^α_{r→ℓ}: X_r ⇒ 𝒦_{ℓ,B_ℓ}，将高层级状态映射为对低层级核的可容许子集，实现自上而下的因果约束。行动者通过因果类 c = γ(a) 抽象因果影响模式（算法结构、固定目标控制、自适应选择、自适应反馈、自适应目标选择等）。
(4) 事件时间结构 U：离散从属映射 U_ℓ: ℕ → ℕ 将全局事件索引 m 映射为各层级事件计数 n_ℓ = U_ℓ(m)。
进一步定义聚合等价（由 Π_ℓ 诱导）与行动者特定因果等价（由受限可容许转移结构诱导），并证明前者不必蕴含后者（命题1）。附录A给出一个四主体二层级的最小离散示例，演示当接口 η 可见聚合所隐藏的低层级站点结构时，聚合等价与因果等价的差异。
AI.result:
1. 给出了层次因果系统的完整离散形式定义（定义1），将聚合、层级内动力学、跨层级约束与事件时间协调四类操作清晰分离。
2. 形式化并证明了命题1：聚合等价不一定蕴含因果等价——即两个低层级状态可有相同聚合像，但在同一行动者实例下其可容许出向核截面不同。
3. 提出行动者实例的六元组结构 α = (a, r, c, ℓ, B_ℓ, η)，将行动者、因果类、目标层级、目标子系统与接口显式编码。
4. 提供了八个配套定义（定义2-8）以规范术语使用（主体、行动者与实例、因果类、转移核、聚合算子、离散从属、聚合与因果等价）。
5. 附录A以四个二元主体与两个块状态的两层级玩具模型完整演示了四元组 H, D, C, U 的协同运行。
6. 系统讨论了该框架与结构因果模型（Pearl）、因果抽象、因果涌现（Hoel）、受约束马尔可夫过程及生存性理论（viability theory）的联系与区别，明确了其作为"层次约束簿记"而非完整推断理论的定位。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心主张是：自上而下的因果性应被理解为高层级行动者实例通过接口对低层级可容许转移结构的限制，而非直接引起低层级状态的变化。该限制若非仅由聚合决定，则系统具有层次因果结构。论文形式化方案的优势在于将聚合、动力学、约束与事件时间四种操作明确分离，使因果等价不被混同于聚合等价——两个低层级状态可在聚合描述上等同却因行动者实例施加的不同接口规则而具有不同的因果未来。其方法有意保持离散、简单与描述性，避免了完整推断、宏观因果强度量化或抽象一致性证明等任务。这种"建筑级"而非"成分级"的视角，使其在表达规则、制度、协议及自适应角色对局部动力学的约束方面具有现实主义优势，同时为后续拓展到受控马尔可夫模型、连续时间极限与可计算生存性核提供了清晰的接入点。

title: A Game-Theoretic Decision Framework for Optimal Selection of Coordination Detection Methods in Multi-UAV Fleet Operations
summary: Detecting coordination among unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) fleets operating in shared airspace and identifying the route-lead aircraft whose navigation decisions govern fleet behavior presents a fundamental speed--accuracy trade-off: fast methods enable real-time traffic management but sacrifice detection fidelity, while accurate methods may exceed the time budget for actionable airspace deconfliction. This paper presents a game-theoretic decision framework that resolves this trade-off by formulating method selection as a two-player zero-sum game between a Monitor (selecting computational methods and parameters) and Nature (selecting the unknown traffic scenario). We construct an end-to-end pipeline from trajectory surveillance data through eight candidate detection algorithms, a Monte Carlo sensitivity analysis characterizing their stochastic performance, and finally a multi-objective optimization layer that identifies Pareto-optimal method portfolios. The minimax solution provides a robust mixed strategy with a probability distribution over methods that guarantees worst-case performance regardless of scenario uncertainty. Experimental evaluation across 200 randomized configurations spanning 5--50 aircraft demonstrates that the framework recommends distinct method portfolios depending on operational priority: Koopman Phase dominates balanced (70.6%) and speed-priority (79.7%) profiles, while CRQA emerges as primary (47.4%) when route-lead identification is prioritized. The framework achieves a guaranteed game value of 0.29--0.53 (normalized utility) across all tested preference profiles, providing the first principled, scenario-adaptive methodology for computational method selection in UTM fleet monitoring operations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种博弈论决策框架，将多无人机(UAV)机群协调检测中的方法选择问题建模为监控者(Monitor)与自然(Nature)之间的零和博弈，通过8种检测算法的端到端流水线、蒙特卡洛灵敏度分析和多目标帕累托优化，为无人机交通管理(UTM)系统提供场景自适应的鲁棒方法组合推荐。
AI.motivation: 随着商业无人机在共享空域中的快速增长，UTM运营商需要自动检测机群协调行为并识别领航飞机(route-lead)。然而，检测算法存在根本性的速度-精度权衡——快速方法牺牲检测保真度，精确方法可能超出实时解冲突的时间预算。现有文献仅将方法评估视为基准测试(后验比较)，缺乏在不确定性下进行方法选择的规范性框架。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 8种检测算法的端到端流水线，涵盖4个算法家族(配对统计法、批处理算子理论法、在线算子法、图拓扑法)；(2) 将方法选择建模为监控者与自然之间的有限双人零和博弈，通过Brown虚拟对弈算法求解minimax混合策略；(3) 利用NSGA-II多目标进化算法识别帕累托最优方法配置，形成Pareto前沿。最终将问题形式化为三层：配置空间(方法+参数)、场景空间(飞机数N、领航数N_L、协调百分比、观测时长T)、以及由权重向量参数化的效用标量化函数。
AI.result: 在200次随机配置(5-50架飞机)的实验中，四种操作优先级下获得不同方法组合：Koopman Phase在平衡(70.6%)、速度优先(79.7%)、精度优先(62.6%)配置中占主导；CRQA在领航识别优先配置中占主导(47.4%)。博弈值在0.29-0.53之间。帕累托前沿分析显示，从mrDMD到Koopman Phase的过渡可获得2.8倍速度提升，代价是30%的协调精度损失。灵敏度分析表明，N_L主导协调F1(η²=0.12-0.93)，N主导速度(η²=0.27-0.74)。最困难场景为大机队(N=30-50)配多领航(N_L=5)和短协调窗口(coord_pct=25%)。
AI.conclusion: 该框架是首个面向UTM机群监控中计算方法选择的原则性、场景自适应方法论。其方法无关性允许集成新算法，权重向量变化时博弈解可即时更新而无需重跑检测算法，为动态UTM操作提供了可重用基础设施。该框架还可推广至任何多种检测算法在不确定操作条件下竞争的场景。局限性包括假设观察窗口内场景平稳、单协调原型假设，未来可扩展至序贯博弈和规避感知协调模型。

title: Fake Plastic Voters: When Political Parties Can Use AI-Simulated Focus Groups
summary: Political parties strive to understand their electorates, and focus groups are a vital tool in these efforts. AI-enhanced simulation technologies (AESTs) enable synthetic focus groups in a fraction of the time (and cost), raising the question of when and how such simulated evidence can be used in campaign research. This paper develops a decision matrix to help party strategists match research needs to appropriate simulation technologies and to identify when to escalate to hybrid or fully human focus groups. The matrix combines three dimensions: strategic purpose, deployment risk, and empirical grounding of the simulation tool. Strategic purpose is the decisive dimension, as it determines what kind of evidence the focus group is meant to produce: observing how political meanings and identities emerge through interaction (Mode 1) or testing and refining campaign messages (Mode 2). The matrix shows that, given documented failure modes such as sycophancy, persona drift, and the suppression of minority viewpoints, AESTs cannot replace human interaction in Mode 1 at any risk level. Within Mode 2, suitability depends instead on deployment risk and on the empirical grounding. Yet even here, we caution that routine reliance on AESTs may erode the qualitative craft on which sound judgment depends.

AI.tldr: 本文针对政党竞选研究中AI增强模拟技术（AESTs）替代传统人工焦点小组的适用性问题，构建了一个三维决策矩阵，用于判断何时可使用AI模拟焦点小组、何时应升级为混合或完全人工焦点小组。核心结论是：AI模拟无法替代Mode 1（观察政治意义与身份互动生成），但在Mode 2（信息测试与优化）中可依据部署风险和经验基础有限度使用。
AI.motivation: 政党需要深入了解其选民群体，焦点小组是核心研究工具。AI增强模拟技术（AESTs）能以更低成本和更快速度生成合成焦点小组，但伴随谄媚性（sycophancy）、角色漂移（persona drift）和少数派观点被抑制等已知失效模式。其使用的时机、方式及局限性尚不明确，因此亟需一个系统性的决策框架来指导竞选策略师合理选用模拟技术。
AI.method: 构建一个三维决策矩阵，三个维度为：(1) 战略目的（strategic purpose）——决定焦点小组所需证据的类型；(2) 部署风险（deployment risk）；(3) 模拟工具的经验基础（empirical grounding）。战略目的进一步区分两种模式：Mode 1（通过互动观察政治意义与身份如何涌现）和Mode 2（测试与优化竞选信息）。该矩阵将研究需求与相应模拟技术进行匹配，并明确升级至混合或人工焦点小组的触发条件。
AI.result: 矩阵分析表明：(1) 在Mode 1下，由于AESTs存在谄媚性、角色漂移和压制少数派观点等失效模式，AI模拟在任何风险水平下均无法替代人工互动；(2) 在Mode 2下，AESTs的适用性取决于部署风险水平和模拟工具的经验基础，经验基础充分且部署风险低时，AI模拟可作为辅助手段；(3) 即使在Mode 2中适用，常规依赖AESTs仍存在风险。
AI.conclusion: AI增强模拟技术不能完全替代人工焦点小组，尤其在需要观察政治意义与身份涌现的探索性研究（Mode 1）中。在信息测试与优化（Mode 2）中，AI模拟可依据风险与经验基础有限度使用。但需警惕：常规依赖AESTs可能逐步侵蚀定性研究的方法论技艺，削弱政党策略师做出正确判断所依赖的质性能力。建议在关键决策点升级至混合或完全人工焦点小组。

title: Idleness is Relative: Exploiting Tool-Call Idle Windows for Offloading in Agentic Systems with MORI
summary: Modern LLM serving systems increasingly host agentic workloads, whose sessions issue tens of model invocations interleaved with tool calls, accumulating KV cache that can be reused across steps. As requests' total KV cache size easily exceeds GPU HBM capacity, researchers offload them to CPU DRAM. However, tool-call durations span orders of magnitude, and the cost of transferring KV cache between tiers makes it impractical to re-place entries on every call. We observe that agentic programs exhibit a two-phase structure: busy phases of rapid short tool calls and idle phases dominated by long-running calls. Current eviction policies such as LRU fail to capture this property. A binary busy/idle label also falls short because the ratio of busy to idle programs may not match the hardware's GPU-to-CPU capacity ratio. When it does not, one tier sits underutilized while the other is oversubscribed, wasting memory or forcing unnecessary evictions. We present MORI, an agent serving system that solves the above problem. Our key insight is that idleness is a continuous, relative spectrum. MORI ranks all active programs by idleness, assigns the busiest to GPU HBM and the most idle to CPU DRAM, dynamically shifts the partition boundary to match hardware capacity, and enforces admission control at each memory tier. Evaluated on real coding agent workloads collected from Claude Code across four GPU and model pairs, MORI delivers 20--71% higher throughput and 18--43% lower TTFT than the best baseline with offloading.

AI.tldr: MORI是一个面向智能体（agentic）LLM工作负载的程序感知调度系统，将"闲置性（idleness）"建模为连续相对的谱系指标，对KV缓存在GPU HBM与CPU DRAM两级存储间进行动态放置与准入控制，在真实编码智能体工作负载上实现显著吞吐量与延迟改进。
AI.motivation: 智能体工作负载中工具调用时长跨越数个数量级且不可预测，导致KV缓存管理面临两难：频繁换入换出开销过高，而现有LRU等策略以及二元busy/idle分类无法捕捉智能体程序交替出现的持续忙闲两阶段特性，也难以适应不同的GPU/CPU硬件容量配比，造成一端过载而另一端闲置。
AI.method: MORI定义窗口化闲置指标ι（最近k个推理-工具调用周期中工具调用时间占比）作为对程序阶段的局部估计；采用三层级队列（GPU队列/CPU队列/等待队列）配合"粘性放置（sticky placement）"策略，按ι连续排序、动态调整GPU/CPU分界点以匹配硬件容量，并在每层实施准入控制；同时将类型标签（busy/idle/inactive）下发至推理引擎的radix tree节点，使引擎块级LRU淘汰在各层中优先保留本层目标程序。
AI.result: 在四套硬件配置（H200 80GB+H200+B200，搭配7B/30B MoE/70B模型）与真实Claude Code回放trace上，单副本场景MORI相对最强offloading基线TA+O实现20–71%吞吐量提升与18–43% TTFT降低，相对无offloading基线提升1.6–2.1×；多副本（DP=3）场景实现54–79%吞吐量提升并维持99%+ GPU利用率（基线仅59–76%），同时将程序跨副本迁移率从14–15%降至0.3–2.9%。
AI.conclusion: 将闲置性视为连续相对的谱系而非二元标签，是解决智能体LLM服务中KV缓存跨级放置问题的有效思路；基于此的MORI在多种GPU型号、模型规模与副本数下均取得一致且显著的性能优势，且其基于排序的设计可自然扩展至SSD、远端DRAM等更多层级及异构硬件场景。

title: ART: Attention Run-time Termination for Efficient Large Language Model Decoding
summary: Long-context decoding in Large Language Models (LLMs) is severely constrained by the memory bandwidth required to fetch the extensive Key-Value (KV) cache. Most existing KV management methods rely on key-only pruning before decoding, despite the evidence that attention outputs depend jointly on keys and values, as incorporating values in their methods incurs prohibitive additional overhead. In this paper, we propose Attention Run-time Termination (ART), a lightweight run-time mechanism that tracks accumulated attention outputs during kernel execution and terminates subsequent KV block accesses once further contributions become negligible. This design makes ART orthogonal to existing key-based KV cache management methods, enabling seamless integration with them. Experiments on LongBench benchmarks show that ART achieves 20% higher generation throughput in large batch size than state-of-the-art baseline while maintaining comparable accuracy.

AI.tldr: ART（Attention Run-time Termination）是一种轻量级运行时机制，通过在FlashAttention内核执行过程中追踪累积注意力输出的稳定性，一旦后续KV块的贡献变得可忽略即提前终止访问，从而加速LLM长上下文解码。它与现有基于key的KV缓存管理方法正交，可无缝集成。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM解码受限于KV缓存的内存带宽开销。现有KV管理方法（如StreamingLLM、SnapKV、PyramidKV）主要依赖key-only的剪枝策略，忽视了value对输出的影响——低注意力权重token可能因value向量对输出仍有显著贡献而被错误剪枝。此外，将value纳入评估通常需要额外预测器或离线分析，开销过大。核心问题是：能否在运行时以可忽略成本捕捉keys和values的联合影响？
AI.method:
ART利用FlashAttention的流式分块执行特性，在每个KV块处理后提取累加器寄存器片段作为探针向量x(t)，通过两个解耦的稳定性指标判断是否终止：
1. 尺度变化 d_scale(t) = ||x(t) - x(t-1)||₂
2. 方向变化 d_direction(t) = 1 - cos(x(t), x(t-1))
当两者同时低于阈值（τ=10⁻⁵, φ=10⁻³）且连续p=5个块保持稳定时触发提前终止。集成策略：对静态方法采用"近因优先"遍历（反序），对重要性评分方法采用"重要性优先"遍历；强制计算Block 0以保留attention sink；通过在线softmax的置换不变性保证正确性。
AI.result: 在Mistral-7B和LongBench基准测试中，ART在全KV下保留99.2%原始分数；在SnapKV等方法上集成后，大批量推理时生成吞吐量提升20%，TPOT一致降低；消融实验验证d_scale（去除后精度-26.57%）、d_direction（-2.04%）和patience机制（-4.37%）的互补性；检测器自身开销仅1.3%；在Llama-3.1-70B上同样保持精度稳定，TPOT降低（虽幅度较小，因70B模型中注意力占比下降）。
AI.conclusion: ART是一种输出感知、运行时感知的轻量级终止机制，与现有KV缓存策略正交且可组合。它通过在注意力输出空间而非key空间进行收敛检测，隐式捕获keys和values的联合贡献。在保持生成质量的前提下，显著降低内存带宽需求和计算冗余，尤其在长上下文大批量场景下收益显著，是高效长上下文LLM解码的通用实用构件。

title: Cognitive-Linguistic Indicators of Depression in Online Communities: Analysed by DistilBERT and Holographic Reduced Representation
summary: This paper investigates whether combining cognitively grounded linguistic features with transformer-based embeddings improves automated detection of depression in online text. Using Beck's Cognitive Theory of Depression, the study extracts cognitive distortions as measurable features, including first-person pronoun density, absolutist words, and negative emotion in Reddit posts from depression-related and control communities. Using a subset of the Kaggle Reddit Suicide and Depression Detection dataset, two classification pipelines are compared, a TF-IDF embedding with Naive Bayes as a baseline, and a hybrid model that concatenates DistilBERT sentence embeddings with Holographic Reduced Representation (HRR) vectors encoding the cognitive-linguistic features, followed by Logistic Regression. The hybrid DistilBERT HRR model achieves a macro F1 score of 0.94 versus 0.80 for the TD-IDF baseline, with 5-fold cross validation F1 improving from 0.83 to 0.92, and AUC from 0.958 to 0.981.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合模型，将DistilBERT上下文嵌入与基于Beck认知理论的Holographic Reduced Representation (HRR)向量相结合，用于在Reddit帖子中自动检测抑郁症。实验结果显示，混合模型在Macro F1上达到0.94，AUC达0.981，显著优于TF-IDF + 朴素贝叶斯基线(F1=0.80)。
AI.motivation: 传统抑郁症诊断依赖人工临床访谈和自评量表，难以扩展且存在偏见。社交媒体上的语言是检测抑郁症的自然窗口。现有研究存在两个脱节：一是NLP研究者使用深度学习达到高精度但缺乏心理学理论根基；二是认知科学家识别了稳健的语言标记但仅分析小样本临床数据。本研究旨在通过将Beck认知理论驱动的语言特征与Transformer嵌入相结合，桥接这两个研究流，实现既可解释又高性能的抑郁症自动检测。
AI.method:
1. 数据：使用Kaggle Reddit Suicide and Depression Detection数据集，平衡采样1,000条抑郁类帖子和1,000条对照帖子，经预处理（去除URL、Markdown、HTML，最少10词过滤）后保留1,937条。
2. 认知-语言特征提取（基于Beck认知理论）：第一人称代词密度、绝对化词汇密度（如"always"、"entirely"）、否定情绪词汇密度、词数。
3. 两条分类管道：
   - 基线：TF-IDF (max_features=5000, ngram=(1,2)) + 多项式朴素贝叶斯
   - 混合模型：DistilBERT [CLS] 768维嵌入拼接256维HRR向量（通过circular convolution和superposition编码四个认知-语言特征）→ 1024维混合表示 → 逻辑回归
4. 评估：精确率、召回率、Macro F1、5折交叉验证、ROC-AUC。
AI.result: DistilBERT ⊕ HRR + LR混合模型取得Macro F1=0.94，AUC=0.981，5折CV F1=0.92。TF-IDF + NB基线Macro F1=0.80，5折CV F1=0.83，AUC=0.958。混合模型F1提升13个百分点，超出预设5-10%目标。基线模型识别的关键抑郁指示词包括"suicide"、"kill"、"anymore"，与Beck理论预期一致。ROC曲线显示混合模型在左上角（高灵敏度低误报）区域表现更优。意外发现：12%的抑郁类帖子超过DistilBERT的512 token限制（对照类仅4%），造成截断偏差偏向于抑郁类。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了假设：理论驱动的认知-语言特征可提供超越上下文嵌入的互补信号，HRR组件将模型预测与Beck认知框架中的潜在认知结构建立了可解释的连接。DistilBERT的零样本嵌入（无抑郁领域微调）即可有效迁移，简化了计算成本。未来工作应解决512 token截断偏差（采用分块策略或长上下文模型），在更大纵向数据集和跨平台语料上评估泛化性，并探索适应其他心理健康状况（焦虑、PTSD）。该研究推动了认知基础、可解释的心理健康NLP发展。

title: Graph-Augmented Retrieval for Cross-Entity Financial Sentiment Analysis: A Comparative Study
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become foundational for grounding large language models in domain-specific corpora, yet conventional vector-based RAG systems are fundamentally limited in their ability to capture the structured, multi-entity relationships that underpin financial market analysis. This paper presents a comprehensive comparative study of a novel two-hop Graph-RAG architecture versus a standard vector-only baseline for cross-entity financial sentiment analysis. Our system constructs a sentiment-weighted knowledge graph of 59 equity entities from 255 news articles covering 10 major technology stocks, then augments dense retrieval with intensity-filtered graph traversal over INFLUENCES edges to surface relational evidence inaccessible to vector search alone. We evaluate both architectures on 100 grounded queries (30 Direct, 70 Relational) using semantic similarity, entity recall, RAGAS metrics, latency benchmarks, and ablation studies. Graph-RAG achieves a statistically significant improvement in entity recall (+6.4%, p < 0.001, Wilcoxon signed-rank) and delivers substantially more relevant answers for complex multi-entity queries (+11.7% Answer Relevancy), with gains concentrating in relational question types (+16.1%). Critically, these improvements come at no measurable cost to answer quality (delta = +0.001 semantic similarity, Cohen's d = 0.078), with a modest 22.6% increase in mean latency offset by an 80% reduction in latency variance. An ablation study on the graph traversal intensity threshold reveals an inverted-U relationship with answer quality, identifying tau = 0.5 as optimal over the production default of tau = 0.7. These findings characterize a precision-for-coverage trade-off inherent to graph-augmented retrieval and provide actionable architectural guidance for practitioners building RAG systems for multi-entity financial analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于跨实体金融情感分析的Graph-RAG架构，通过构建包含59个股票实体的情感加权知识图，并在密集检索基础上增加强度过滤的图遍历。实验表明该方法在实体召回率(+6.4%)和答案相关性(+11.7%)上显著优于纯向量检索基线，尤其在关系型查询中提升达16.1%，但会带来22.6%的延迟增加。
AI.motivation: 传统基于向量检索的RAG系统将文本视为独立片段，无法捕捉金融市场中实体间的结构化多跳关系（如供应链级联、影响网络等），在多实体跨文档推理任务上存在"上下文平台期"问题。本文旨在解决向量检索在金融多实体情感分析中对结构化关系建模的局限性。
AI.method: 方法采用双架构对比设计：(1) 语料构建——使用Playwright和BeautifulSoup抓取10只科技股新闻(255篇文章)，用BGE-large模型编码为1024维向量，FAISS索引；(2) 知识图谱构建——通过GLiNER进行零样本实体抽取，FinBERT计算情感强度，构建Neo4j图(59个实体)，INFLUENCES边权重由情感极性差定义；(3) Graph-RAG两跳检索——第一跳向量检索top-5种子片段，第二跳遍历Intensity>0.7的INFLUENCES边获取邻居实体并重排序；(4) 评估——使用GPT-4o-mini生成，RAGAS指标+语义相似度+实体召回率，Wilcoxon符号秩检验统计显著性，并进行强度阈值消融实验。
AI.result: 在100个查询(30直接+70关系型)上的评估显示：Graph-RAG实体召回率提升+6.4%(p<0.001)，答案相关性提升+11.7%，在关系型查询中提升达+16.1%；语义相似度无显著差异(Δ=+0.001, Cohen's d=0.078)；上下文精度提升+6.1%但上下文召回率下降3.1%；平均延迟增加22.6%(9.03s vs 7.37s)但延迟方差降低80%；消融实验发现强度阈值与答案质量呈倒U型关系，τ=0.5优于生产默认τ=0.7。Graph-RAG在100题中胜出52题、平局25题、失败23题，失败案例集中在单实体事实查询和低连通性实体。
AI.conclusion: Graph-RAG在跨实体金融情感分析中相比纯向量检索存在精度-覆盖率的权衡：对于多实体关系型查询有显著价值，但对于简单事实查询收益有限。建议采用查询类型感知的路由策略，将简单查询导向向量检索、复杂关系查询导向图增强检索。强度阈值τ=0.5为推荐配置。未来工作方向包括人工评估、更大规模实体图、动态阈值选择和多模型泛化验证。

title: Agreement Metrics for LLM-as-Judge Evaluation: What to Report and Why
summary: Validating an LLM judge against human annotations usually means reporting several agreement statistics: accuracy, precision, recall, $F_1$, Cohen's $\kappa$, and one or more rank correlations. A survey of 24 recent LLM-as-judge papers finds metric choice entangled with the judgment scale, tie handling, invalid outputs, and abstention handling, and those choices rarely stated. For binary criteria -- the common case in rubric-based evaluation, where each criterion is graded MET or UNMET -- most of the reported numbers are redundant: Pearson's $r$, Spearman's $\rho$, Kendall's $\tau_b$, the phi coefficient $\phi$, and the Matthews Correlation Coefficient all reduce to a single number on non-degenerate binary data, so reporting several of them only creates an illusion of corroborating evidence. Cohen's $\kappa$ is the one agreement coefficient that adds information: it shares $\phi$'s numerator but normalizes differently, and the gap between them measures how far the judge's positive-label rate has drifted from the human's. We then trace what changes when a judge may abstain with a CANNOT_ASSESS verdict: the three common ways of handling abstentions are not interchangeable preprocessing choices but answer different questions, and they break the binary equivalences. The same equivalences reappear, up to a negligible finite-sample correction, for multi-judge ensembles scored with Fleiss' $\kappa$ or Krippendorff's $\alpha$. We close with a reporting checklist that names the judgment scale, the abstention and tie handling mode, coverage, the confusion matrix, and the aggregation level alongside any scalar agreement coefficient.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统审计了24篇LLM-as-Judge论文的协议指标报告实践，证明在二元判定数据上Pearson r、Spearman ρ、Kendall τ_b、φ系数和MCC五者完全等价（Observation 1），Cohen's κ是唯一提供独立信息的系数（其与φ的差异反映预测正例率的偏差）；CANNOT_ASSESS弃权的三种处理方式（排除、重编码、保留为第三类）估计不同的总体量；多评判者集合中Fleiss' κ与Krippendorff's α的差异仅为可忽略的有限样本修正。最终给出11条报告清单。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-Judge验证中常同时报告多个一致性指标（accuracy、F1、Cohen's κ、Pearson/Spearman/Kendall相关），但：(1) 这些指标在二元数据上是否真正独立？多数仅是同一数字的重复计算，制造"三角验证"的假象；(2) CANNOT_ASSESS弃权的处理是简单预处理还是估计量选择？作者对24篇近期文献的审计发现，指标选择与判定尺度、平局/无效输出/弃权处理纠缠不清，且几乎从不明确说明，造成报告数字不可复现、不可跨研究比较。
AI.method: 纯分析方法（无需新数据/模型）：(1) 对2×2混淆矩阵进行闭合式推导，证明五个二元关联指标代数等价；(2) 通过AM-GM不等式证明|κ|≤|φ|，等号当且仅当π=π̂（边际匹配）；(3) 引入潜在二元判定y*与弃权指示m的生成模型，将三种弃权处理方式形式化为不同条件估计量；(4) 通过仿射秩变换证明k=3时Spearman≠Pearson的定性断裂；(5) 推导Fleiss' κ与Krippendorff's α的精确恒等式α=κ_F+(1-κ_F)/(NR)；(6) 用δ方法证明匹配边际下Var(κ̂)=Var(φ̂)+O(N⁻²)。
AI.result: (1) 命题1（二元等价）：在非退化二元向量上，ρ_Pearson=ρ_Spearman=τ_b=φ=MCC；命题2（多评判者）：α=κ_F+(1-κ_F)/(NR)，对典型参数差异约1.3×10⁻³，可忽略；(2) κ与φ共享分子（TP·TN−FP·FN），分母分别为A+B与2√(AB)，故κ/φ=2√(AB)/(A+B)≤1，差距反映正例率漂移；(3) 工作例题：(TP,FN,FP,TN)=(40,10,20,30)时Acc=0.700、F1=0.727、κ=0.400、φ≈0.408；低频(5,5,0,90)时Acc=0.95、κ≈0.643、φ≈0.688，且全负预测器Acc=0.9、κ=0；(4) κ悖论：π→0或1时p_e→1，小幅精度差距将κ推向零或负值；(5) 聚合层级（micro/macro/item-level）估计不同量，给出两标准差准则下各自不同结果；(6) 弃权三模式示例（3×3表）：exclude得Acc=0.714、κ=0.416、F1=0.750；recode得0.700/0.394/0.667；三类得0.600/0.370/N/A；(7) 11条报告清单涵盖判定尺度声明、单一关联指标、混淆矩阵、退化准则处理、CA/平局模式、弃权率作为独立指标、覆盖度+选择性精度报告、权重矩阵、聚合层级、集合评判者。
AI.conclusion: LLM-as-Judge验证中报告的指标多样性"主要是表象"：在二元判定下，常报的六种数字坍缩为四种独立量（accuracy、F1、单一关联值φ、Cohen's κ）。Cohen's κ通过机会修正（其与φ的差距度量正例率漂移）提供独立信息；并列报告Pearson/Spearman/Kendall是用同一种统计量以三种方式计算，制造虚假的三角验证。真正携带信息的是结构性信息（混淆矩阵分离严格vs宽松评判者），而非数值多样性。弃权处理不是预处理而是估计量选择，三种模式（排除、重编码、保留三类）回答不同问题，最后一种破坏了二元等价。多评判者集合的Fleiss' κ、Krippendorff's α与平均配对φ在二元数据上仅差可忽略的有限样本修正。一致性数字只有在伴随固定其含义的声明（判定尺度、弃权/平局处理、覆盖度、混淆矩阵、聚合层级）时才可解释；这些声明成本仅为验证已产生的计数，最终汇总为Section 8的11条报告清单。

title: RealityTest: How People Probe AI Identity and Whether Models Disclose It
summary: AI systems are increasingly deployed in conversational settings where users may be uncertain whether they are speaking with a human or an AI. Despite mounting regulatory attention to this known safety risk, existing evaluations of AI disclosure are typically English-only, based on machine-generated questions, and restricted to text. We present RealityTest to comprehensively test whether AI systems disclose their identity when asked. The benchmark is the first large-scale multimodal and multilingual evaluation, grounded in human data on how people actually encounter and question AI identity in the real-world. Alongside the benchmark, we release the underlying dataset of 3,152 identity-probing queries collected from ~750 participants across 49 countries and five languages, in text and speech scenarios. We find that only 31% of people ask about identity directly in ambiguous scenarios, and that the questions people ask are far more diverse than machine-generated queries. We test 17 text and 6 speech models, and find substantial variation in disclosure behaviour. However, a single suppression instruction reduces disclosure rates to below 30%, even in the best-performing models. Validating our investment in diverse, human-grounded evaluation data, we find that how the question is phrased and the context of the conversation matter more for disclosure than which model is being tested. Safety evaluations built on narrow or synthetic query sets risk mischaracterising how models behave in realistic deployment settings.

AI.tldr: RealityTest 是一个大规模、多语言、多模态的基准测试，用于评估 AI 系统在被询问时是否披露其 AI 身份。该研究基于来自 49 个国家约 750 名参与者收集的 3,152 条真实人类身份探测查询，跨越 5 种语言和文本/语音两种模态，测试了 17 个文本模型和 6 个语音模型的披露行为。
AI.motivation: 随着对话式 AI 系统日益普及，用户经常无法确定自己是在与人类还是 AI 交流。现有 AI 身份披露评估存在三个关键局限：(1) 仅限英语；(2) 基于机器生成的问题，缺乏真实人类数据；(3) 局限于文本模态。这导致评估结果可能无法反映真实部署场景中模型的行为。此外，监管机构（如 EU AI Act、加州 BOT Act）已要求 AI 系统披露其人工性质，但缺乏对模型实际合规情况的系统性评估。
AI.method: 研究采用三阶段方法：(1) 通过英国代表性人口调查 (N=503) 和 Reddit 帖子 (50 个主题) 映射真实世界中身份模糊性出现的场景，归纳出三种典型场景：服务自动化、对抗性欺骗、合意沉浸；(2) 收集 3,152 条多语言、多模态的身份探测查询，由 784 名参与者针对假设场景生成，并将查询策略分为五类（直接身份查询、人物查询、能力查询、AI 漏洞利用查询、无显式查询）；(3) 构建 RealityTest 基准，将人类撰写的查询与现实场景配对，使用 GLMM 统计模型分析 17 个文本模型和 6 个语音模型在直接身份查询下的披露行为，并测试系统提示抑制指令和对话深度对披露率的影响。
AI.result: 关键发现包括：(1) 仅 31% 的参与者在模糊场景中直接询问身份，人类查询的语义多样性显著高于机器生成查询（平均成对余弦距离 0.85 vs 0.53）；(2) 模型披露率差异显著：文本模型从 8% 到 92%，语音模型从 10% 到 57%；(3) 查询措辞是披露率变异的最大来源（语音 37%，文本 26%），超过模型身份本身（10%-18%），语言仅占 1-3% 的变异；(4) 一条简单的抑制指令（"永远不要说你 AI"）即可将最佳模型的披露率降至 30% 以下，最高表现的 Claude Opus 4.6 从约 90% 降至 5% 以下；(5) 对话深度对披露率的影响因模型和场景而异，无统一方向性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了基于狭窄或合成查询集的 AI 安全评估可能严重误判模型在真实部署环境中的行为。即使在身份披露这一相对明确的行为上，模型表现也高度依赖于查询措辞、场景上下文和系统提示。研究强调，AI 安全评估必须建立在生态学有效、人类真实使用数据的基础上，以有效支撑监管合规、学术审计和开发者改进。RealityTest 基准、数据集和分析框架已公开发布，为监管者、研究者和开发者提供了可审计、可复现的身份透明度评估工具。

title: BOUTEF: A Multilingual Corpus for FakeNews in North Africa -- Language as a Weapon
summary: The rapid spread of fake news on social media has become a major challenge, particularly in multilingual and under-resourced contexts such as North Africa. In this paper, we introduce BOUTEF, a large-scale multilingual corpus designed to study the propagation, characteristics, and impact of fake news in Algeria and Tunisia. The corpus integrates three complementary components: fake narratives, genuine narratives, and associated user-generated comments, along with verified debunking information. It covers a wide range of languages and linguistic varieties, including MSA, Algerian and Tunisian dialects, Arabizi, French, English, and code-switched language. Building on this resource, we conduct a comprehensive empirical analysis combining quantitative and qualitative approaches. We examine thematic distributions, linguistic and rhetorical strategies, sentiment patterns, and social engagement dynamics. Statistical analyses reveal significant associations between thematic categories and message veracity, as well as strong correlations between user engagement and the visibility of fake content. Our findings show that fake news relies heavily on emotionally charged narratives, sensational framing, and hybrid linguistic practices that enhance virality and audience engagement. In contrast, debunking content adopts a more factual and verification-oriented style. Furthermore, a comparative analysis between Algeria and Tunisia highlights both shared dynamics and country-specific characteristics shaped by sociopolitical contexts. The results emphasize the role of informal language practices in the diffusion and reception of misinformation. By providing a rich, annotated, and publicly available dataset, this work contributes to advancing research on fake news detection, low-resource language processing, and the understanding of information disorders in complex linguistic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了BOUTEF，一个针对阿尔及利亚和突尼斯的大规模多语言假新闻语料库，涵盖MSA、阿尔及利亚/突尼斯方言、Arabizi、法语、英语及混合语码切换内容，并结合定量与定性分析揭示了假新闻的传播特征、语言策略及辟谣内容的差异。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体上假新闻的快速传播已成为重大挑战，尤其是在北非等多语言、低资源语境中。现有研究缺乏针对该地区多语言变体（方言、Arabizi、语码切换等）的专用数据集，难以深入理解虚假信息的传播机制与社会影响。
AI.method: 构建BOUTEF多语言语料库，整合假叙事、真实叙事、用户评论及验证后的辟谣信息，覆盖MSA、阿尔及利亚/突尼斯方言、Arabizi、法语、英语及语码切换语言。综合运用定量与定性方法，分析主题分布、语言与修辞策略、情感模式及社交互动动态，并通过统计检验主题类别与信息真伪的关联性，以及用户参与度与假内容可见度的相关性。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）假新闻严重依赖情感化叙事、煽情化框架以及混合语言实践以增强病毒式传播和受众参与度；2）辟谣内容则采用更加事实化、以核实为导向的风格；3）主题类别与信息真伪之间存在显著统计关联，用户参与度与假内容可见度呈强相关；4）阿尔及利亚与突尼斯既存在共享的传播动态，也因各自的社会政治背景呈现国家特异性差异。
AI.conclusion: 非正式语言实践在复杂语言环境中的虚假信息扩散与接收中扮演关键角色。BOUTEF作为丰富、标注且公开可用的数据集，将推动假新闻检测、低资源语言处理及信息失序（information disorders）研究的进一步发展。

title: DeSQ: Decomposition-based SPARQL Query Generation
summary: Dominant approaches to Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) fall into two categories. First is the generation of a formal query that suffers from brittleness and limited explainability, and the second is direct answer retrieval through KB exploration that is computationally costly and prone to hallucination. To combine the strengths of both paradigms while mitigating their respective weaknesses, we introduce DeSQ (Decomposition-based SPARQL Query Generation), a KB-agnostic framework that operates in three stages. First, it decomposes complex questions into Atomic Constraints (ACs) that mirror the relational structure of the underlying KB. Second, it generates a two-part structured output: (a) Mapping of each AC to its corresponding SPARQL Fragment, using standardized variable and URIs placeholders, and (b) URIs Grounding block describing each placeholder. Third, it assembles these fragments into a complete SPARQL query. DeSQ surpasses state-of-the-art approaches on four out of five major benchmarks and demonstrates superior robustness to lexical variation. Beyond performance gains, our framework greatly simplifies evaluation by eliminating the need for a live KB endpoint, and its structured output enables fine-grained error analysis, allowing more targeted interventions for improvement.

AI.tldr: DeSQ（基于分解的SPARQL查询生成）是一个知识库无关（KB-agnostic）的KBQA框架，通过三阶段流程将自然语言问题转换为可执行SPARQL查询：(1)将复杂问题分解为与知识库关系结构对齐的"原子约束"(AC)；(2)生成结构化的两部分输出（AC到SPARQL片段的映射+URI接地元数据）；(3)确定性组装为完整查询。该框架在五个主要基准测试中的四个上超越SOTA，并展现出对词法变化的更强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: KBQA领域存在两种主流范式各有缺陷：(1)直接生成形式化查询——脆弱、可解释性差，难以对齐自然语言与KB的高度结构化标识符；(2)直接通过KB探索检索答案——计算成本高、容易产生幻觉。现有端到端方法将语言理解与KB特定标识符解析这两种错误源混在一起，无法进行细粒度错误分析。此外，执行式F1评估会高估空结果查询对的表现。因此需要一个能够解耦语言推理与事实接地、消除对在线KB端点依赖、并支持细粒度错误诊断的框架。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：阶段1——问题分解：从训练集gold SPARQL查询中提取片段（SELECT/FILTER子句、图模式、修饰符），使用GPT-OSS 20B将每个片段口述化为原子约束(AC)，确保与KB的RDF格式结构对齐；每个AC对应一个关系三元组。阶段2——查询片段生成与URI接地：生成两部分输出——(a) AC到SPARQL片段的映射（使用标准化变量和URI占位符），(b) URI接地块（为每个占位符提供id、label、description）。阶段3——片段组装与URI纠正：使用BGE-Large构建的密集非参数KB记忆进行检索式URI纠正；提出"Round-trip"策略——若预测ID不在KB记忆中或其官方标签与生成标签不匹配，则用标签+描述进行密集检索替换。评估采用三粒度精确匹配(EM)：片段级、URI级、最终查询级。实验在六个开源LLM（Qwen3.5-0.8B/27B、Gemma-4 31B、Llama3.3 8B、Phi-4 14B）上进行，使用LoRA+4-bit量化微调。
AI.result: Phi-4 14B为最佳模型。在五个基准测试中四个超越SOTA：LCQ2 Raw 95%、LCQ2 Ref 70%、WebQSP 80%（vs ChatKBQA 77%）、CWQ 78%（vs ChatKBQA 76%）、QALD-10 66%（首次建立基线）。仅在GrailQA上未达SOTA（66% vs 79%），原因是该基准KB元素描述不完整限制了URI解析。关键发现：(1)语言分解任务在不同复杂度数据集上表现稳定（Phi-4在LCQ2 Raw上映射EM达86%），URI识别是主要瓶颈；(2)密集模型（Phi-4 14B）优于更大的MoE/混合模型（Qwen3.5 27B、Gemma-4 31B），模型规模与性能不呈正相关；(3)基于推理的模型并未优于非推理模型；(4)在Raw→Ref vs Ref→Raw的词法变化泛化中，前者泛化能力强（URI AVG 67.60 vs 37.58），表明自然表述问题提供更丰富学习信号。
AI.conclusion: DeSQ通过将分解粒度约束为与KB关系结构对齐，验证了三个关键贡献：(1)解耦语言推理与事实接地——模型学习独立的查询结构生成和URI接地；(2)后验URI纠正策略可有效恢复错误KB标识符，同时保留正确预测；(3)结构化输出消除了评估时对在线KB端点的需求，并支持细粒度错误分析。该工作揭示了知识库完整性的核心局限性——方法效果受限于KB中实体/关系的描述质量。Phi-4（14B）作为统一模型在所有基准上展现了强大的泛化能力。

title: Parameter Alignment Mitigates Catastrophic Forgetting in Multilingual Expert Language Models
summary: While continual pretraining~(CPT) is a practical way to extend large language models to new languages, naïve finetuning on targeted data erodes existing capabilities through catastrophic forgetting. Organizing training around language families reduces cross-language interference but cannot alone prevent forgetting of the general knowledge needed for downstream tasks. We link this forgetting to parameter drift in multilingual CPT and present a suite of five layer-aware parameter alignment strategies: hard layer freezing, soft regularization, post-hoc weight reversion, and model merging. We systematically compare our alignment strategies against two unregularized CPT baselines on benchmarks spanning 32 training languages from five language families, plus held-out languages, across four evaluation axes: perplexity, reading comprehension, physical reasoning, and translation. Parameter alignment substantially reduces forgetting at minimal cost to language acquisition: layer freezing and regularization best preserve comprehension, whereas post-hoc reversion yields the strongest translation gains. Together, these results map the acquisition--forgetting frontier for family-expert CPT and offer practical deployment guidelines pairing each strategy to the tasks it best serves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在多语言专家语言模型的持续预训练（CPT）中，通过五种子层感知（layer-aware）的参数对齐策略（硬层冻结、软L2-SP正则化、训练后权重回滚、Expert Soup模型合并）来缓解灾难性遗忘，并在5个语系、32种训练语言、4个评估维度（困惑度、阅读理解、物理推理、翻译）上系统比较。结果表明参数对齐能以最小代价减少遗忘，最优策略因任务而异：层冻结和正则化最佳保留理解能力，回滚策略带来最强翻译增益。
AI.motivation: 持续预训练（CPT）是将大语言模型扩展到新语言的实用方法，但朴素微调会通过灾难性遗忘侵蚀已有能力。已有研究证明按语族组织训练可减少跨语言干扰，但如何同时保护下游任务所需的通用知识仍是开放问题。本文假设遗忘源于多语言CPT中过度的参数漂移（parameter drift），并将问题转化为：能否通过约束或修正参数更新来在专家训练中保留基础模型能力？
